title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Engineering
full_description: <p>At Rockstar Games, we create world-class entertainment experiences.&nbsp;</p> <p>Become part of a team working on some of the most rewarding, large-scale creative projects to be found in any entertainment medium - all within an inclusive, highly-motivated environment where you can learn and collaborate with some of the most talented people in the industry.</p> <p>Rockstar Games is seeking a Senior Software Engineer in Data Engineering to join a team focused on building a cutting-edge game analytics platform and tools to better understand our players and enhance their experience in our games. &nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>The ideal candidate will be skilled in developing complex ingestion and transformation processes with an emphasis on reliability and performance. In collaboration with Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and other Software Engineers, the candidate will empower the team of Analysts and Data Scientists to deliver data driven insights and applications to company stakeholders. &nbsp;</p> <p>This is a full-time, in-office position based out of Rockstar’s newly renovated game development studio in Andover, MA.</p> <h4><strong>WHAT WE DO</strong></h4> <ul> <li>The Rockstar Games Online Services team builds the technology foundation that powers our games and delivers world-class player experiences. &nbsp;</li> <li>Our Data Engineering group manages petabyte-scale data, integrating dozens of streaming and batch sources with strict requirements for reliability, compliance, and low-latency processing.&nbsp;</li> <li>We approach data engineering with the rigor of software engineering by applying modern practices such as clean architecture, modular design, and automated testing. Our focus is on building scalable, reusable platforms and frameworks that enable our partners in Data Science and Game Development to deliver insights and unlock new possibilities for players.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h4><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain high-throughput streaming and batch data processing services, with a primary focus on raw and bronze-level ingestion.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop and operate stream–based applications responsible for real-time data transformation, enrichment, validation, and routing.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own and evolve event schemas and data contracts, including Avro schemas and Schema Registry governance.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure scalability, fault tolerance, and performance of streaming and ingestion pipelines under heavy load.&nbsp;</li> <li>Contribute to platform-level concerns such as deployment automation, observability, operational tooling, and CI/CD.&nbsp;</li> <li>Participate in the design and implementation of cloud-native data infrastructure supporting real-time and batch workloads.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h4><strong>REQUIREMENTS</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience building production software systems, preferably in a distributed or data-intensive environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong experience with Java (and/or Scala) as well as Python, in backend or data processing applications.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience designing and operating streaming systems using Kafka or Kafka Streams (or similar).&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working with event-driven architectures, including schema evolution and compatibility.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience building real-time and/or near-real-time data pipelines at scale.&nbsp;</li> <li>Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts (partitioning, fault tolerance, backpressure, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with Avro, Protobuf, or similar serialization formats and schema governance practices.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h4><strong>PLUSES</strong></h4> <p>Please note that these are desirable skills and are not required to apply for the position.</p> <ul> <li>Experience with Databricks, particularly for ingestion, bronze-layer processing, or structured streaming.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience deploying and scaling applications in containerized environments (e.g., Kubernetes, AKS).&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working with artifact repositories (e.g., Artifactory, ProGet, Maven repositories).&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, Databricks Asset Bundles).&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with the Microsoft Azure cloud ecosystem.&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with Apache Spark.&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment workflows.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h4><strong>HOW TO APPLY</strong></h4> <p>Please apply with a resume and cover letter demonstrating how you meet the skills above. If we would like to move forward with your application, a Rockstar recruiter will reach out to you to explain next steps and guide you through the process.</p> <p>Rockstar is committed to creating a work environment that promotes equal opportunity, dignity and respect. In line with this commitment, Rockstar will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified job applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process in order for such applicants to be considered for the position for which they are applying, as well as to qualified employees to enable them to perform the essential functions of their roles. If hired, employee will be in an "at-will position" and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.</p></div><div class="title">NE Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$130,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$150,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

full_description: <p><strong>Working at CreateFuture</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><a href="https://createfuture.com/">CreateFuture</a> is an <strong>AI-native consulting partner </strong>where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the</p> <p><strong>About the role&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We're looking for an experienced Lead Data Engineer to join our growing Data Practice, working on a Financial&nbsp;Services engagement centred on a large, long-lived SQL Server estate. You'll work as part of a multidisciplinary&nbsp;team helping a major FS client understand and de-risk a database landscape that has grown, unchecked, over 15&nbsp;years of trading activity.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who is comfortable going in without a map: a single SQL Server RDS instance holding around 1,100 tables and fifteen years of trade data, with no archiving strategy, no inventory of stored procedures, and tables duplicated across multiple schemas with no reliable way to tell what's actually in use.Part of the engagement's as-is analysis uses Claude to scan the codebase, map integration points, and flag likely&nbsp;dead code — you'll sit at the centre of that process, validating, interrogating, and making sense of what the&nbsp;tooling surfaces.</p> <p>As a Lead, you'll shape the technical approach to the estate discovery, mentor engineers supporting the&nbsp;analysis, and act as a trusted, credible partner to the client's data and platform teams.</p> <p>This role is Hybrid - requires 2 days per week on our clients site in Glasgow.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the as-is analysis of a ~1,100-table SQL Server RDS estate — establishing what exists, how it's&nbsp;structured, and where the risk sits, in the absence of any existing documentation or stored procedure&nbsp;inventory.</li> <li>Working alongside Claude-driven codebase scanning to map integration points, trace data lineage, and&nbsp;identify likely dead code, then applying engineering judgement to validate and prioritise the findings.</li> <li>Investigating duplicated tables across schemas to determine which copies are live, which are redundant,&nbsp;and what depends on each — building the tooling and queries needed where none currently exist.</li> <li>Designing an approach to 15 years of unarchived trade data — assessing volume, growth, and usage&nbsp;patterns to inform archiving, retention, and future-state options.</li> <li>Producing clear, defensible documentation of the database estate — schemas, dependencies, stored&nbsp;procedures, and data flows — that the client can rely on long after the engagement ends.</li> <li>Advising on remediation and modernisation options once the estate is understood, from consolidation&nbsp;and archiving through to longer-term platform or cloud migration.</li> <li>Leading and mentoring a small team of data engineers on the engagement, setting standards for how&nbsp;findings are verified, tested, and documented.</li> <li>Acting as a credible, hands-on technical partner to client stakeholders — including DBAs, platform&nbsp;owners, and risk/compliance contacts — who will be understandably cautious about changes to a live&nbsp;trading data estate.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h3> <p>You know your way around legacy SQL Server estates</p> <ul> <li>You're genuinely strong in SQL Server — schema design, query performance, stored procedures,&nbsp;indexing — and comfortable working in large, poorly documented production estates.</li> <li>You've reverse-engineered a database landscape before: worked out what's live vs. dead, resolved&nbsp;duplicated or conflicting schemas, and built confidence in an estate nobody fully understood.</li> <li>You understand the particular pressures of financial services data — long retention requirements, audit&nbsp;and regulatory expectations, and the need to prove data integrity for trade and transaction records.</li> <li>You're comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and know how to build a reliable&nbsp;picture of a system methodically rather than guessing.</li> </ul> <p>You're comfortable using AI tooling as part of the analysis</p> <ul> <li>You're open to and effective at using AI-assisted tools (we use Claude) to scan codebases, map&nbsp;integration points, and surface candidate dead code at a scale manual review can't match.</li> <li>You know how to sanity-check and validate AI-generated findings against the real system — you treat&nbsp;the output as a strong starting hypothesis, not ground truth.</li> <li>You can translate what the tooling surfaces into a clear, prioritised narrative that both engineers and&nbsp;non-technical stakeholders can act on.</li> </ul> <p>You know your tools</p> <ul> <li>Deep, hands-on SQL Server experience — T-SQL, SSMS, execution plans, and diagnosing performance or&nbsp;integrity issues in large OLTP schemas.</li> <li>Comfortable with AWS RDS for SQL Server, including monitoring, performance insights, and operational&nbsp;management.</li> <li>Solid scripting ability (Python and/or PowerShell) for building the discovery, cataloguing, and&nbsp;dependency-mapping tooling this engagement needs from scratch.</li> <li>Experience with data cataloguing, lineage, or metadata management tooling is a strong plus, even if the&nbsp;client doesn't currently have any in place.</li> <li>Familiarity with data archiving and retention strategies for large historical datasets is beneficial.</li> </ul> <p>You thrive in a consultancy setting</p> <ul> <li>You've led or mentored data engineers and are comfortable owning technical direction on a complex,&nbsp;ambiguous engagement.</li> <li>You can navigate the caution and politics of a large FS operator — multiple stakeholders, risk-averse&nbsp;change processes, and legacy systems that can't just be switched off.</li> <li>You're happy being onsite in Glasgow two days a week, building trust face-to-face with the client team</li> <li>You balance hands-on delivery with client engagement, and know when to push back on scope and&nbsp;when to be pragmatic.</li> </ul> <p>Tech snapshot</p> <ul> <li>Primary platform title: Forward Deployed Engineer, CE (Evergreen)
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Sayari:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <div> <p>Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue &amp; Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.</p> </div></div><h3><strong>POSITION DESCRIPTION</strong></h3> <p><strong>At Sayari, we’re always looking for great talent to join our team. This is a proactive hiring post for future Forward Deployed Engineer, CE roles, allowing us to connect with amazing candidates like you before a specific seat opens up.</strong></p> <p>This is not a traditional sales engineering role. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are at the critical intersection of our code, our clients, and their most critical missions. You will be deployed to our most strategic partners, embedding within their environments to solve high-stakes problems that have no textbook answers.</p> <p>You own the "last mile" of our product's impact , ensuring our technology fundamentally transforms how our users confront challenges such as financial crime, supply chain disruption, and threats to national security.</p> <p>You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. One day you might be architecting a data pipeline within a client's cloud environment ; the next, you'll be writing production Python to integrate our API into a proprietary analytics platform ; and by the end of the week, you could be briefing a C-level executive, intelligence analyst, or mission director on the outcomes your work has enabled.</p> <p>You thrive on ambiguity, operate with extreme ownership, and are relentless in your pursuit of delivering real-world value. You will act as a vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams, turning your bespoke solutions into scalable, platform-wide features of Sayari’s product suite.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>JOB RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Embed and Build:</strong> Deploy directly into our clients' technical ecosystems and work with key stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, technical environments, and mission challenges. Design, build, and ship production-grade code. You will write robust Python applications, advanced SQL, and leverage our APIs to solve bespoke challenges at the edge.</li> <li><strong>Own the Outcome:</strong> Lead the entire technical lifecycle of our most strategic deployments, from initial discovery and architectural design to implementation and operationalization. You are responsible for ensuring our platform delivers tangible, mission-critical value.</li> <li><strong>Be the Tip of the Spear:</strong> Serve as the primary technical authority for our clients. You'll lead deep-dive technical workshops, debug complex systems, and act as a trusted, hands-on advisor on how to best leverage Sayari's platform to achieve their objectives in real-world investigations and missions.</li> <li><strong>Engineer Solutions for the Mission:</strong> Deconstruct ambiguous, high-level mission requirements into concrete technical solutions. Architect and implement scalable data models and workflows, ranging from building robust data pipelines into client persistence layers (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) to developing custom Python scripts and prototyping AI/ML models.</li> <li><strong>Shape Our Product:</strong> Act as the vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams. You will translate complex, real-world operational needs and feedback into the next generation of Sayari's platform.</li> </ul> <h4>SKILLS &amp; EXPERIENCE</h4> <p><em>Required:</em></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a client-facing, technical role (Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, etc.).</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to write clean, production-ready code, with strong proficiency in programming languages (preferably Python) and its data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas, etc.).</li> <li>Deep fluency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.</li> <li>Hands-on, practical experience consuming, integrating, and reasoning about RESTful APIs.</li> <li>Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between code and mission. You can articulate highly technical concepts with clarity and conviction to engineers, analysts, and senior leaders alike.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex scenarios.</li> <li>A relentless drive and intellectual curiosity. You are comfortable parachuting into new environments and learning new technologies on the fly.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field strongly preferred</li> </ul> <p><em>Desired:</em></p> <ul> <li>Practical experience leveraging AI, including prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) or using their APIs to build analytical solutions.</li> <li>Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).</li> <li>Familiarity with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) and workflow orchestrators (e.g., Airflow, Prefect).</li> <li>Knowledge of graph data technologies (Neo4j, TigerGraph) and their corresponding query languages.</li> <li>Exposure to machine learning applications, particularly in NLP or entity resolution.</li> <li>Experience in, or a demonstrated passion for, high-stakes domains such as AML/Financial Crime, Supply Chain Risk, or National Security.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 30%</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>The target base salary for this position is $160,000-$180,000 plus commission and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Benefits:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <div> <ul> <li>100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents</li> <li>Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days</li> <li>Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions</li> <li>A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion</li> <li>Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage),, and parental leave</li> <li>A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you</li> <li>Limitless growth and learning opportunities</li> </ul> </div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.</em></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$160,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$180,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

You will be deployed to our most strategic partners, embedding within their environments to solve high-stakes problems that have no textbook answers.</p> <p>You own the "last mile" of our product's impact , ensuring our technology fundamentally transforms how our users confront challenges such as financial crime, supply chain disruption, and threats to national security.</p> <p>You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Shape the Future of AI</strong></h2> <p>At Labelbox, we're building the critical infrastructure that powers breakthrough AI models at leading research labs and enterprises. Since 2018, we've been pioneering data-centric approaches that are fundamental to AI development, and our work becomes even more essential as AI capabilities expand exponentially.</p> <h2><strong>About Labelbox</strong></h2> <p>We're the only company offering three integrated solutions for frontier AI development:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Enterprise Platform &amp; Tools</strong>: Advanced annotation tools, workflow automation, and quality control systems that enable teams to produce high-quality training data at scale</li> <li><strong>Frontier Data Labeling Service</strong>: Specialized data labeling through Alignerr, leveraging subject matter experts for next-generation AI models</li> <li><strong>Expert Marketplace</strong>: Connecting AI teams with highly skilled annotators and domain experts for flexible scaling</li> </ol> <h2><strong>Why Join Us</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>High-Impact Environment</strong>: We operate like an early-stage startup, focusing on impact over process. You'll take on expanded responsibilities quickly, with career growth directly tied to your contributions.</li> <li><strong>Technical Excellence</strong>: Work at the cutting edge of AI development, collaborating with industry leaders and shaping the future of artificial intelligence.</li> <li><strong>Innovation at Speed</strong>: We celebrate those who take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact. You'll be surrounded by curious minds solving complex problems at the frontier of AI.</li> <li><strong>Clear Ownership</strong>: You'll know exactly what you're responsible for and have the autonomy to execute. We empower people to drive results through clear ownership and metrics.</li> </ul></div><h2 data-section-id="k5dw9e" data-start="434" data-end="507">The role</h2> <p>The FDE Manager leads and grows the team of Forward Deployed Engineers who own the high-level technical side of our customer data programs. FDEs scope tasks, design the pipelines and measurement that turn a customer's goal into a training signal, write the instructions that guide Alignerrs, and work out what each customer actually needs from their data. The FDE Manager owns the people who do that work — their craft, their growth, and how they're deployed across domains and customers — and is accountable for the technical quality and consistency of what the team produces.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of people leadership, technical depth, and delivery quality. The FDE Manager must understand the technical substance of our projects well enough to coach on scoping and pipeline design, pressure-test instructions, judge whether a project's data will genuinely move the customer's model, and raise the bar on measuring quality early rather than late. It's a player-coach role: you lead people, but you stay close enough to the work to set and defend the craft bar yourself.</p> <p>The FDE Manager reports to the Services lead and partners closely with the SPL Manager, Deployment Leads, and General Managers. A core part of the role is keeping FDEs at the right altitude — focused on higher-level technical and customer-facing work — and actively handing the day-to-day running of projects to the SPLs and Pod Leads, so the team's most expensive technical talent is never absorbed into project operations.</p> <p>The FDE Manager also owns FDE onboarding and is the steward of the FDE career path, which runs from FDE to FDE 2 to FDE Manager, with branches toward the Forward Deployed Researcher (FDR) track and, in time, toward General Manager.</p> <hr data-start="1041" data-end="1044"> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the FDE team end-to-end: hire, coach, manage performance, and develop careers across the FDE track and toward FDR or GM.</li> <li>Own the supply side of FDE staffing: commit FDEs to the staffing cadence and match them to projects by skill and development need, balancing each FDE's preferred vertical with where the work is, and staffing to the phase of a project rather than parking people for its full length.</li> <li>Set and uphold the craft bar: sharp task scoping, sound pipeline and measurement design (including the LLM-as-judge and quality instrumentation that surface problems early), clear instruction writing, and compelling customer-facing presentation of findings.</li> <li>Protect FDE focus: keep day-to-day project operations with the SPLs and Pod Leads, and keep FDEs on scoping, technical depth, and what the customer needs from the data.</li> <li>Own FDE onboarding and the bar that certifies a new FDE as ready to be staffed: define which projects are eligible to onboard on, maintain the instruction and Loom repository, and run the onboarding program — including the core exercise (read a past project's instructions, explain them back, and write a new version in the repo).</li> <li>Drive reuse and leverage: build the templates, tooling, and playbooks that stop FDEs rebuilding pipelines and instructions from scratch each project, so the team's capacity compounds as we scale.</li> <li>Ensure FDEs work hand-in-glove with FDRs on research, efficacy, and customer needs, and partner with whoever owns quality sign-off so quality is caught in flight, not at delivery.</li> <li>Partner with the SPL Manager, Deployment Leads, and GMs on staffing, delivery, and alignment with customer objectives.</li> <li>Step in on escalations when a pipeline, delivery, or customer relationship is at risk.</li> <li>Maintain a clear, live view of team capacity, utilization, and bench across active projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Own</strong></p> <ul> <li>The capability and craft bar of the FDE team.</li> <li>How quickly and consistently new FDEs reach a staffable standard.</li> <li>Healthy deployment — the right FDEs on the right projects, at the right altitude and utilization.</li> <li>A growing bench of FDEs developing toward FDR and future leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong forward-deployed / FDE background, or significant experience managing technical or delivery people — and readiness to be a hands-on, player-coach manager.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency in our domain: enough depth in frontier-data work, RL environments, data pipelines, and quality/evaluation to coach credibly on scoping, pipelines, judge design, and data quality.</li> <li>Excellent judgment on what makes data genuinely useful to a customer — how to translate ambiguous requirements into clear plans, and how to tell whether data will actually move a model.</li> <li>A track record of developing people and giving direct, useful feedback.</li> <li>A high bar for quality paired with the ability to deliver against ambitious timelines.</li> <li>Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments where the processes are still being built.</li> <li>The ability to manage multiple people and projects at once without losing attention to detail.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct experience with RLHF, reinforcement-learning environments, evaluation/benchmark work, or LLM-as-judge systems.</li> <li>Experience working with forward-deployed engineers, solutions engineers, or implementation teams.</li> <li>Experience building onboarding programs, instruction systems, or training content.</li> <li>Experience scaling a team and its operating processes in a high-growth environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <p>In your first several months, you'll take ownership of the FDE team, raise the bar on scoping, pipeline, and instruction quality, and get onboarding running smoothly — eligible projects defined, the instruction and Loom repository in good shape, and new FDEs reaching a staffable standard faster and more consistently. You'll build strong working relationships with the SPL Manager, Deployment Leads, and GMs, keep FDEs well-deployed and at the right altitude, and become the person the team relies on for craft and career growth.</p> <p>Over time, you'll define how FDEs work at scale: the templates, tooling, and playbooks that let the team produce more without rebuilding from scratch, a measurement-and-quality craft bar that surfaces problems early, and a pipeline of FDEs growing into FDRs and future leaders.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>Labelbox strives to ensure pay parity across the organization and discuss compensation transparently.&nbsp; The expected annual base salary range for United States-based candidates</em><em>&nbsp;</em><em>is below. This range is not inclusive of any potential equity packages or additional benefits. Exact compensation varies based on a variety of factors, including skills and competencies, experience, and geographical location.</em></p></div><div class="title">Annual base salary range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$190,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$250,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Life at Labelbox</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Environment</strong>: Fast-paced and high-intensity, perfect for ambitious individuals who thrive on ownership and quick decision-making</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: Career advancement opportunities directly tied to your impact</li> <li><strong>Vision</strong>: Be part of building the foundation for humanity's most transformative technology</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our Vision</strong></h2> <p>We believe data will remain crucial in achieving artificial general intelligence. As AI models become more sophisticated, the need for high-quality, specialized training data will only grow. Join us in developing new products and services that enable the next generation of AI breakthroughs.</p> <p>Labelbox is backed by leading investors including SoftBank, Andreessen Horowitz, B Capital, Gradient Ventures, Databricks Ventures, and Kleiner Perkins. Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading AI labs.</p> <p><strong>Your Personal Data Privacy</strong>: Any personal information you provide Labelbox as a part of your application will be processed in accordance with Labelbox’s <a href="https://docs.labelbox.com/page/job-applicant-privacy-notice">Job Applicant Privacy notice</a>.</p> <p>Any emails from Labelbox team members will originate from a @labelbox.com email address. If you encounter anything that raises suspicions during your interactions, we encourage you to exercise caution and suspend or discontinue communications.</p></div>

Since 2018, we've been pioneering data-centric approaches that are fundamental to AI development, and our work becomes even more essential as AI capabilities expand exponentially.</p> <h2><strong>About Labelbox</strong></h2> <p>We're the only company offering three integrated solutions for frontier AI development:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Enterprise Platform &amp; Tools</strong>: Advanced annotation tools, workflow automation, and quality control systems that enable teams to produce high-quality training data at scale</li> <li><strong>Frontier Data Labeling Service</strong>: Specialized data labeling through Alignerr, leveraging subject matter experts for next-generation AI models</li> <li><strong>Expert Marketplace</strong>: Connecting AI teams with highly skilled annotators and domain experts for flexible scaling</li> </ol> <h2><strong>Why Join Us</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>High-Impact Environment</strong>: We operate like an early-stage startup, focusing on impact over process. You'll take on expanded responsibilities quickly, with career growth directly tied to your contributions.</li> <li><strong>Technical Excellence</strong>: Work at the cutting edge of AI development, collaborating with industry leaders and shaping the future of artificial intelligence.</li> <li><strong>Innovation at Speed</strong>: We celebrate those who take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact. Our environment rewards high agency and rapid execution.</li> <li><strong>Continuous Growth</strong>: Every role requires continuous learning and evolution. You'll be surrounded by curious minds solving complex problems at the frontier of AI.</li> <li><strong>Clear Ownership</strong>: You'll know exactly what you're responsible for and have the autonomy to execute. We empower people to drive results through clear ownership and metrics.</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2> <p>Alignerr is Labelbox's human data organization — we produce the training data that frontier AI labs use to build their most capable models. Our Forward Deployed Research Team sits at the intersection of research science and client delivery, embedding research capability directly into the engagements that drive our business.</p> <p>This is not a traditional research scientist role. You will not spend months pursuing a single research question. You will work on multiple client engagements simultaneously, operating on timescales of days to weeks. You will sit in scoping meetings with research teams at major AI labs, reason scientifically about data strategy in real time, fine-tune open-weight models to validate our data methodology, and collaborate with our Applied Research team to turn client-grounded findings into published work. The pace is fast, the problems are applied, and the feedback loops are short.</p> <p>We are looking for someone who finds that energizing, not compromising.</p> <h2><strong>Your Impact</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Engage directly with frontier lab research teams.</strong> You will be in the room during client scoping meetings — not as support staff, but as a technical peer. You'll engage on methodology, challenge assumptions about data requirements, and shape project specifications based on a scientific understanding of how data composition affects model outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Develop deep scientific understanding of client engagements.</strong> For each project, you will build a working model of the client's architecture, training methodology, and target capabilities. You'll use this understanding to reason about why a particular data strategy will or won't work, identify risks early, and iterate with empirical grounding — not intuition.</p> <p><strong>Run ablation studies and fine-tune open-weight models.</strong> You will fine-tune models on client data (and proxy data) to empirically measure the impact of our data on model performance. This is how we validate that what we deliver actually improves our customers' models — and how we catch problems before the client does.</p> <p><strong>Consult on workflow and quality systems.</strong> You will partner with our Human Data Operations team to review annotation schemas, task designs, and quality rubrics before projects go into execution. Your job is to ensure the spec is technically sound — that the data we produce will actually serve the client's training objectives.</p> <p><strong>Collaborate with Applied Research on publications and benchmarks.</strong> Our Applied Research team owns the long-horizon research agenda. Your role is to feed them signal from the field — generalizable findings, reusable methodologies, empirical results — and help drive joint projects to completion. You will contribute to benchmarks, white papers, and conference submissions that establish Labelbox's research credibility.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>MS or PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.</li> <li>Hands-on experience fine-tuning large language models (open-weight models such as Llama, Mistral, Qwen, or similar).</li> <li>Strong understanding of LLM training pipelines — pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, RLHF/DPO, and how data quality and composition affect each stage.</li> <li>Experience designing and executing experiments with rigor — hypothesis formation, controlled comparisons, statistical analysis of results.</li> <li>Ability to operate at speed. You should be comfortable going from problem definition to experimental results in days, not months.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication. You will present findings to client research teams and contribute to published work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience at a frontier AI lab, applied ML startup, or in a research role with direct client/stakeholder interaction.</li> <li>Experience with evaluation and benchmarking of LLMs — designing metrics, building eval harnesses, interpreting results critically.</li> <li>Familiarity with human data pipelines — annotation workflows, quality assurance methodology, inter-annotator agreement analysis.</li> <li>Experience with reinforcement learning, reward modeling, or RLHF environments.</li> <li>Published research (conferences, journals, or technical reports) in ML/NLP or adjacent fields.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Matters More Than Credentials</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Applied instinct over academic purity.</strong> The measure of success here is client impact and publishable-but-practical results — not methodological novelty for its own sake. This is a full-stack role: you'll build and maintain the pipelines, transformations, and data models that turn billing and usage data into the revenue, forecasting, and reporting infrastructure Finance runs on.</p> <p>You'll work closely with Finance stakeholders to understand how metrics are used and make sure they're right, not just build to spec. pipelines that bring billing, usage, and contract data into the warehouse reliably, including metered usage across multiple products.</li> <li>Diagnose and resolve data quality and freshness issues at the source, not just downstream.</li> <li>Design and maintain dbt models that turn raw billing and usage data into clean, trusted datasets for revenue recognition, margin, and forecasting.</li> Finance leaders (FP&amp;A, Accounting, Revenue) to understand what they need from the data and why, and push back when the ask doesn't match the underlying question.</li> <li>Build pipeline and transformation code to a high engineering bar, and hold others to it through code review.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers and help set technical standards for the team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning production data pipelines end-to-end</li> <li>Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience writing production-grade, testable code, not just scripts for one-off analysis</li> <li>Hands-on experience with dbt (or a comparable transformation <li>Competitive compensation package, including equity.</li> <li>Inclusive Healthcare Package.</li> <li>Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.</li> <li>Flexible Time Off.</li> <li>We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.</li> </ul> <p>The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $170,000 - $260,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Role</span></h3> <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Tailscale, you’ll be the bridge between our technical capabilities and the needs of our most strategic customers. You will work directly with customers to ensure their success with Tailscale’s products, helping them get onboarded, driving their long-term adoption, and providing expert technical guidance throughout their journey. This role requires a combination of technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and an empathetic customer-centric approach to ensure customers are fully empowered to leverage the power of Tailscale. The role will report directly to the Team Lead, Customer Success Engineers.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Lead and manage the onboarding process for new strategic customers, ensuring they quickly understand and adopt Tailscale. Provide training and resources that set customers up for long-term success.</li> <li>Offer technical support for customers, diagnosing and resolving issues across Tailscale's platform. Assist with configuration, integration, and troubleshooting to ensure smooth implementation.</li> <li>Conduct QBRs with customers to review usage, success metrics, and future goals. Use these touchpoints to identify opportunities for deeper engagement and horizontal expansion.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor. Help customers optimize their use of Tailscale by identifying best practices, and by providing recommendations based on their specific use cases and desired business outcomes.</li> <li>Serve as the voice of the customer internally, relaying feedback and insights to the product and engineering teams to help improve the product and the customer experience.</li> <li>Work closely with sales, product, engineering, and support teams to ensure smooth handoffs, escalate critical issues, and drive customer success across the organization.</li> <li>Develop and maintain a repository of technical documentation, FAQs, and guides to help customers self-serve. Share insights and best practices with both the customer and internal teams.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>6+ Years in a technical role with minimum 2 years of customer-facing experience (Solutions engineer/architect, Sr. Support Engineer, etc.)</li> <li>Experience working with enterprise customers in a consultative capacity</li> <li>Strong understanding of networking, VPNs, and security principles. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and other DevOps technologies</li> <li>Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer/architect, or Customer Success Engineer at a SaaS company</li> <li>Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to a diverse audience, from non-technical stakeholders to engineers. Strong written and verbal communication skills are a must</li> <li>Analytical mindset and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to think critically and methodically to resolve complex technical issues</li> <li>A passion for delivering excellent customer service and a strong focus on building long-term customer relationships</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize tasks, and keep projects on track. Strong time management and organizational skills are key</li> <li>A collaborative mindset and ability to work cross-functionally with product, sales, and engineering teams to deliver customer success</li> </ul> <p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>For this position, our pay ranges reflect target OTE (on target earnings), inclusive of base salary and variable compensation tied to the attainment of quarterly sales targets.</p></div><div class="title">CAN Pay Range (OTE)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$201,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$335,000 CAD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications.&nbsp;</em><strong data-stringify-type="bold"><em data-stringify-type="italic">We encourage you to help us break that statistic!</em></strong></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self.</strong> We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.</li> <li><strong>A competitive total compensation package.</strong> This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).</li> <li><strong>Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. </strong>Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!</li> <li><strong>Remote first company</strong>—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.</li> <li><strong>Employer-funded retirement contributions. </strong>Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.</li> <li><strong>Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. </strong>Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.<strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Support for your personal and professional development.</strong> Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration.&nbsp;</strong>Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>A build-your-own home office setup. </strong>You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Paid parental leave program</strong>. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).</li> </ul> <p><em>Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.</em></p> <p><em>Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.</em></p> <p><em>Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit <a href="https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness">https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness</a>.</em></p></div>

title: Staff Data Engineer
full_description: <h1>Staff Data Engineer</h1> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>Fora is in the process of modernizing its data stack to build the foundation for agentic products and analytics. To lead this effort, we are hiring a Staff Data Engineer to build and own the platform backbone for governed reporting and trusted AI workflows.</p> <p>This is a hands-on Staff IC role on a small Data &amp; AI team. You will make strategic architecture calls—from ingestion patterns and Snowflake design to data contracts and SLAs—and then get into the weeds to build, harden, or rebuild pipelines.</p> <p>We are looking for a systems thinker who understands business impact and operational burden, and who can partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, and vendors to turn fragmented source systems into trustworthy data products.</p> <h2>What you will own</h2> <h3>Architecture &amp; Strategy</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Data platform architecture</strong>: ingestion patterns, warehouse design, environment strategy, orchestration, access governance, and reliability standards.</li> <li><strong>Freshness &amp; ingestion strategy: </strong>Deciding when to use streaming versus batch based on business value, cost, and operational burden.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership: </strong>Partnering with Platform Engineering to ensure our data infrastructure integrates securely and reliably with core operational systems.</li> </ul> <h3>Execution &amp; Reliability</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Data Integrations: </strong>requirements → source profiling → ingestion design → QA → documentation → support.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline reliability: </strong>dependencies, retries, alerts, backfills, incident response, runbooks, monitoring, and support expectations.</li> <li><strong>Legacy migration: </strong>helping retire brittle reporting paths such as Azure Data Factory, SQL backup workflows, and other duplicate pipelines.</li> </ul> <h3>Governance &amp; Quality</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Snowflake governance:</strong> roles, permissions, service accounts, connector ownership, environment separation, performance, cost, and governance.</li> <li><strong>Data contracts:</strong> schema-change handling, new-field availability, upstream SLAs, source defects, and escalation paths.</li> <li><strong>Data observability:</strong> freshness, volume movement, nulls, duplicates, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and critical business-rule checks.</li> <li><strong>AI-enabled leverage:</strong> using AI and automation to accelerate debugging, documentation, pipeline scaffolding, and operational workflows.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Deep data engineering judgment.</strong> You have designed, built, and operated production platforms, not just individual pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on depth.</strong> You move seamlessly from high-level architecture to writing production code, standing up CI/CD workflows, and debugging pipeline failures.</li> <li><strong>Strong ingestion fundamentals.</strong> APIs, CDC, backfills, idempotency, schema drift, and failure recovery.</li> <li><strong>Snowflake fluency.</strong> Warehouse design, RBAC, performance tuning, and cost controls.</li> <li><strong>Data quality discipline.</strong> You know which checks matter and make quality visible before users find issues.</li> <li><strong>Ownership &amp; communication.</strong> You can sequence ambiguous work, write useful design docs, align technical decisions with business outcomes, and carry problems to resolution.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> You work with stakeholders across Engineering, Analytics, and the business to understand needs, define clear requirements, and build trust.</li> <li><strong>AI leverage.</strong> You use LLMs and agents to accelerate your own work, and you build data products that agents can consume safely.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Lending, fintech, or financial-services data experience.</li> <li>CDC, Debezium, dbt Cloud, Dagster, Airflow, or equivalent tooling.</li> <li>Fluency with Azure data services such as Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, and Azure DevOps.</li> <li>Data observability with Monte Carlo, Elementary, dbt tests, custom monitors, or similar.</li> <li>Data contracts, source SLAs, or schema-change processes with Engineering teams.</li> <li>AI-native analytics, semantic layers, MCP servers, agentic orchestration, or governed context retrieval.</li> <li>Familiarity with open table formats such as Apache Iceberg.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation and logistics</h2> <ul> <li>Base salary: <strong>$175,000–$200,000</strong></li> <li>Fully remote within the US; Eastern or Central time zones preferred.</li> <li>Reports to the VP of Data &amp; AI.</li> <li>Final compensation is based on scope of past ownership, technical judgment, and ability to set direction independently.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits of working at Fora Financial</h2> <ul> <li>Company-subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans.</li> <li>401(k) plan with company match.</li> <li>Life insurance at no cost to employees.</li> <li>Generous time off plan, including rollover vacation days.</li> <li>Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts.</li> <li>Commuter benefits.</li> <li>Remote working model.</li> <li>Weekly breakfast, snacks, and Friday lunches provided onsite.</li> </ul> <h2>About Fora Financial</h2> <p>Fora Financial is a technology-enabled provider of flexible financing to small and medium-sized businesses. Since 2008, we have supported more than 55,000 merchants nationwide with over $4 billion in capital for operating expenses, cash-flow management, and growth.</p> <p>Our proprietary technology helps deliver capital through a streamlined process that can be completed in as little as 24 hours, compared with the weeks or months often required for a traditional bank loan. Fora has grown from two founders in a small Manhattan workspace to a company of nearly 200 employees with a collaborative, partner-centric culture.</p> <h2>Equal Opportunity Statement</h2> <p>Fora Financial is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under local, state, or federal law. Fora Financial provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.</p>

full_description: <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Position Summary</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The BI &amp; Data Applications Engineer is an experienced BI and data engineering professional responsible for building and maintaining Focus's data consumption layer — the reports, dashboards, and interactive applications that let the business work directly with data in Snowflake. title: Director, Data Engineering
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About Engine<br></strong></h3> <p>Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.<br><br>That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).<br><br>We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.&nbsp;</p> <p>Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We’re seeking a <strong>Director of Data Engineering</strong> to define the vision and execute the long-term strategy for our global data ecosystem. This is a foundational leadership role responsible for the re-architecture of our data warehouse into a world-class platform. You will not only oversee the migration to modern infrastructure but will also be the primary architect of our data governance framework and cross-functional data democratization strategy. We are looking for a visionary leader who can balance technical depth in the modern data stack (Snowflake, Airflow, dbt) with the executive presence to influence our product and business roadmaps.</p> <h3><strong>Your Mission</strong></h3> <p>As a key leader within the Engine team, you will move beyond project management to organizational leadership. Your core responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Vision &amp; Roadmap:</strong> Define the 2–3 year vision for the data platform. Align data engineering initiatives with overarching company goals to ensure data is a primary driver of business growth.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Leadership:</strong> Build and scale a multi-tiered engineering organization. Foster a culture of technical excellence, mentorship, and high accountability, ensuring a robust leadership pipeline within your team.</li> <li><strong>Data Governance &amp; Compliance:</strong> Establish and enforce global standards for data quality, security, and privacy (GDPR/CCPA). Own the framework for data cataloging and lineage to ensure "one source of truth" across the enterprise.</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence &amp; ROI:</strong> Optimize the total cost of ownership (TCO) for our data infrastructure. Manage vendor relationships (Snowflake, etc.) and budgets while ensuring the stack scales efficiently with company growth.</li> <li><strong>Executive Stakeholder Management:</strong> Serve as the primary liaison between Engineering and the C-suite. Translate technical debt and infrastructure needs into business value, and turn business requirements into scalable technical architectures.</li> <li><strong>Innovation &amp; Architecture:</strong> Drive the adoption of cutting-edge technologies (AI/ML integration, real-time streaming) to keep Engine at the forefront of the industry.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You’ll Bring to Engine</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for an executive-minded leader who thrives at the intersection of deep technical "know-how" and high-level business strategy:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 10+ years in Data Engineering/Software Engineering, with at least 5+ years in senior leadership roles (managing managers or leading large-scale departments).</li> <li><strong>Strategic Technical Expertise:</strong> Deep architectural knowledge of the modern data stack (Snowflake, Airflow, dbt, Airbyte). Experience leading large-scale cloud migrations and designing systems that support both BI and Machine Learning workflows.</li> <li><strong>Change Management:</strong> Proven ability to lead organizations through significant technical shifts and cultural changes, specifically moving from legacy systems to agile, modern architectures.</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen:</strong> Exceptional ability to communicate the "Why" behind technical investments to non-technical partners. You should have a track record of using data to solve complex business problems.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.</li> <li><strong>Mindset:</strong> A high-level thinker who isn't afraid to dive into the weeds when necessary, but consistently operates with an eye toward scalability, sustainability, and competitive advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p data-start="62" data-end="438"><span style="font-size: 18px;"><strong data-start="62" data-end="78">Compensation<br></strong></span><br data-start="78" data-end="81">Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, total compensation may include equity and/or variable pay (OTE). Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$223,975</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$310,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The Engine Edge: Perks &amp; Compensation</strong><strong><br></strong>We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Compensation:</strong> Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with opportunities for bonuses, commissions, and equity.</li> <li><strong>Benefits:</strong> Check out our full list at<a href="https://engine.com/culture"> </a><a href="http://engine.com/culture">engine.com/culture</a>.</li> <li><strong>Environments for Success: </strong>Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we’ll make sure you have what you need to succeed.</li> </ul> <p><em>Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more.</em></p> <p><strong>Ready to Build the Future of Work Travel?</strong><strong><br></strong>Join us on our mission to transform how work travel works—for businesses, for travelers, and for the industry. Apply now and let’s make travel simpler, smarter, and more enjoyable—together.</p></div>

title: Data Engineer
location: New York, New York, United States
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.</p> <p>We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.</p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>You'll join an early and growing data engineering team that's shaping the foundations of our data platform. We're investing in a modern transformation layer, reliable pipelines, and richer in-product analytics for our clients and you'll have real influence over how that gets built.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>You'll be one of the first data engineers on our team. This is hands-on, high-ownership work: building our transformation layer, strengthening our analytics pipelines, and creating the data models that power both internal reporting and the analytics our clients see inside the product.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build data models:</strong> develop dbt models and SQL transformations, backed by tests, that turn raw data into reliable datasets.</li> <li><strong>Improve pipeline reliability:</strong> help monitor our replication and orchestrated pipelines, investigate data issues, and add quality checks.</li> <li><strong>Power reporting:</strong> build and refine the datasets and dashboards that internal teams and clients rely on.</li> <li><strong>Learn and grow:</strong> work closely with senior engineers, take part in code review, and steadily take on more ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <p><em>We're open on exact tools — we care about fundamentals and trajectory. You'll likely have most of the following:</em></p> <ul> <li>3-5 years of professional data engineering experience</li> <li><strong>Strong SQL:</strong> you write correct, readable SQL and understand relational data modeling</li> <li><strong>Data experience:</strong> you've developed data pipelines and transformations in production environments</li> <li><strong>Eagerness to learn:</strong> you take feedback well, ask good questions, and are excited to grow as a data engineer</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to have: exposure to dbt, CDC / replication or orchestration tools (e.g. Estuary Flow, Debezium/Kafka, Airflow), a cloud data warehouse (ex. Redshift), a BI tool (ex. Sigma, Looker); comfort with PostgreSQL or a similar database.</em></p> <h4>Our stack</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Databases:</strong> PostgreSQL across our production and analytics environments, with room to grow into a cloud warehouse (ex. Redshift) as we scale</li> <li><strong>Ingestion:</strong> CDC / streaming replication into analytics (evaluating tools like Estuary Flow and Debezium/Kafka)</li> <li><strong>Transformation:</strong> building out a version-controlled, dbt-based staging/marts layer with data tests and CI/CD</li> <li><strong>Orchestration:</strong> scheduled, observable pipeline runs (e.g. Airflow or similar)</li> <li><strong>BI &amp; embedded analytics:</strong> a modern BI and embedding platform (we use Sigma) for internal reporting and in-product client analytics, with a maturing semantic/metrics layer</li> <li><strong>Domain:</strong> life sciences / healthcare data; comfort working in HIPAA-aware, PHI-handling environments is a plus</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)</li> <li>401(k) with employer funded match</li> <li>Unlimited Vacation</li> <li>Commuter Benefits</li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Catered lunch on Fridays</li> <li>Wellness stipend</li> </ul> <p>The annual salary range for the target level for this role is $120,000-$150,000 + equity + benefits, including medical, dental, and vision. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, interview performance, and internal equity.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Courier Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p>We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</p></div>

title: Data Engineer III
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>What you’ll be part of</strong></h2> <p>Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.</p> <p>The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.</p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an exceptional Data Engineer III to join our Engineering team, with a high sense of ownership who is excited about our mission, eager to learn and teach others, and can deliver across the tech stack. The ideal candidate should have experience with a modern data stack and implementations of data pipelines using Python and SQL in AWS.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Where you will work:</strong></p> <p>This role will be based in our New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.</p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, optimize, and maintain data pipelines that power our business</li> <li>Define and build out abstracted reusable data sets to be used for Business Intelligence, Marketing, and Data Science Research</li> <li>Design, build, and evangelize a federated data validation framework to be used to monitor potential data inconsistencies</li> <li>Protect our users’ privacy and security through best practices</li> </ul> <p><strong>The ideal candidate has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of software/data engineering experience (distributed data processing, data warehousing, data governance, Big Data, data variance, data privacy, and data quality).</li> <li>Expertise in SQL and Python</li> <li>Expertise in building scalable data pipelines, query optimization, data modeling, and defining reusable datasets</li> <li>Experience working with orchestration tools (especially Airflow), databases (especially PostgreSQL), data warehouses (especially Snowflake)</li> <li>Familiarity with SQL tuning, medallion/event-driven architectures, and telemetry.</li> <li>Familiarity with healthcare or insurance</li> <li>Familiarity with data security and HIPPA compliance</li> <li>A desire to be a part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.</strong></p> <h3><strong>What you'll get here:</strong></h3> <p>You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.</p> <p>At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use:</strong></p> <p>Postgres/SQL, Snowflake, Python, AWS, Terraform, Argo, Airflow, Spark, DuckDB, Iceberg, Airbyte, DBT, ElasticSearch (aka OpenSearch), OpenTelemetry, Looker</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.</p> <p><strong>Compensation Transparency:</strong></p> <p>The target salary range for this position is $<span data-sheets-root="1">166,000 - $205,000</span>. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health and more.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <h3><strong>Fraud and Security Notice:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use <a href="http://getgarner.com/">getgarner.com</a> and <a href="garnerhealth.com">garnerhealth.com</a> email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement <a href="https://www.ic3.gov/Home/ComplaintChoice">here</a> and to <a href="mailto:candidateprotection@getgarner.com">candidateprotection@garnerhealth.com</a>.</p> <h3><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity:</strong></h3> Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. <p>Garner Health is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at <a href="mailto:talent@getgarner.com">talent@garnerhealth.com</a>.&nbsp;</p> </div></div>
