title: Analytics Engineer
full_description: <p>Scopely is seeking a highly motivated <strong>Analytics Engineer</strong> to join our Playgami team in <strong>Barcelona on a hybrid basis</strong>!&nbsp;</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Playgami is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The team strives to create the world’s best products for game production, operation, and insights. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>We collaborate with engineers, product teams, and analysts to create self-serve insight products that are fast, accurate, and elastic at a petabyte-scale</li> <li>We work across the full data product lifecycle: designing new tracking plans, developing data models, ELT pipelines, and self-serve insight products like Looker explores and dashboards</li> <li>We are stewards of data quality, ensuring that metrics are consistently reported across the catalog of data products</li> <li>We work with cutting-edge tech (BigQuery, dbt, Looker)</li> <li>We look forward and back, applying tools like BQML to predict player behavior</li> <li>We empathize with our game product teams and departments to make their daily work more enjoyable and their products more successful</li> <li>We often specialize in some part of the data stack and lifecycle but always aim to contribute across the full spectrum</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>You love solving puzzles</li> <li>You can translate needs into analytics tech</li> <li>You have experience with the modern data stack (tools like BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Airflow, GitHub, and command line-based workflows) or hunger to work in that domain</li> <li>You have first-class SQL skills and 3+ years of experience in a relevant role</li> <li>You understand the importance of data modeling, like knowing your Kimballs, your star schemas</li> <li>You value business context and improvement as much as you do first-class technical solutions</li> <li>You love collaboration and take pride in working in high-functioning teams</li> <li>You enjoy working in rapidly evolving, hyper-growth environments where every change presents an opportunity for us to grow</li> <li>You love having fun at work. Ping Pong/Mario Kart skills are a plus!</li> </ul> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! &nbsp; We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div>

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Data Engineering
full_description: <p>Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.</p> <p><strong>Job overview:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our Data Engineering team builds and operates the data platform and curated data products that power analytics, reporting, experimentation, and AI-driven insights across Product, Clinical, Commercial, Finance, and Operations. We are looking for an experienced <strong>Senior Engineering Manager, Data Engineering</strong> to lead our data engineering organization and help shape the future of Omada's enterprise data platform.</p> <p>As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead a team responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable data pipelines that serve as the trusted foundation for business intelligence, machine learning features, product analytics, operational reporting, experimentation, and advanced analytics.</p> <p>You will partner closely with Data Architects, Product Managers, Analytics, Data Science, Governance, and Software Engineering teams to define the technical strategy, execution roadmap, and operating model for Data Engineering.</p> <p>This role requires a strong balance of organizational leadership and technical depth. You will build high-performing engineering teams, drive platform strategy, and deliver reliable, scalable, and governed data capabilities that enable data-driven decision making across Omada.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish and execute a strategic roadmap for Omada's Data Engineering platform.</li> <li>Lead the delivery of scalable, reliable, and governed data products that enable analytics, reporting, experimentation, and AI-driven insights.</li> <li>Deliver trusted, reusable production datasets that power Applied Data Science, Product, Clinical, Commercial, Finance, Operations, and Executive analytics.</li> <li>Lead, develop and grow a high-performing Data Engineering organization through hiring, coaching, mentoring, and career development.</li> <li>Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.</li> <li>Empower teams to deliver high-impact solutions while maintaining a strong focus on quality and operational excellence.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Analytics, Data Science, Architecture, Governance, and Engineering leaders to define priorities and accelerate data-driven decision making across Omada.</li> <li>Translate business needs into scalable platform capabilities and trusted data products.</li> <li>Build strong relationships across the organization to drive alignment, transparency, and execution.</li> <li>Establish engineering excellence through improved data quality, reliability, observability, security, and platform performance.</li> <li>Define and monitor engineering and operational metrics to continuously improve platform health, cost efficiency, and developer productivity.</li> <li>Guide adoption of Improved reliability, quality, governance, and usability of enterprise data products.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership for architecture, platform evolution, scalable technologies, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards across Data Engineering.</li> <li>Expand self-service analytics through trusted and reusable data capabilities.</li> <li>Influence long-term technology strategy while partnering with engineering leaders across Omada to build a world-class data platform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale data platforms, analytics systems, or software platforms.</li> <li>5+ years of experience leading Data Engineering teams, with experience managing managers or multiple teams preferred.</li> <li>Proven ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing engineering organizations.</li> <li>Demonstrated success defining technical strategy, driving execution, and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives.</li> <li>Strong experience partnering with Product, Analytics, Data Science, and executive stakeholders.</li> <li>Deep experience designing and operating modern cloud-based analytics platforms, including data warehouses, lakehouses, ELT/ETL pipelines, and data processing systems.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data modeling, analytics architecture, semantic layers, and scalable data product design.</li> <li>Experience implementing data quality, observability, governance, metadata, lineage, and access control capabilities.</li> <li>Experience modernizing enterprise data platforms and driving adoption of modern data engineering practices.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI and machine learning data workflows is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of distributed data systems, cloud-native architectures, and software engineering practices.</li> <li>Experience with modern data technologies such as Databricks, Spark, Airflow, Kafka, Redshift, Snowflake, Python, SQL, Graph DB and AWS.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, testing frameworks, monitoring, and performance optimization.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern data governance platforms such as Unity Catalog, Collibra, or OpenMetadata is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Communication Skills:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust data architectures and engineering data models and pipelines. This role will play a critical part in ensuring the integrity, scalability, and performance of our data processing and products.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Data Architecture: Design, develop, and implement scalable, secure, and efficient data solutions that meet the needs of the organization.</li> <li>Data Modeling: Create and maintain logical and physical data models to support business intelligence, analytics, and reporting requirements.</li> <li>Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and data pipelines to ensure smooth and efficient data flow from various sources.</li> <li>Data Integration: Integrate diverse data sources, including APIs, databases, and third-party data, into a unified data platform.</li> <li>Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize the performance of data systems and pipelines to ensure low latency and high throughput.</li> <li>Data Quality and Governance: Implement data quality checks, validation processes, and governance frameworks to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data.</li> <li>Collaboration: Partner closely with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions that meet their needs.</li> <li>Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of data architectures, models, and pipelines for ongoing maintenance and knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Training: You'll train and collaborate with teammates effectively in data engineering best practices</li> <li>Technical Influence/Leadership: Recommends policy changes and establishes department-wide procedures. Uses extensive experience and knowledge to resolve complex problems.&nbsp;</li> <li>Monitor and manage production environment to deliver data within defined SLAs&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>How you can make an impact:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ll evaluate, benchmark, and improve the scalability, robustness, and performance of our data platform and applications</li> <li>You'll make significant contributions to the architecture and design of our data processing platform</li> <li>You’ll implement scalable, fault tolerant, and accurate ETLs frameworks.</li> <li>You’ll gather and process raw data at scale from diverse sources</li> <li>You’ll collaborate with product management, data scientists, analysts, and other engineers on technical vision, design, and planning</li> <li>You’ll implement and maintain a high level of data quality monitoring in our analytics &amp; ML ecosystem</li> <li>You’ll train and collaborate with teammates effectively in data engineering best practices</li> <li>You will be responsible for leading, documenting, and collaborating across teams for technical projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will love this job if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are passionate about building data-driven systems to enable Data Scientist, Data Analysts and AI/ML Engineers.</li> <li>You want to make a difference to empower digital healthcare through Data-driven decision making.</li> <li>You would like to learn how to build scalable, performant and reliable data pipelines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience building, maintaining, and orchestrating scalable data pipelines.&nbsp;</li> <li>3+ years of experience as a data engineer developing or maintaining integration with software such as Airflow or any Python-based data pipeline codebase.</li> <li>Experience applying a variety of integration patterns for different use cases.</li> <li>Experience in backend software development to contribute to distributed computing development and data technologies, with broad experience across systems, contexts, and ideas.</li> <li>Experience implementing data pipelines and improving the performance of ETL processes and related SQL queries.</li> <li>Experience in data modeling for OLTP and OLAP applications</li> <li>Experience with Cloud platforms such as Amazon AWS</li> <li>Familiarity with workflow management tools (Airflow preferred)</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud-based data warehouses (Amazon Redshift preferred)</li> <li>Exceptional Problem solving and analytical skills</li> <li>Experience working with sensitive data i.e. PHI / PII &amp; security best practices</li> <li>Familiarity with data governance practices and principles<strong>.</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).</li> <li>Proficiency in Analytical SQL (e.g. Analytics Queries, Distributed database queries) and experience working with massive parallel processing (MPP) databases (e.g., Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake).</li> <li>Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala.</li> <li>Knowledge of data modeling techniques (3NF)&nbsp; and tools (e.g., ER/Studio, ERwin).</li> <li>Software Engineering Mindset: Apply best practices to write elegant, maintainable code and understand automated testing concepts.</li> <li>Familiarity with business intelligence tools and environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Lambda, Iceberg or Delta Lake, Spark, or Kafka)</li> <li>Software engineering mindset and an ability to write elegant, maintainable code while following engineering best practices&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Communication Skills:</strong> Excellent communication and collaboration skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>Self-Directed:</strong> Leading projects and tasks effectively with cross functional stakeholders minimal guidance. You care about writing quality software and recognize that there are often many right answers. Ability to lead tasks and projects effectively.</p> <p><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar discipline preferred.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use:</strong> Ruby on Rails, Redshift, Athena, Postgres, SQL, Python, Apache Airflow, Appflow, S3, SNS, SQS, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS infrastructure, Lambda, Serverless, Tableau, Bugsnag, Datadog, GitLabCI, Cursor, OpenMetadata, Databricks</p> <p><strong>Bonus Points for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with NoSQL databases (e.g., document and graph databases)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience building internal frameworks or development productivity tools would be a big plus.</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building data infrastructure, frameworks and automation is a big plus.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience using Generative AI tools or technologies to improve engineering workflows, automation, analytics, or data platform capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus</li> <li>Equity grants</li> <li>Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Remote first work from home culture</li> <li>Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones</li> <li>Generous parental leave</li> <li>Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)</li> <li>401k retirement savings plan</li> <li>Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)</li> <li>Mental Health Support Solutions</li> <li>...and more!</li> </ul> <p>It takes a village to change health care. title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Data & Analytics
location: Atlanta; Boston; Charlotte; Chicago; Dallas; Los Angeles; New York; San Francisco
full_description: <h3><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE—where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value—supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.</p> <p>If you crave challenging work and are looking to&nbsp;grow, come solve&nbsp;complex&nbsp;issues alongside&nbsp;1,600+ finance &amp; technology experts in&nbsp;a supportive, collaborative&nbsp;environment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Backed&nbsp;by premier private equity firms and headquartered&nbsp;in New York with 11&nbsp;offices&nbsp;around&nbsp;the&nbsp;globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm&nbsp;looking&nbsp;for&nbsp;people&nbsp;who&nbsp;want&nbsp;to be part of building&nbsp;something&nbsp;great. Come make your mark.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Data &amp; Analytics</strong></h3> <p>Accordion's Data &amp; Analytics and Engineering team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.</p> <p>We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media &amp; Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.</p> <p>We deliver agentic workflows, and solutions designed to streamline processes and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.</p> <p>This role can be based in any of our US office locations and has the potential for client travel to be onsite. Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.</p> <p>This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role and You</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for a rare combination: a data scientist who thinks like a strategist and a strategist who speaks fluent data. You fall in love with problems and quantify complex situations using math. This isn't a role in building models in isolation—it's about transforming how a business makes decisions, identifying opportunities, and driving growth. You'll be an equal parts analyst, advisor, and architect of our strategic direction.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>You'll sit at the intersection of data and strategy, turning complex business challenges into quantifiable opportunities. This means diving deep into our numbers to surface insights that others miss, then translating those insights into actionable growth strategies. You'll work directly with leadership to shape major business decisions, from market expansion and pricing strategy to resource allocation and competitive positioning.</p> <p>Your day-to-day will involve identifying the right questions to ask before anyone else thinks of asking them, building the analytical frameworks to answer those questions, and presenting recommendations that fundamentally shift how we operate. You'll own strategic initiatives from conception through execution, measuring impact and iterating as you go. You’ll travel to client sites as needed, leading AI assessment and Strategy Engagements.</p> <h3><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h3> <p><strong>The Strategic Mindset:</strong> You naturally think several moves ahead. You understand business models, competitive dynamics, and growth levers. You can walk into a room with executives and hold your own in discussions about market strategy, unit economics, and long-term planning. You've seen how businesses succeed and fail, and you know how to spot the difference.</p> <p><strong>The Technical Depth:</strong> You're genuinely strong in quantitative methods—statistics, predictive modeling, optimization, and experimental design. You can wrangle messy data, build robust analyses, and know when a sophisticated model is needed versus when a simple calculation will do. Python, R, and SQL are still in your wheelhouse.</p> <p><strong>The Translation Layer: </strong>You can explain complex analytical concepts to non-technical stakeholders without dumbing them down. You know how to build conviction around data-driven recommendations and can defend your methodology when challenged. You make the quantitative accessible and actionable.</p> <p><strong>The Business Acumen:</strong> You understand P&amp;Ls, growth metrics, customer economics, and operational levers. You've worked closely enough with business teams to know what keeps them up at night and how your analyses can help them sleep better.</p> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in data science, engineering or data engineering roles with increasing strategic responsibility</li> <li>Strong foundation in data platforms, data science, statistics, machine learning, and quantitative analysis</li> <li>Additional considering will be given to engineers who have a background in data but have yet to work deeply with LLM enabled workflows</li> <li>Experience working directly with business leaders to convey options and tradeoffs to define solution design and scope.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience influencing business strategy through data</li> <li>Track record of identifying and driving growth opportunities</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with technical and executive audiences</li> <li>Proficiency in modern data science tools and languages</li> <li>Understanding of business finance and growth frameworks</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Ideal Background</strong></h3> <p>You might come from management consulting or technical consulting with deep analytical chops, a curiosity for working on business problems, strategic roles at high-growth companies, corporate strategy teams with hands-on data work, or data science roles where you've grown into strategic advisory. What matters most is that you've successfully used data to change how businesses operate and grow.</p> <h3><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h3> <p>In your first year, you'll have identified three major strategic opportunities we weren't seeing before, built the analytical infrastructure to evaluate them rigorously, and driven at least one to implementation with measurable business impact. You'll have become a trusted advisor to leadership and the person they turn to when facing the company's thorniest strategic questions.</p> <p>The annual salary for this role ranges from: $145,000 to $240,000 USD + benefits + bonus. Actual compensation packages are determined by evaluating a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to geographic location, skill set, years and depth of experience, education, certifications, cost of labor and internal equity.</p> <p>Accordion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.&nbsp; We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.</p> <p>Please note that as per Accordion policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening and in alignment with our inclusive diversity values. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that Accordion will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-NG1</span></p>

Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.</p> <p>This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.</p> <h3><strong>Overview</strong></h3> <p>Accordion is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to embed directly with client finance teams and build AI-powered agents and automated workflows that transform how organizations interact with their Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and Corporate Performance Management (CPM) systems. intersection of applied AI, financial domain expertise, and client delivery—understanding the nuances of each client’s financial architecture, identifying high-value automation opportunities, and movements, close reporting agents that generate narrative commentary and executive summaries, and forecasting co-pilots that assist FP&amp;A teams with scenario modeling and assumption validation.</li> <li>Build integrations between AI agents and existing EPM/CPM platforms (e.g., Oracle EPM Cloud, OneStream, Anaplan, Planful, Workday Adaptive Planning) to read from and write back to the client’s system of record.</li> <li>Develop automated data reconciliation and validation workflows that reduce manual effort during period-end close, intercompany eliminations, and management reporting cycles.</li> <li>Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, tool-use patterns, and multi-step agent architectures that ground AI outputs in the client’s actual financial data and business context.</li> </ul> <h4>Client Discovery and Solution Design</h4> <ul> <li>Embed with client finance, FP&amp;A, and accounting teams to deeply understand their existing EPM/CPM environment, data flows, reporting cadences, and pain points.</li> <li>Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities where AI agents and automation can eliminate manual, repetitive work—particularly in variance commentary, flux analysis, board reporting, cash flow forecasting, and data quality assurance.</li> <li>Translate business requirements into technical solution architectures, defining agent capabilities, data source integrations, guardrails, and success metrics in collaboration with client stakeholders.</li> <li>Manage the full lifecycle of agent development on-site—from rapid prototyping and stakeholder demos through iteration, testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring.</li> </ul> <h4>Platform and Product Thinking</h4> <ul> <li>Contribute to Accordion’s reusable agent framework and shared component library, abstracting patterns from client engagements into configurable, scalable building blocks for future deployments.</li> <li>Stay current on advances in large language models, agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Anthropic tool use), and emerging best practices for building reliable, auditable AI systems in financial contexts.</li> <li>Establish and enforce quality standards for AI outputs in financial workflows, including accuracy validation, hallucination mitigation, audit trail generation, and appropriate human-in-the-loop checkpoints.</li> <li>Document solution architectures, integration patterns, and deployment playbooks to accelerate future client engagements and enable knowledge transfer across the team.</li> </ul> <h3>Required Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, or a related field.</li> <li>3+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on building applications powered by large language models, AI agents, or intelligent automation.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Python and experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Anthropic API, OpenAI API) and related tooling (vector databases, embedding models, prompt engineering).</li> <li>Working knowledge of financial processes including budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, close management, variance analysis, and management reporting.</li> <li>Solid SQL skills and experience integrating with APIs, data warehouses, ERPs, and financial systems to source and transform data for AI workflows.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with CFOs, controllers, and FP&amp;A leaders—translating their needs into technical solutions and demonstrating value through rapid iteration.</li> <li>Willingness to travel to client sites as needed (up to 50–80%, depending on engagement).</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Understanding of financial planning and reporting systems (Oracle EPM Cloud, OneStream, Anaplan, Planful, Workday Adaptive Planning)</li> <li>Experience in consulting or professional services.</li> <li>Familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle EBS, Microsoft Dynamics) and how financial data flows from transactional systems into EPM/CPM platforms.</li> <li>Experience building production AI systems with appropriate guardrails for regulated or audit-sensitive environments, including explainability, traceability, and human-in-the-loop review patterns.</li> <li>Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) and comfort deploying and monitoring agent-based applications in production environments.</li> <li>Background in financial data modeling, multidimensional databases, or business intelligence tooling.</li> </ul> <h3>Example Agent Use Cases</h3> <p>The following are from the EPM system, identifies material variances, drills into driver-level detail, and generates narrative explanations ready for management review.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="222"> <p>Close Reporting Agent</p> </td> <td width="396"> <p>Monitors close task completion, assembles period-end financial packages, generates board-ready commentary, and flags anomalies or incomplete items to the title: Forward Deployed Engineering, Portworx
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p> <p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p> <p>Portworx is building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to embed directly with our most strategic customers during their highest-stakes Kubernetes storage deployments. You'll be the technical bridge between complex customer infrastructure and Portworx itself: designing production architectures, unblocking critical rollouts, and turning field experience into structured product feedback that shapes our roadmap.</p> <p>This is not a support role and not a pure pre-sales role. You'll own engagements end-to-end: from solution validation before you ever get on a plane, through architecture design, production stabilization, and a clean handoff. You'll leave behind documentation and automation that make the next customer's journey faster.</p> <p>Just as important as the technical delivery: this is a relationship-building role. You'll work directly with senior technical leaders (Directors and VPs of Infrastructure and Platform Engineering), and the goal is to become a trusted advisor on their broader platform strategy, not just their Portworx footprint. Done well, this role gives Portworx (and Pure) visibility and influence across the customer's whole platform organization.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Where possible - reproduce a customer's target environment, whether on-prem or cloud/CaaS, in a lab and validate the proposed solution and architecture pattern <em>before</em> traveling on-site, so on-site time is spent building trust and executing a proven design</li> <li>Design and validate production Portworx architectures for complex, high-stakes customer environments (multi-cluster, DR, KubeVirt VM migration, regulated/air-gapped deployments, cloud-native CaaS platforms)</li> <li>Lead hands-on implementation: storage class design, KVDB topology, snapshot/backup policy, async/sync replication, capacity and sizing models</li> <li>Run failure-mode and performance validation before go-live (node/AZ loss, network partition, upgrade paths)</li> <li>Troubleshoot production-blocking issues in real time during critical rollouts</li> <li>Author runbooks, reference architectures, and automation that become reusable IP across engagements</li> <li>Upskill customer platform teams so they can operate independently post-handoff</li> <li>Build and sustain relationships with senior technical leaders (Directors/VPs of Infrastructure and Platform Engineering) by understanding and helping shape their broader platform strategy, not just their Portworx deployment</li> <li>Conduct periodic visits to established, already-live accounts to maintain the relationship, stay current on their evolving platform needs, and surface expansion opportunities. Many customers start small and grow, and this is how that growth gets found and won</li> <li>Develop enough fluency in the customer's development environment and workflows to speak credibly to their CaaS platform needs as a whole</li> <li>Log and structure field feedback (bugs, feature gaps, roadmap signal) for a recurring feedback loop with Product and Engineering</li> <li>Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to triage which engagements warrant FDE involvement</li> <li>We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in infrastructure/platform engineering, SRE, or field/solutions engineering roles; prior "forward deployed," field engineering, or professional services experience a plus</li> <li>Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise (CKA/CKS or equivalent production experience). You've run clusters in production, not just in a lab</li> <li>Strong understanding of enterprise storage infrastructure: SAN/NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NVMe/TCP, multipath (dm-multipath), LVM</li> <li>Solid Linux systems administration background</li> <li>Comfort working across <strong>both on-prem and cloud/CaaS deployment models</strong>. You shouldn't have a blind spot on either side</li> <li>Working understanding of customer development environments (CI/CD, application deployment patterns, dev/test workflows) sufficient to reason about CaaS platform needs beyond just the storage layer</li> <li>Experience with virtualization and migration patterns (VMware, KubeVirt) a strong plus</li> <li>Prior experience with Portworx, other CSI-based storage platforms, or enterprise storage vendors (Pure Storage, NetApp, Dell, etc.) is highly valued</li> <li>Genuine relationship-building instincts. This role requires earning trust with senior technical leaders over time, not just closing out a project; comfort running both a technical whiteboard session and a live war-room call, and staying in touch between fires</li> <li>Strong technical writing skills. The artifacts you leave behind are as important as the fix you made</li> </ul> <p>#LI-ONSITE</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.</em></p></div><div class="title">The annual base salary range is: </div><div class="pay-range"><span>$208,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$305,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li> <li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li> </ul> <p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://purebenefits.com">purebenefits.com</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p> <p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a href="mailto:TA-Ops@purestorage.com">TA-Ops@purestorage.com</a> if you’re invited to an interview.</p> <p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p> <p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p> <p>Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.</p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Join us and bring your best.</strong></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Bring your bold.</strong></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Pure and simple.</strong></p></div>

ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, low-ego environment where data makes a difference for patients.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Primary workflows&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Lead the development and best practices of version control, documentation, and coding data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">7+ years post-internship hands-on experience in a data engineering, analytics engineering, or data science role in the pharmaceutical industry&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Proficient in Python, R, SQL, with experience operationalizing analytics at data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Experience in applying AI to streamline or augment data workflows&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Experience working with patient-level data or in regulated environments (e.g., HIPAA,&nbsp;GxP, FDA) preferred&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and Reasonable&nbsp;accommodations&nbsp;may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Annualized Base Salary</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$145,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$165,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits<br><br></strong>At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and <em>their</em> people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. &nbsp;We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&amp;D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let’s achieve the impossible together!&nbsp;<br><strong><br>Company Overview</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.&nbsp; At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.&nbsp; Our core Values of <strong>Trust</strong>, <strong>Ownership</strong>, <strong>Curiosity</strong> and <strong>Results</strong> are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.<br><br><strong>Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion</strong><br>Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE<sup>®</sup> to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.<br><br><strong>Attention: Job Scam Alert</strong><br>Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. All unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any Praxis employee in any form or method will be deemed to be the property of Praxis, and Praxis explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruitment agency.</p></div>

title: Advanced Cyber Security Analytics Engineer
full_description: <p><strong>**ACTIVE TS/SCI SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIRED**</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the Lead of Focused Operations, under the Branch Chief of Defensive Cyber Operations, you will be tasked with developing and maintaining defensive countermeasures for the enterprise. Working within a Fusion model, will collaborate with other teams within Focused Operations with the distinct task of proactively preventing a successful compromise and eradicating persistent adversaries already in the enterprise.&nbsp; This will be done through various means such as reviewing future and past intelligence reports, reviewing incident reports, through regular Purple Teaming exercises, and continuously validating Defensive Countermeasures already deployed.</p> <p><strong>More about your role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyzes trends and patterns of data on NGA networks to identify and predict previously undiscovered events and incidents and develop or tune rules/signatures/scripts as needed.</li> <li>Coordinates with Defensive Cyber Operations and Focused Operations to develop or tune rules/signatures/scripts.</li> <li>Coordinates with other Cybersecurity Operations Services to investigate and obtain information about potential sources of compromise on enterprise systems and develop or tune rules/signatures/scripts as needed.</li> <li>Correlates and analyzes precursors to incidents and develop or tune rules/signatures/scripts as needed.</li> <li>Will collaborate with the Cyber Data Analytics team to achieve SIEM alert efficiency though evaluation of valid alerts and false positives, and develop or tune rules/signatures/scripts as needed</li> <li>Work with the Cyber Incident Response Team by assessing ongoing incident activity to predict adversary responses and locations of compromise to assist with triage.</li> <li>Documents all work in the authorized ticketing system with a sufficient level of detail to ensure all stakeholders can systematically reconstruct the analysis;</li> <li>Provide input to reoccurring meetings and briefings as required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be a US Citizen with an Active TS/SCI.</li> <li>8+ years of related advanced cyber security analytics work experience.</li> <li>Must have a certification that is compliant with DoD 8140.01 and DoD 8570.01-M IAT Level III and CSSP Analyst.</li> <li>Experience with data mining or building queries in a SIEM.</li> <li>Strong understanding of signature development and tuning.</li> <li>Strong understanding of network protocols and analysis with protocol analyzers.</li> <li>Knowledge of static file signatures, i.e. "magic numbers" and how it applies to developing countermeasures for files in transit and that reside locally on a host.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of regular expressions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comfortable in a hex editor.</li> <li>Ability to write python/bash/powershell scripts.</li> <li>Ability to analyze each use case, as it pertains to detection logic, and identify the corresponding capability.</li> <li>Good understanding of Purple Team Tactics.</li> <li>Familiarity with security in a cloud environment and how it applies to visibility gaps, data lakes and data mining.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional Information</strong></p> <ul> <li>All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.</li> <li>Compensation is unique to each candidate and relative to the skills and experience they bring to the position. The salary range for this position is typically $90-$100k. This does not guarantee a specific salary as compensation is based upon multiple factors such as education, experience, certifications, and other requirements, and may fall outside of the above-stated range.</li> <li>Highlights of our benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Accrued PTO, STD/LTD/Life Insurance, Referral Bonuses, professional development reimbursement, and more!</li> </ul> <p><em>D2 Technical Services is committed to a merit-based recruitment process and encourages applications from all qualified individuals.&nbsp; As a Veteran-Owned Small Business, we particularly welcome applications from veterans who have the requisite skills and experience.&nbsp; Job applicants that are interested in one of our openings and may require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, should contact us to request an accommodation.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

title: Quantitative Data Engineer
full_description: <p>Qube Research &amp; Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset, which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.</p> <p>We are looking for a Quantitative Data Engineer to join the Data Search &amp; Analytics team. In this role, you will work with the Research and Trading desks to ensure the successful leveraging of data at the firm.</p> <p><strong>Your future role within QRT</strong></p> <p>This team is integral to the firm’s success. As such, your responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Collaborating with Quantitative Researchers and Traders to design datasets that drive systematic strategies and discretionary trading decisions.</li> <li>Working within our framework to extract, clean, and aggregate data from a wide range of raw sources and formats ensuring robust data extraction processes</li> <li>Managing end-to-end process of onboarding new datasets</li> <li>Proactively solving data related problems to minimise time to production</li> <li>Innovating and experimenting with novel data extraction methods to enhance the firm’s data onboarding toolkit</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your present skillset</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer (or similar position) working with financial data; experience in a buy-side quantitative finance role is advantageous</li> <li>Rigorous about correctness: able to critically assess code and data quality, regardless of origin</li> <li>Experience using AI-powered development tools to accelerate engineering tasks and improve productivity</li> <li>Advanced programming experience in Python, including proficiency with data handling libraries such as Pandas, Polars and NumPy</li> <li>Familiarity with SQL and relational databases</li> <li>Demonstrable interest in financial markets and the application of data in its analysis and understanding</li> <li>Experience working with both traditional and alternative financial datasets</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with all stakeholders, including researchers, traders, engineers, management, and external vendors</li> <li>Experience creating documentation and providing direct support to help stakeholders understand and use complex datasets quickly</li> <li>Ability to work in a high-performance, high-velocity environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.</em></p>

title: Senior Data Engineer
full_description: <p>Qube Research &amp; Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology and trading expertise has shaped QRT’s collaborative mindset which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.</p> <p><strong></strong></p> <div><strong>Your future role within QRT:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate high-throughput distributed data systems that power quantitative research and production trading workflows.</li> <li>Develop production-grade Python services and pipelines to acquire, process, validate, and distribute large volumes of market and reference data.</li> <li>Build systems supporting both large-scale historical data processing and time-critical overnight pipelines on the path to trading.</li> <li>Design scalable processing architectures that partition work across QRT’s on-premises compute infrastructure and AWS.</li> <li>Build comprehensive observability and operational tooling to monitor data freshness, completeness, quality, and pipeline health.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with quantitative researchers, trading teams, software engineers, and infrastructure teams to onboard new datasets and improve research productivity.</li> <li>Take ownership of systems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation through deployment, production operation, and incident resolution.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Your present skillset:</strong></div> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade data platforms, distributed systems, or large-scale data-processing applications.</li> <li>Strong Python software engineering experience, including the design of maintainable, tested, and performance-conscious production applications.</li> <li>Strong understanding of distributed processing concepts such as partitioning, parallelism, concurrency, fault tolerance, idempotency, and failure recovery.</li> <li>Experience designing systems that process large data volumes with demanding throughput or completion-time requirements.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow.</li> <li>Experience with AWS services including S3, EC2, AWS Batch, IAM, CloudWatch, and cloud SDKs.</li> <li>Experience operating business-critical pipelines and diagnosing data, performance, and reliability issues in production.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across research, trading, engineering, and infrastructure teams.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Nice to have:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience building market-data platforms or other high-throughput financial data systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of non-equity asset classes such as futures, fixed income, commodities, or FX.</li> <li>Experience with time-sensitive overnight processing or systems operating on the path to production trading.</li> <li>Familiarity with Apache Parquet, Apache Arrow, or distributed processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or Dask.</li> <li>Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.</li> <li>C++ development experience.</li> <li>Experience working in high-performance computing or hybrid cloud environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong></strong></p> <p>QRT is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Data Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">About Hopscotch Primary Care</span></h2> <p>At Hopscotch Primary Care, we believe great healthcare should be accessible to all people across all communities.&nbsp; Today, almost 20% of Americans live in a rural community, yet only 11% of physicians practice in those same communities.&nbsp; We are on a mission to transform healthcare in rural America.&nbsp; We provide high-quality primary care tailored to meet the needs of our patients through our robust care model and comprehensive care team, delivering care in our clinics, and across settings, and wrapping resources around the patients who need them most.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Our patients and the care teams who serve them sit at the center of everything we do at Hopscotch.&nbsp; Hopscotch Primary Care takes a team approach to serve patient needs and provide the best care possible.&nbsp; Our goal is to provide the care each of us would want for ourselves or for our family members, in the right setting, and at the right time.&nbsp;</p> <p>Today, we are serving thousands of patients in our value-based care model and the number is growing every day.&nbsp; If you want to bring your experience, skill and passion to make a lasting impact in healthcare, we’d like to meet you.&nbsp;</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>ABOUT THE ROLE</h3> <p>We are looking for a&nbsp;<strong>Senior Data Engineer&nbsp;</strong>(remote) to own and evolve the backbone of our data platform. This role is for a hands-on builder who thrives at the intersection of data engineering, software architecture, and pragmatic problem solving. You’ll design and scale the systems that ensure our data is trustworthy, accessible, and ready to power everything from day-to-day operations to next-generation AI applications. While this is not a people manager role, you will serve as a technical leader on the team, raising the bar on engineering fundamentals and helping shape the long-term direction of our data ecosystem. You will be part of a skilled, passionate, and collaborative team committed to working together to realize Hopscotch’s ambitious and important vision.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <h3>RESPONSIBILITIES &nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li> <ul> <li><strong>Architect, build, and maintain</strong> our data model, data pipelines, and data access layer that support our care delivery, operations, and analytics in collaboration with the data platform team.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Own the end-to-end lifecycle&nbsp;</strong>of data pipelines that enable key business operations, support third-party integrations, and ensure timely, accurate data delivery across internal and external platforms.</li> <li><strong>Ensure data quality &amp; governance</strong>: implement practices that make our data trustworthy and usable for all stakeholders, from clinicians to operators.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Monitor and optimize data infrastructure</strong>: troubleshoot issues, improve system performance, and drive efficiency through automation and process enhancements.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Lead with technical depth</strong>: review code and set engineering best practices across the team.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Think big picture</strong>: design today’s infrastructure with tomorrow’s needs in mind, laying the foundation for high quality workflow enhancements as well as advanced analytics and AI.</li> <li><strong>Contribute where business needs are highest:</strong> flex across the stack, from backend data engineering to occasional contributions in frontend applications that bring data to life</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with cross-functional teams</strong>: work with product managers, analytics, operations, and care delivery stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data solutions.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3>ABOUT YOU</h3> <p>You would be a great fit for this position if you:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Have an ownership mentality; take high-level business and technical challenges, frame them into actionable work, and deliver solutions with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Are customer-focused with a passion for serving patients and providers who make healthcare possible</li> <li>Are results-driven, focusing time and resources against the most important priorities</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity and bring a structured, proactive approach to executing</li> <li>Energized by building relationships and finding creative solutions</li> <li>Articulate and succinct with communication about complex concepts, both verbally and in writing</li> </ul> <p>From a cultural perspective, you are:</p> <ul> <li>Agile, yet thoughtful, and can work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment · Constantly seeking ways to simplify and improve how things are done, bringing a positive attitude to challenges</li> <li>Always looking for ways to modernize our stack, testing out the limits of new technologies, and applying new technologies to solve problems where applicable</li> <li>Accountable, holding yourself, and others, to a high standard</li> <li>Supportive of teammates and aim to share knowledge with others</li> <li>Willing to roll up your sleeves to get work done and collaborate effectively with people of all backgrounds</li> </ul> <h3>ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field</li> <li>4+ years of professional experience in data engineering and software architecture shipping production level code, preferably in healthcare services</li> <li>Strong programming skills (Python, Pyspark, or similar) with proven experience in building and scaling reusable, testable, and maintainable data pipelines</li> <li>Experience designing and optimizing data models, warehouses, and/or lakehouses</li> <li>Familiarity with modern data platforms and cloud ecosystems (ex. Palantir Foundry, DBT, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS/GCP/Azure).</li> <li>Track record of ensuring data quality, governance, and reliability</li> <li>Ability to balance high-level architecture with tactical execution</li> </ul> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">In accordance with the Illinois Pay Transparency Act, we’re providing the full salary range for this position. Actual compensation will be determined based on location, relevant experience and qualifications. Most offers will fall within a portion of the listed range. </span>This position has a salary range of <span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">$140,000-170,000 </span>annually,<em> </em>based on location, relevant experience and qualifications. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:</p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Paid holidays + PTO</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">Company sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurance for you + your family</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">FREE short-term and long-term disability insurance</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">FREE $100k life insurance policy</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">401k plan with 4% company match + no vesting period</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">$720 - $1,000 added to employee Health Savings Account annually for eligible health plans</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal">And more!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335557856&quot;:16777215,&quot;335559740&quot;:300}">&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Hopscotch Primary Care, we embrace diversity, invest in a culture of inclusion and positivity and encourage all to apply to join our team.&nbsp; You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering

Through our design-once, build-many model, we're accelerating the deployment of safe, reliable, and affordable nuclear energy.</p> <p><strong>We operate with an AI-first mindset.</strong>&nbsp;Every employee is expected to leverage AI, technology, and the Nuclear Operating System (NOS) as integral components of their role to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We expect every team member to continuously identify opportunities to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NOS as a strategic operating capability that enables The Nuclear Company to scale with excellence.</p> <p><strong>We hire people who are driven by purpose, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building what has never been built before.</strong> Our team combines intellectual curiosity with high agency, embraces candid feedback and continuous learning, and holds themselves and others to exceptional standards. Our values, <strong>Transparency, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappy, and Tenacity, </strong>guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions every day. They are not words on a wall; they are the standard by which we operate.
