title: Senior Data Engineer II, AI Native
full_description: <h3>About Life360</h3> <p>Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.&nbsp;</p> <p>Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).&nbsp;</p> <p>Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit <a href="http://life360.com/">life360.com</a>.</p> <p><strong><em>Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.</em></strong></p> <h3>We are AI Native</h3> <p>We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.</p> <p>Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>The Data &amp; Analytics team is building Life360's next-generation data platform — powering real-time decision-making, experimentation, ML, and large-scale analytics. We operate at significant scale and complexity in a high-ambiguity environment, and we expect engineers to own problems, drive clarity, and raise the bar across the org.<br><br></p> <p>We're looking for a high-intensity engineer who wants to envision, design, and build high-impact data products with cutting-edge tools — all while keeping our members ahead of the metrics. You'll become the go-to person for data products across the business, joining a collaborative team that communicates openly, celebrates wins together, and is committed to helping everyone do their best work.</p> <h3>About the Job</h3> <p>At Life360, we collect a lot of data: tens of billions of unique location points, tens of billions of user actions, billions of miles driven every single month, and so much more. As a Senior Data Engineer II, you will enhance and maintain our data processing and storage pipelines for a robust and secure data lakehouse. We're looking for a strong engineering background — and just as important, a genuine desire to take ownership and make our data systems world class.<br><br>The US-based salary range for this position is $148,000 to $216,500. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:</p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain scalable, distributed data pipelines and systems — from ingestion through ELT to storage — supporting streaming and batch processing for real-time analytics, ML, and experimentation.</li> <li>Automate, test, and harden data workflows to ensure reliability at scale.</li> <li>Architect logical and physical data models that meet evolving business needs.</li> <li>Build and maintain features for ML models.</li> <li>Collaborate with product, analytics, and data science teams to turn data into value.</li> </ul> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience working with high volume data infrastructure.</li> <li>Deep expertise with a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse platform (Databricks preferred; Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar also considered) on a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).</li> <li>Proficient in Python and SQL, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries.</li> <li>Must have hands-on experience with dbt, ownership of dbt models.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale data processing using Spark and/or Presto/Trino.</li> <li>Strong grasp of data modeling, partitioning strategies, storage formats, and analytical workload optimization.</li> <li>Hands-on experience leveraging LLMs for code generation, analysis, and related work — including reviewing AI-generated output with a close eye on quality, standards, and testing, and owning it as your own.</li> <li>Experience with modern data engineering tooling — orchestration (Airflow, Databricks Workflows), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, DABs).</li> <li>BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering (Computer, Electrical, or Software), or a related quantitative field.</li> </ul> <p><br>AI-Native Expectations</p> <ul> <li>The team leverages LLMs to support code generation, analysis, and other use cases. Your experience with AI / LLM usage should include managing code generation with a close eye on quality, standards, and testing — owning the outputs as your own. Your work with and ability to leverage these tools will drive your velocity and ability to effectively work within our environment.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to Have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience working with an experimentation framework.</li> <li>Experience designing and maintaining real-time streaming architectures.</li> </ul> <h3>Our Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)</li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>401(k) plan with company matching program</li> <li>Mental Wellness Program &amp; Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being</li> <li>Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development programs</li> <li>Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment</li> <li>Free Life360 Platinum Membership Tile trackers</li> </ul> <h3>Life360 Values</h3> <p>Our company’s mission driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.&nbsp;</li> <li>Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.</li> <li>Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.&nbsp;</li> <li>High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>Our Commitment to Diversity</h3> <p>We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.</p> <p><em>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.&nbsp;&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.</em><strong><em> </em></strong><em>Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>#LI-Remote</strong></p>

title: Senior Data Engineer
full_description: <h2 style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Senior Data Engineer&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span></h2> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141); font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>Prolific</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141); font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>The role</em></span></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help build scalable data solutions that serve teams across the business – from data scientists and analysts to AI engineers and product teams. You'll contribute to both the underlying platform and the way data is used in our products, working in a modern, cloud native environment where privacy, security, and good data practices are part of how we build.</p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141); font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>What you’ll bring to the role</em></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Expertise:</strong> 3+ years building and shipping production grade data systems, with strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language (Java, Scala etc.)</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure</strong> - ideally some exposure to Terraform, Kubernetes, or similar IaC and container orchestration tools. We don't expect deep expertise in all of these, but comfort working in this kind of environment matters.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing data APIs or services</strong> that expose data to applications, or a strong interest in working across the analytical/operational boundary.</li> <li><strong>A thoughtful approach to data quality, privacy, and security</strong> - you understand that how data is used is as important as how it's moved.</li> <li><strong>Strong collaboration skills</strong> and comfort working across teams with different priorities — engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, product.</li> <li><strong>A pragmatic, curious mindset</strong> - you enjoy keeping up with the field and know when to reach for a new tool versus when to stick with what works.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline Management:</strong> Hands on experience with data pipeline tools (Airflow, dbt) and strong ability to optimise for performance and reliability.</li> <li><strong>Quality Focus:</strong> Commitment to continuously improving product quality, security, and performance through rigorous testing and code reviews.</li> <li><strong>Documentation:</strong> Meticulous approach to creating and maintaining architecture and systems documentation.</li> <li><strong>Problem-Solving:</strong> Exceptional analytical skills to troubleshoot complex data issues and implement effective solutions.</li> <li><strong>Independence: </strong>Capability to ship medium features independently while contributing to the team's overall objectives.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);">What you’ll be doing in the role</span>&nbsp;</em></span></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain data pipelines that power analytics, ML workloads, and product-facing applications - from internal databases, SaaS sources, and streaming systems through to the teams and services that consume them.</li> <li>Evolve our data platform alongside cloud platform engineers, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes-based deployments (Argo) to keep the platform scalable, reliable, and self-serve.</li> <li>System Architecture: Design and implement scalable data infrastructure that accommodates our growing data volume and complexity.</li> <li>Develop data services and APIs that expose trusted data to product applications, bridging analytical and operational systems.</li> <li>Own data quality and observability, putting monitoring, testing, and alerting in place so issues are caught early and trust in the data stays high.</li> <li>Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand their data needs and design the right solutions – not just the quickest ones.</li> <li>Uphold strong data privacy, security, and compliance practices in everything you build, particularly where data flows into product-facing contexts.</li> <li>Technical Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of data flows, models, and systems for knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Security and Compliance: Ensure all data systems adhere to security best practices and compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141); font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>Why Prolific is a great place to work</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141); font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>Links to more information on Prolific</em></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/dbc97f2b3ff24f1bb6fa834a2c9c3283?v=4f874e88e46a4f54afd8bf62f1db19ed&amp;p=9f2c1de05dfa43338d48c20362bfead1&amp;pm=c">Benefits&nbsp;</a></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/dbc97f2b3ff24f1bb6fa834a2c9c3283?v=4f874e88e46a4f54afd8bf62f1db19ed">External Handbook</a>&nbsp;</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><a href="https://www.prolific.com/">Website&nbsp;</a></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@JoinProlific">Youtube</a>&nbsp;</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141); font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>Privacy Statement</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Data Engineer (DE) at Planet, you will own, architect and build production, enterprise-scale data ecosystems using modern cloud technologies, to power mission-critical, customer-facing products. You will act as a strategic partner to cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex requirements into robust, scalable solutions. You will build and design data solutions end to end: from high-level architecture and implementation to CI/CD, orchestration automated QA, and seamless integration into production systems. You’ll be a senior member of the Data Team within the Software Engineering organization, which is made up of data scientists, engineers and analysts working on similar tasks across Planet domains.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your scope will focus on the architecture and evolution of data systems supporting our global monitoring products. These products are vital offerings designed to provide persistent, high-cadence monitoring and active intelligence, particularly for our Defence and Intelligence customers. You will collaborate closely with leadership across Product and Engineering to ensure some of our most sophisticated customers have the data required for global security and rapid decision-making. This role is ideal for an expert data engineer looking to lead the evolution of complex systems and deliver transformative technology to the defense sector. The ideal candidate is an independent operator who thrives in a dynamic, global environment and is deeply passionate about Planet’s mission and national security solutions.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Washington DC or Denver CO office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You'll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Architect and oversee robust, high-availability data pipelines while establishing the standards for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing existing ecosystems.</li> <li>Collaborate with global product, commercial and technical leadership.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.</li> <li>Expertise in designing and implementing end-to-end data architectures for global-scale, customer-facing solutions, with a focus on data integrity and efficiency.</li> <li>Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL for complex ETL/ELT pipeline construction, including event-driven data architectures.</li> <li>Proactive, self-starter mindset with the ability to lead problem-solving initiatives in a dynamic, high-stakes environment.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical execution and high-level business requirements.</li> <li>Deep experience in maintaining enterprise-grade, peer-reviewed codebases and advanced CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI, Docker, and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Significant experience with cloud-native architectures (GCP preferred).</li> <li>Experience tuning storage formats such as Parquet to ensure sub-second query performance for consumers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience using modern data tooling (e.g. dbt) for pipeline inputs to customer-facing production systems.</li> <li>Experience leveraging Infrastructure as Code tooling (e.g. Terraform) to manage cloud architecture.</li> <li>Experience architecting solutions for geospatial datasets.</li> <li>Knowledge of earth observation and/or satellite operation concepts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>October 1, 2026 by 11:59p / 23:59 CET (Central European Time)</p> <p><strong>EAR/ITAR title: Data Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We&nbsp;take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination&nbsp;and drive&nbsp;to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.</span></p></div><p><strong>Step Into the Multiverse: Your Next Adventure Starts Here </strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Wizards of the Coast, we harness the power of imagination and connection to create unforgettable experiences. We create entertainment that inspires creativity, sparks passion, forges friendships, and fosters communities around the globe. In every pursuit our mission is to inspire a lifetime love of games. Whether it's through the strategic depth of Magic: The Gathering®, the rich storytelling of Dungeons &amp; Dragons®, or our AAA digital game studios, we build worlds that bring people together, spark creativity, and fuel adventure. As we continue to grow and explore new realms, we're seeking passionate, curious, and innovative minds to join the adventure.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are growing our&nbsp;Enterprise Data &amp; Engineering team!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Do you have a passion for data and a drive to build things that matter? We’re looking for a&nbsp;Data Engineer to join our high-visibility Enterprise Data &amp; Engineering team, helping Hasbro better reach consumers with compelling products and entertainment. This is a great opportunity for an emerging engineer eager to grow their skills and make a real impact in a collaborative, data-driven environment.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of data pipelines, transformations, and analytics infrastructure that power decision-making across the business. You’ll work alongside senior engineers, data scientists, and analysts, gaining hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms and growing into the kind of engineer who can one day lead complex, enterprise-scale data initiatives.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We value diverse perspectives and welcome candidates who bring different experiences and approaches to solving data challenges.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows that move and transform data across cloud platforms including Azure and AWS.</li> <li>Write and tune complex SQL queries to support analytics, reporting, and data modeling needs.</li> <li>Participate in the design and implementation of data engineering infrastructure, learning standards from senior engineers and technical leads.</li> <li>Support data quality monitoring and validation efforts, helping to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data products.</li> <li>Contribute to code reviews, testing, and documentation as part of a culture of engineering excellence.</li> <li>Collaborate with data scientists, analytics engineers, and business partners to understand data needs and deliver scalable solutions.</li> <li>Assist in the integration of AI and machine learning solutions into data workflows to improve efficiency and elevate the consumer experience.</li> <li>Develop familiarity with data governance principles, including metadata management and data lineage.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>1–3 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated skills through internships, academic projects, or self-directed work.</li> <li>Solid foundation in SQL; experience writing queries to extract, transform, and analyze data.</li> <li>Exposure to at least one scripting language (Python preferred) for data manipulation, automation, or pipeline development.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud-based data ecosystems (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and a curiosity to deepen that knowledge.</li> <li>Understanding of core data engineering concepts: ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehousing, and batch processing.</li> <li>Awareness of or interest in tools like DBT, Databricks, Airflow, Snowflake, or Kafka — experience with any is a plus.</li> <li>A self-starter mindset with genuine curiosity for solving unstructured data problems and working with large datasets.</li> <li>Familiarity with or curiosity about AI-enabled development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar coding assistants) and an interest in leveraging them to write better code, accelerate development, and improve engineering workflows.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.</li> <li>Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, with equivalent experience accepted.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Wizards, we believe in the magic of diversity—great ideas come from unique perspectives. We are committed to building an inclusive, welcoming workplace where everyone belongs. Wizards is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Wizards will provide reasonable accommodations with the application process, upon your request, as required to comply with applicable laws. If you have a disability and require assistance in this application process, please contact your recruiter or coordinator.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;" data-teams="true">The pay transparency range for this role is listed below. The hiring range will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location and market conditions. Additionally, employees may be eligible for annual and long-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package.</span></p></div><div class="title">Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$108,300</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$162,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Employees may be eligible for annual and long-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package, depending on role, location, and eligibility. Benefits and programs may include:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Health &amp; Wellness</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Time Off to Recharge</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Financial Well-being</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Life &amp; Family Support</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Volunteer and Community Initiatives</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Learning &amp; Development&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Exclusive Perks</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">Please review our </span><a id="OWAf3b48604-66ff-cab5-fa36-85c2d05d437e" class="OWAAutoLink" href="https://nam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fdocs.hasbro.com%2Fprivacy%2Fjob-applicant&amp;data=05%7C02%7CMaria.Hughes%40wizards.com%7C73f450b2476e4441be3308dec7006d14%7C701edd3ec7a84789b1ce8a243620d68f%7C0%7C0%7C639167001791388387%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=QzsYnPcynaB0OC2yYMSHab2TyW8jOlZQWyr87FBwDt8%3D&amp;reserved=0" data-auth="NotApplicable">Applicant Privacy Notice</a> to learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in connection with the application process.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><br></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"></span></p></div>

title: Senior Data Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><img src="https://hi-contentful.imgix.net/4xN7JhmwCRuz3y9M8L8CF7/5c244c52cfc982bd1a348a80dc35d43b/hi-logo-new.svg?auto=format&amp;ixlib=react-9.0.3&amp;h=40&amp;w=132&amp;q=50&amp;dpr=2" alt="hi-logo" width="132" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.</strong>&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the role</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">As a Senior Data Engineer on the Data Access team, you will be a technical anchor for Human Interest’s data platform at a pivotal moment in Human Interest's growth. This role exists to build and own the infrastructure that ensures the data powering our products, our customer reporting, and our business metrics are reliable and well governed. You will drive the evolution of our data platform toward an architecture that scales for AI consumption and for Human Interest's next growth stage. This is a high-ownership role where your architectural decisions will have a direct and visible impact on Human Interest's capabilities.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The Data Access team is Human Interest's internal data platform team. We own the full data stack from ingestion and orchestration through transformation, governance, and delivery to BI tools. Our stack includes Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Meltano, and Terraform on AWS. We're a small, highly collaborative team embedded within the HI Tech organization, working closely with Analysts, Finance, Product, and engineering teams to ensure that the data people rely on is trustworthy and accessible.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You'll have the opportunity to shape how we evolve our architecture towards AI-consumption and to set the standard for how production data assets are built, certified, and maintained at Human Interest. The team actively uses AI tools as part of our development workflow, and we expect this role to help drive and expand that practice across the team.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you get to do every day</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Define and maintain data governance standards including access controls, data lineage, and contracts between data producers and consumers</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Lead the technical direction and evolution of our data platform as we move toward an AI-first data infrastructure. You will design for AI consumption, unstructured data access, and integration with AI tooling from the ground up.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Build and scale data pipelines and architectures that make data accessible and useful to both human analysts and AI systems.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own end-to-end design and development of scalable data pipelines, from ingestion and orchestration to transformation and delivery, using tools including AWS, Terraform, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, Meltano, Python.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Drive data platform reliability through performance optimization, data quality monitoring, and SLA-based prioritization of our most critical data assets.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Leverage and champion AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, to accelerate development velocity across the team.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Mentor data engineers and analysts, raising the technical bar across the team.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you bring to the role</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer with a strong focus on production data pipelines and data infrastructure development.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong experience with AWS data services in a production context, including storage, compute, and pipeline tooling.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Hands-on experience with managing cloud data warehouse technologies, including Snowflake or equivalent, covering access control, performance tuning, and cost management.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong Python skills, with the ability to independently own and improve complex production data pipelines.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience with workflow orchestration at scale, including Airflow or equivalent tools.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Familiarity with data governance, observability, and data quality practices.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Familiarity with event sourcing or change data capture-based data patterns.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A strong desire to leverage AI tools and workflow automation to improve team productivity.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Nice to haves:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience with data lakehouse architectures and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience with dbt-core in a production repository.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience building data infrastructure to support AI-driven data access such as exposing data assets via MCP, implementing governance frameworks for AI data access, and curating, monitoring and evaluating the quality of AI-generated query responses.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Background in fintech, financial services, or another highly regulated or compliance-driven industry.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Please feel free to apply to this position even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements listed above.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Why you will love working at Human Interest</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Customer obsession</strong>: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Long-Term Orientation</strong>: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Autonomous and Accountable Teams</strong>: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance</strong>: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Fundamental Optimism</strong>: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Compensation</strong> - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. title: Data Engineer (Databricks)
full_description: <div>At Livefront, we help companies design and build world-class digital products that command attention and inspire joy. We’ve helped household names like CVS, Samsung, General Mills, and Optum create experiences that have reached millions of people, and startups like HomeSpotter and Credly build entirely new businesses that challenge their industries’ status quo.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're looking for an outstanding Databricks Data Engineer to join our growing data practice — someone who builds the data and AI foundations that digital products and intelligent experiences run on. This is a senior-level position with the opportunity to work remotely in<strong>&nbsp;</strong>Peru.</div> <div> <div class="section page-centered" data-qa="job-description"> <div>&nbsp;</div> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a Databricks-focused Data Engineer who understands that great data platforms are only as valuable as the products, AI workflows, and experiences they enable. You bring deep, production-grade expertise across the Databricks platform and know how to connect platform capabilities to real business outcomes.</p> <p>You thrive in ambiguity and can quickly assess a client's data landscape to recommend and implement the right solutions. You understand that in consulting, your Databricks depth is most valuable when it connects platform capabilities to the products and experiences clients actually use — and you're as comfortable in a product design conversation as you are building a DLT pipeline.</p> <p>You excel at translating complex data challenges into clear technical requirements and can confidently navigate conversations with everyone from data scientists to executives. Your engineering principles are mature and grounded in real-world experience across various industries and scales.</p> <p>You have an interest in and a curiosity about data platforms and the latest advances in data technology.</p> <h2><strong>What you will be doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design and build production data pipelines using Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Autoloader, and Structured Streaming, with end-to-end ownership of ingestion, transformation, data quality expectations, and CI/CD deployment via Declarative Automation Bundles.</li> <li>Architect and implement Lakehouse solutions on Databricks — medallion architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog — tailored to the client's analytics, AI, and application needs.</li> <li>Build and maintain Databricks transformation layers — DLT pipelines, PySpark notebooks, and dbt — with data quality constraints and SLAs baked in.</li> <li>Design and maintain the data and AI foundations — Unity Catalog, Feature Store, MLflow, and Model Serving — that power production ML, agent workflows, and AI-enabled digital products.</li> <li>Collaborate with product and backend engineers to design data models, APIs, and application data contracts — ensuring the platform serves the product, not just the warehouse.</li> <li>Consult with clients to understand their data challenges, develop data strategies, and implement sustainable solutions.</li> <li>Adapt your approach based on project needs — sometimes leading data architecture discussions with clients, other times supporting internal teams with specialized data expertise.</li> <li>Work within multi-cloud environments — primarily AWS and Azure — anchoring data platform recommendations around Databricks where it fits the client's architecture and goals.</li> <li>Champion data governance through Unity Catalog — access control, lineage, data quality policies, and compliance — as a first-class part of every engagement, not an afterthought.</li> <li>Design data-to-application architectures — including Lakebase-backed services and Databricks Apps — that connect governed data to AI workflows, digital products, and user-facing experiences.</li> <li>Help build Livefront's Databricks practice — contributing to accelerators, internal enablement, certification goals, and Databricks partner go-to-market materials alongside delivery work.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why you should apply</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You want to work with passionate and talented people who are always looking for ways to make things better.</li> <li>You desire a work environment where respect, mutual trust, and egoless collaboration are paramount.</li> <li>You want colleagues who take their work seriously but not themselves, and who know how to let loose and have a good time.</li> <li>You like being part of a team with a reputation for excellence that gives back to the community by educating, mentoring, and sponsoring.</li> <li>You want to work on products and accounts that have outsized impact and reach.</li> <li>You believe in sweating the details, giving a damn about quality, and taking pride in going the extra mile.</li> <li>You want to help build a data practice specialization from the ground up — shaping how we go to market with Databricks, what we build as accelerators, and what it means to do this kind of work at a digital product company.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you bring to the table</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3-5 years of data engineering experience with at least 2 years in production Databricks environments, preferably in a consulting or client delivery context.</li> <li>Solid working knowledge of AWS and Azure cloud services relevant to Databricks deployments — storage, networking, IAM, and compute — with GCP familiarity a plus.</li> <li>Deep, production-grade Databricks expertise: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Autoloader, Structured Streaming, Lakeflow Jobs, Unity Catalog (including fine-grained access control and lineage) — demonstrated through shipped production workloads, not prototypes.</li> <li>Proven experience designing Lakehouse architectures — medallion patterns, Delta Lake table design, partitioning, Z-ordering, and query optimization — at production scale.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with data pipeline testing, observability, and CI/CD for data — including unit testing, data quality frameworks, and version-controlled deployments via Git and Declarative Automation Bundles.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to write clean, performant, and maintainable code.</li> <li>Understanding of data modeling, schema design, and query optimization.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and deliver pragmatic solutions.</li> <li>Above-average discipline and personal organization skills.</li> <li>Obvious comfort with critique and peer review in the context of an iterative development process.</li> <li>A demonstrated hunger for personal and professional growth.</li> <li>A self-evident love and care for the craft of data engineering.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Bonus points if you…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Have worked with real-time streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.).</li> <li>Have hands-on experience with alternative cloud data platforms — useful context for migrations and competitive assessments, though Databricks is our primary platform focus.</li> <li>Have experience in healthcare or fintech domains.</li> <li>Have hands-on experience with MLOps or LLMOps on Databricks — MLflow experiment tracking, model registry, Model Serving endpoints, or Vector Search for RAG pipelines.</li> <li>Have experience with Java, Go, or Scala.</li> <li>Have strong illustration skills for technical diagramming and data architecture documentation.</li> <li>Speak, write, and/or educate publicly about data engineering topics.</li> <li>Have contributed to open-source data projects.</li> <li>Hold or are actively pursuing a Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional, or Apache Spark Developer) — we treat these as meaningful signals of platform depth, and they directly support our Databricks partner growth goals.</li> <li>Have experience with Databricks Apps, or Lakebase — early familiarity with where the Databricks platform is heading is a strong differentiator.</li> </ul> <h2>What to expect</h2> </div> <div class="section page-centered" data-qa="closing-description"> <div>When applying, please include a short note about yourself, a summary of your work experience, and a link to any public profiles you actively maintain (e.g., GitHub, LinkedIn, etc).</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Our hiring process moves quickly and consists of several stages for candidates who capture our attention with their initial submission, sometimes including but not limited to a short preliminary phone interview, a series of video interviews, and a short take-home exercise, which you'll have up to a week to complete.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <h2>Additional information</h2> <div>We go out of our way to evaluate all employees and job applicants equally based on merit, competence, and qualifications. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply and consider all qualified applicants. Don't worry, every application will be reviewed by a human.</div> </div> </div>

title: Associate Forward Deployed Product Manager
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.&nbsp;</p> <p>Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/pingwu/">Ping Wu</a>, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.</p> <p>Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.</p></div><div>&nbsp;</div> <p>Cresta is on a mission to turn every customer conversation into a competitive advantage. Our unified platform combines both AI and human intelligence to enable 1. automating conversations with AI Agents and 2. transform their contact centers to discover customer insights.</p> <p>Born from the Stanford AI lab, Cresta's co-founder and chairman is<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/sebastian-thrun-59a0b273/"> Sebastian Thrun</a>, the genius behind Google X, Waymo, and Udacity. Our leadership includes CEO,<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/pingwu/"> Ping Wu</a>, the co-founder of Google Contact Center AI &amp; Vertex AI platform,<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/tianlinshi/"> and co-founder, Tim Shi</a>, an early member of Open AI in 2017. Our investors include Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock Partners, Sequoia, and former AT&amp;T CEO John Donovan.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our valued customers include brands like Airbnb, United Airlines, Hilton, Porsche, United Healthcare, Intuit, Cox Communications, and Carmax and we’ve been recognized by Forbes, Forrestor, and Bain Consulting as one of the top private AI companies in the world.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>As an Associate Forward-Deployed Product Manager on the AI Agents team, you will create, deploy, and optimize AI Agents that transform our customers’ businesses and delight their customers. This customer-facing role blends product thinking, prompt engineering, data-driven insights, and project leadership with Strategic &amp; Fortune 500 companies.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll collaborate with senior Forward-deployed Product Managers and Forward-deployed Engineers (FDEs) to support the build of AI Agent products.&nbsp;</p> <p>What You’ll Do:</p> <ul> <li>Drive AI Agent deployments for customers across the lifecycle — from pre-sales to post-launch optimization</li> <li>Define AI roadmaps for the customer’s executive team by blending both quantitative analysis and qualitative insights; leverage automated conversation discovery tools in addition to traditional data analysis</li> <li>Iterate prompt &amp; context engineering to achieve customer’s use case and intended business outcomes</li> <li>Own designing and running evaluations and A/B tests of AI Agents with Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs) using Cresta’s agent builder and beta internal tools</li> <li>Improve our playbooks for agent development and customer deployment</li> </ul> <p>Why join as an Associate FDPM at Cresta?&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Differentiated career development:</li> <ul> <li>Get hands-on AI product experience building Agentic solutions using a cutting-edge tech stack</li> <li>Access to an accelerated timeline of customer-facing opportunities as an AI thought partner to executives &amp; leadership</li> </ul> <li>Rotational opportunities:</li> <ul> <li>Launching solutions for mid-market to Fortune 500 companies across different verticals, gaining breadth &amp; depth in industry knowledge and domain expertise</li> <li>Develop multiple functional strengths as a super-generalist: work on projects that give experience across multiple teams, including go-to-market, engineering, product, customer success, and more</li> </ul> <li>Investment &amp; mentorship:</li> <ul> <li>Mentorship from PMs who have been building GenAI solutions since GPT-2, as well as from Microsoft, TikTok, consulting firms, and start-ups</li> <li>Launching pad for your learning and career, we take that seriously as a company in scoping opportunities</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For:</strong></p> <p>You are a pragmatic, results-oriented problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments and excels at turning ambiguity into execution.</p> <p>What you’ll bring:</p> <ul> <li>2+ years of relevant experience (e.g., Product Management, Consulting, Implementations, Customer / Sales Engineer, Revenue &amp; Sales Analyst, Investment Banking, Founder)</li> <li>Hands-on work style – curiosity with a bias for action. You deliver with urgency and care</li> <li>Comfortable working with ambiguity and learning quickly in a dynamic startup environment</li> <li>Willingness to travel</li> </ul> <p>Bonus Points:</p> <ul> <li>Previous exposure via clients or projects to the travel &amp; hospitality, healthcare, insurance, and financial industry domains</li> <li>Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment</li> <li>Experience working closely with AI or LLM-first products</li> <li>Technical understanding, systems thinking and exposure to building Agents (not necessarily conversational, personal projects count!)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Perks &amp; Benefits:</strong></p> <p>We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:</p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family</li> <li>Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it</li> <li>Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child</li> <li>Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future</li> <li>Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office</li> <li>Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced</li> <li>In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation at Cresta&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.</p> <p>The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.</p> <p><strong>OTE Range</strong>: $130,000–$170,000 + Offers Equity</p> <p>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.&nbsp; If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai</p>

The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.&nbsp;</p> <p>Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/pingwu/">Ping Wu</a>, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.</p> <p>Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.</p></div><h4>About the role:</h4> <p>At Cresta, the AI Agent team is on a mission to create state-of-the-art AI Agents that solve practical problems for our customers. We are focused on leveraging the latest technologies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent systems, while ensuring that the solutions we develop are cost-effective, secure, and reliable.&nbsp;</p> <p>As an <strong>AI Agent Engineer</strong>, you'll be at the forefront of deploying AI agents that address real-world challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers as well as our software and machine learning engineers, ensuring high-impact AI Agent deployments and contributing to the continuous improvement of our core AI platform. You’ll develop intelligent AI agents, integrate them seamlessly with external systems and offer hands-on technical expertise to ensure successful deployments.. This position requires strong engineering skills, adaptability, and customer engagement. If you are self-driven, analytical, and eager to leverage AI in practical applications, this role is for you.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do </strong>:</p> <ul> <li><strong>AI Agent Development:</strong> Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents using Cresta’s AI platform and tools.</li> <li><strong>System Integration:</strong> Build AI agent integrations with external systems (APIs, databases, CRMs, etc.) to ensure seamless workflow integration.</li> <li><strong>Performance Optimization:</strong> Optimize AI agent performance (e.g. fine-tune prompts and configurations) and troubleshoot issues in complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Requirements Gathering:</strong> Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to gather technical requirements and translate business needs into AI Agent solutions.</li> <li><strong>Demos &amp; Iteration:</strong> Conduct interactive demos and present compelling proof-of-concepts to prospective customers, proactively gather feedback, and iteratively refine solutions to meet objectives.</li> <li><strong>Project Coordination:</strong> Define project milestones, create implementation plans, and coordinate execution with internal teams to ensure on-time delivery. Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through real-world deployment learnings.</li> <li><strong>Partner Cross-Functionally:</strong> Collaborate with PMs to define agent goals, iterate rapidly based on customer feedback, and shape product capabilities that maximize customer ROI.</li> <li><strong>Technical Guidance:</strong> Serve as a trusted technical advisor for the customer, guiding best practices for AI agent adoption and usage. Provide technical guidance on AI agent best practices, including architecture design, security considerations, and scalability planning.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What We're Looking For:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Education: </strong>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Experience: </strong>3+ years of full-time working experience in software development/Consulting, AI/ML engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Programming Skills:</strong> Proficiency in Python and Golang, with the ability to write clean, efficient code.</li> <li><strong>AI/ML Knowledge: </strong>Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.</li> <li><strong>AI Agent Frameworks: </strong>Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Hands-on experience of building such a system is strongly preferred.</li> <li><strong>Cloud &amp; DevOps: </strong>Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).</li> <li><strong>Integration Expertise: </strong>Hands-on experience with integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Excellent communication and project management skills.</li> <li><strong>Analytical Approach: </strong>Ability to use data-driven decision-making, including A/B testing and performance monitoring, to refine solutions.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Builder:</strong> You thrive in cross-functional environments, working hand-in-hand with PMs and engineers to turn real customer problems into scalable AI solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Note on Our Hiring Process</strong></p> <p>We highly value your time and engineering craftsmanship. To ensure a streamlined and objective process, the first step for qualified applicants following an initial resume review is a self-paced CoderPad technical assessment. This allows you to showcase your practical coding and problem-solving skills in a real-world environment before moving into conversational interview rounds.</p> <p><strong>Perks &amp; Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>We offer Cresta employees a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs</li> <li>Paid parental leave to support you and your family</li> <li>Monthly Health &amp; Wellness allowance</li> <li>Work from home office stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment</li> <li>Lunch reimbursement for in-office employees&nbsp;</li> <li>PTO: 3 weeks in Canada&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. We are actively hiring for this role in the US and Canada. Your recruiter can provide further details.</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">This posting will be used to fill a newly-created role.</p> <p>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain.&nbsp;Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.&nbsp; If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to <a href="mailto:recruiting@cresra.ai">recruiting@cresta.ai</a></p>

full_description: <p><strong>About Wonderschool</strong><br>Wonderschool’s mission is to ensure every child has access to early childhood education that helps them realize their full potential. We empower small business owners, childcare providers, to launch and grow in-home programs through cutting-edge software, personalized coaching, and responsive support. We also partner with governments to modernize public childcare infrastructure. Our team is small, fast-moving, and deeply motivated by the impact we create in families and communities across the country.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong><br>We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to lead product development on some of the most strategically important initiatives at Wonderschool. You’ll spend your time working directly with customers (traveling as needed), uncovering pain points, and building AI-powered solutions that drive measurable impact across revenue, operational efficiency, and user experience. You’ll act like a founder inside the company: identifying problems, shipping code, driving adoption, and iterating quickly based on what you learn. This role blends engineering, product, operations, and business leadership, and is ideal for someone who has launched products, acquired users, and driven growth independently. You will work closely with our sales, onboarding, and account management teams to automate workflows, build better customer experiences, and unlock new growth.</p> <p>This role is inspired by best-in-class FDSEs at companies like Palantir and is perfect for builders who love solving real-world problems in the field, not from behind a desk.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong><br>Work directly with users and internal teams to identify high-leverage problems and ship product solutions. Write production code (approximately 50% of your time) and ship weekly improvements across the customer journey. Use tools like Widesurf, Cursor, and other AI accelerators to increase your velocity and quality of output. Build and deploy AI-powered tooling that eliminates manual effort and improves the experience for providers, parents, and government partners. Automate onboarding flows, proposal generation, reporting processes, and other operational workflows. Own full loops: talk to users, design solutions, write code, test, deploy, and monitor adoption. Prioritize based on business impact and collaborate across teams to drive measurable results.</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong><br>You uncover user pain points faster than anyone else and consistently ship solutions that address them. You deploy AI-infused internal tools or product experiences that improve core metrics (conversion, retention, revenue). You fully own feedback loops, from discovery to deployment, and iterate rapidly. Internal teams rely on your tools to operate faster and with fewer resources. You’re moving fast, staying close to the customer, and operating with very little hand-holding.</p> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong><br>A builder and founder at heart, you’ve started a company, built products that got users, or made revenue independently. Comfortable talking to users weekly and distilling insight into product decisions. Technical enough to ship production code on your own, experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar languages. Experienced using AI/LLMs and developer tools like Windsurf and Cursor to move faster and smarter. Business-minded, you’ve worked in consulting, managed a P&amp;L, or attended business school and know how to prioritize based on ROI. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and energized by a high-trust, high-impact, in-person environment.</p> <p><strong>Why Join Us</strong><br>Make a direct impact on families, small business owners, and communities. Operate with founder-like ownership on the company’s most important priorities. Join a small, fast-moving team with a bias for action. Talk to users, ship weekly, and see your work go live and drive real-world outcomes. Help reimagine early education and child care for the modern era.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>In-person, 5-6 days a week. This role requires regular client travel.</p>

title: Lead Data Engineer - Auctions & Outcomes
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Kargo creates powerful moments of connection between brands and consumers to build businesses. Every day, our dynamic teams work to radically raise the bar on what agentic AI, CTV, eCommerce, social, and mobile can do to deliver unique ad experiences across the world’s most premium platforms. Taking a Creative Science approach to all we do, we continuously innovate solutions that outperform industry benchmarks and client expectations. Kargo is growing rapidly and currently has offices in NYC, Chicago, LA, Dallas, Sydney, Auckland, London and Waterford, Ireland.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who We Hire</strong></p> <p>Techies who want to build the future. Creatives who want to design it better. Communicators to win business. Collaborators to build it. Data pros who turn numbers into insights. Product builders who turn ideas into innovations. Anyone eager to be on a team that doesn’t stop to ask what’s next, because they’re already building it.&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Kargo is building toward a unified platform where advertisers run campaigns across CTV, web, mobile apps, and social entirely self-serve – the first time that capability goes directly into clients' hands. It raises the bar on the pipelines behind it, which already process billions of events per hour and now need stability, speed, a consistent vocabulary across surfaces, and observability that catches problems before clients do (for engineers and AI agents alike).</p> <p>In this role you'll own that work across supply and demand, measurement, reporting, and the log processing pipelines underneath. You'll also set the technical bar for the domain's engineers.</p> <p><strong>The Daily To-Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own business-metric reporting for data engineering</strong>: publisher performance, campaign delivery, revenue and spend, and attribution. Shape the definitions that make a cross-surface campaign read the same everywhere.</li> <li><strong>Own the domain's data sharing</strong>: the reports publishers and advertisers receive, log-level data for partners and clients, and our data sharing API.</li> <li><strong>Level up the event log processing pipelines at the heart of the domain</strong>: idiomatic Spark, refactored for testability, and a path to streaming as demand for faster insights grows.</li> <li><strong>Own and raise the bar on the domain's observability and alert response</strong>. Inventory today's signals, monitors and alerts, centralize them, and bring each to standard: a freshness and quality commitment, context for AI-assisted triage, and a runbook.</li> <li><strong>Lead and grow the domain's data engineers</strong>. Define the standards for testability, cost efficiency and the patterns worth repeating, then raise the team to them through your own code, reviews, and knowledge-sharing, recording decisions in ADRs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>You've owned large-scale, interdependent data systems in production, with deep Spark expertise: idiomatic, testable transformations tuned for cost and performance, built on Python, Airflow and Iceberg.</li> <li>You've led engineers, setting direction, reviewing work, developing people, while staying hands-on.</li> <li>You're hands-on with infrastructure: comfortable in AWS and Kubernetes, able to dig into logs and metrics to work out why a workload is failing or running slowly, and glad to pass that on.</li> <li>You engage analysts and business stakeholders directly, on metric definitions, not just requirements, and turn ambiguity into a sequenced roadmap, managing dependencies across teams and saying what isn't getting done.</li> <li>You're fluent with AI tooling in your own workflow, and you reason about what makes a codebase and its data legible to it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exchange, SSP or DSP experience: log-level auction and bidstream data at scale.</li> <li>Measurement and attribution in AdTech: pixels, trackers, 3P measurement partners.</li> <li>Migrating data systems: SQL to Spark, batch to streaming with Kafka or Redpanda.</li> <li>Snowflake, where reporting aggregation still lives, plus Clickhouse or similar.</li> <li>CI/CD with GitHub Actions/ArgoCD; monitoring with VictoriaMetrics/Prometheus/Grafana.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice To Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building internal tooling or libraries that other engineering teams adopted.</li> <li>Consolidating or migrating data systems following an acquisition.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]"><em>In accordance with applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency laws, the anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for variable compensation — either the Kargo Sales Incentive Plan (sales roles) or an annual discretionary bonus (all other roles). Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, education, and skills.</em></p></div><div class="title">U.S Salary Range </div><div class="pay-range"><span>$200,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$230,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What We're Proud Of</strong></p> <ul> <li>AdAge Best Places to Work&nbsp;</li> <li>ThinkLA Partner of the Year</li> <li>Built In Best Places to Work&nbsp;</li> <li>Cynopsis 2025 Top Women in Media - Jeannine Shao Collins</li> <li>Martech Breakthrough Awards - Best Overall Adtech Company</li> <li>Digiday Media Awards Best Event</li> <li>Cynopsis Media Impact Awards-Best CTV Platform</li> <li>Martech Breakthrough Awards-CTV Innovation</li> <li>Adweek Media Plan of the Year Awards - Best Use of Insights</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Following Our Lead</strong></p> <ul> <li>Big Picture:&nbsp; <a href="https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/kargo.com">kargo.com</a></li> <li>The Latest:&nbsp; Instagram (@kargo.hq) and LinkedIn (Kargo)</li> </ul></div>

Every day, our dynamic teams work to radically raise the bar on what agentic AI, CTV, eCommerce, social, and mobile can do to deliver unique ad experiences across the world’s most premium platforms. You'll also set the technical bar for the engineers building it with you.</p> <p><strong>The Daily To-Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build a new identity graph</strong>.
