title: Lead Analytics Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Innodata&nbsp;(Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked.&nbsp;Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale.&nbsp;We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.</p></div><p><strong>Scope of the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are hiring a Staff / Lead-level Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer to embed with the Monetization Data Science &amp; Analytics team as a senior individual contributor and technical leader. This person will be the go-to analytics expert for advertiser revenue, monetization performance, and growth metrics — trusted by Data Scientists, Analysts, PMs, and Engineering leaders to drive high-impact work end-to-end.</p> <p>This is a staff-level Individual Contributor role, not a mid-level execution seat. The successful candidate operates as:</p> <ul> <li>A trusted thought partner to Data Scientists and Product leaders — someone who improves the quality of the <em>question</em> before answering it.</li> <li>A technical leader who sets standards for data models, pipelines, and dashboards that others follow.</li> <li>A force multiplier who unblocks the team by identifying and fixing root causes across the data stack, not just building what's asked.</li> </ul> <p data-start="774" data-end="910"><strong>What You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>50% — Analytics, Business Insights &amp; Technical Leadership</strong> Partnering with Data Scientists and Product on the hardest analytics problems; driving metric definitions; reviewing others' analyses; setting standards for the team's analytics work.</li> <li><strong>30% — Data Engineering &amp; Pipeline Ownership</strong> Architecting and owning production SQL pipelines, data models, and data cubes; designing and operating Airflow DAGs; setting the bar for data quality, reliability, and reconciliation across the domain.</li> <li><strong>20% — Data Visualization, Metric Governance &amp; Enablement</strong> Owning executive-visibility dashboards in Tableau / Superset; defining and governing metrics; enabling self-serve analytics for the broader Monetization org.</li> </ul> <h3>Analytics Leadership &amp; Business Partnership</h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the senior analytics IC for the Monetization Analytics pod — the person Data Scientists and PMs come to with the hardest, most ambiguous data problems.</li> <li>Improve the <em>quality of the question</em> before answering — reframe vague asks into sharper, more valuable analytical approaches.</li> <li>Lead end-to-end analytics initiatives that span data modeling, pipeline work, and dashboard delivery — with minimal supervision and clear stakeholder communication throughout.</li> <li>Set metric definitions and standards for advertiser revenue, monetization performance, funnel/cohort metrics, and experiment readouts — and drive consistency across dashboards.</li> <li>Independently drive root-cause analysis on data discrepancies across dashboards, warehouses, or pipelines — including cross-team debugging when needed.</li> <li>Review, coach, and raise the bar on the work of other analysts and analytics engineers on the team.</li> </ul> <h3>Data Engineering &amp; Pipeline Architecture</h3> <ul> <li>Architect and own production-grade SQL data pipelines (Presto / Trino / Hive / Spark SQL) — including making the right tradeoffs on incremental vs. full refresh, pre-aggregation, and cost/performance.</li> <li>Design and own data cubes, aggregate tables, and semantic layers used by the whole Monetization Analytics function.</li> <li>Author, own, and operate Airflow DAGs for critical revenue and monetization pipelines — including SLAs, on-call posture, backfills, and incident response.</li> <li>Set and enforce standards for data quality, reconciliation, and observability — row counts, revenue tie-outs, distribution checks, anomaly alerting — across the domain.</li> <li>Optimize existing pipelines aggressively for cost and latency (partitioning, incremental refresh, query tuning on billion+ row tables) — and quantify the wins.</li> <li>Contribute to cross-team technical decisions — table designs, upstream schema changes, migration plans (e.g., Hive → Trino) — via design docs and reviews.</li> </ul> <h3>Data Visualization, Metric Governance &amp; Enablement</h3> <ul> <li>Own the design and quality of executive and cross-functional dashboards in Tableau and/or Superset.</li> <li>Drive metric governance — clear definitions, owners, source-of-truth queries, validation, deprecation.</li> <li>Enable self-serve analytics for Data Scientists, Analysts, and PMs — clear naming, documentation, certified metrics, sensible defaults, and coaching.</li> </ul> <p data-start="774" data-end="910"><strong>You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>9+ years of combined experience</strong> in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering roles.</li> <li>At least <strong>3+ years at Senior level or above</strong> in an analytics-adjacent role at a high-scale tech, ads-tech, marketplace, or fintech company.</li> <li>Prior experience as the <strong>most senior analytics IC</strong> on an embedded team — or a strong case for why they're ready to step into that role now.</li> <li>Track record of leading <strong>end-to-end analytics initiatives</strong> — from ambiguous business question through data model, pipeline, dashboard, and rollout.</li> <li>Prior experience partnering directly with <strong>US-based Data Science, Product, and Engineering leaders</strong> as a full contributor.</li> </ul> <h3>Technical Skills — SQL &amp; Data Engineering (Advanced)</h3> <ul> <li>Expert-level SQL — deep proficiency with window functions, CTEs, complex joins, query optimization, incremental patterns, skew mitigation, and cost tuning on billion+ row tables.</li> <li>Deep hands-on with at least two of: Presto, Trino, Hive, Spark SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift. Can reason about query plans and physical layout, not just syntax.</li> <li>Advanced Airflow — has architected and operated large DAG ecosystems (50+ production DAGs), including cross-DAG dependencies, backfills at scale, and SLA management. Equivalent orchestrators (Dagster, Prefect) also acceptable if depth is comparable.</li> <li>Data architecture &amp; modeling depth — Kimball, star schema, dimensional modeling, OLAP cubes, wide fact tables, slowly-changing dimensions, semantic layer design. Can defend design tradeoffs in a design review.</li> <li>ETL / ELT architecture — incremental loads, backfills, idempotency, data quality frameworks, lineage.</li> <li>Python for data work — pandas, PySpark, scripting, and light tooling development.</li> <li>dbt or equivalent transformation framework experience strongly preferred.</li> <li>Experience contributing to or reviewing design docs and RFCs for data platforms and pipelines.</li> </ul> <h3>Technical Skills — Visualization</h3> <ul> <li>Deep, hands-on production experience building executive-grade dashboards in Tableau and/or Apache Superset (Looker, Power BI, Mode also acceptable).</li> <li>Strong opinions on dashboard design — headline vs. drilldown metrics, layout, filters, performance, self-serve UX.</li> <li>Experience driving metric governance and self-serve BI at an org level.</li> </ul> <h3>Analytics &amp; Business Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Strong grasp of KPI definition, metric design, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B testing methodology.</li> <li>Deep exposure to digital advertising / monetization metrics — impressions, clicks, CTR, CPM, CPC, CVR, ROAS, revenue attribution, incrementality — is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Prior experience at ads-tech, digital media, or major consumer/marketplace tech companies (Meta, Google, Amazon, Uber, DoorDash, Snap, TikTok, LinkedIn, Airbnb, Instacart, Pinterest peers, etc.) is a strong plus.</li> <li>Comfort reading experiment results and challenging methodology when needed.</li> </ul> <h3>Leadership, Communication &amp; Ways of Working</h3> <ul> <li>Native or near-native English (spoken and written) — this is a hard requirement.</li> <li>Track record of leading initiatives end-to-end with minimal direction — scoping, aligning stakeholders, executing, and communicating results.</li> <li>Comfortable pushing back on unclear or misdirected requirements and proposing better approaches.</li> <li>Prolific writer of design docs, RFCs, requirement docs, and postmortems.</li> <li>Experience mentoring or coaching less-senior analysts and analytics engineers — even if not a formal manager.</li> <li>Executive presence — can present analytics work to Director/VP-level stakeholders and defend recommendations.</li> <li>Operates with the ownership mindset of a permanent employee, even in a contract role.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>The expected salary range for this position is $130,000 – $150,000 USD per year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p class="x_elementToProof"><em>Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at&nbsp;</em><a href="https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams." target="_blank">https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.</a><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p class="x_elementToProof"><em>If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at&nbsp;</em><a href="mailto:verifyjoboffer@innodata.com" target="_blank">verifyjoboffer@innodata.com</a><em>&nbsp;and consider reporting it to the FTC at&nbsp;</em><a href="http://reportfraud.ftc.gov/" target="_blank">ReportFraud.ftc.gov</a><em>.</em></p> <p></p></div>

By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.</p></div><p><img style="max-width: 100%;"></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong data-stringify-type="bold"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Please submit your resume in English.</em></strong></span></p> <p>Data Engineers work closely with business stakeholders to understand their goals and identify data-driven strategies to achieve those goals. business.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the dbt transformation layer (staging → intermediate →&nbsp;marts) with dimensional modeling, tests, and certification of datasets and semantic views for broad self-service use.</li> <li>Enable BI and downstream consumers (Looker/Tableau) by exposing consistent, trustworthy metrics through the modeled and semantic layers.Skills:</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on production experience building analytics models with dbt&nbsp;(staging/marts patterns, tests, documentation).</li> <li>Strong dimensional and semantic data modeling skills — star schemas, facts vs. dimensions, grain, and slowly changing dimensions.</li> <li>Production experience with title: VP, Forward Deployed Lead
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are:<br></strong></p> <p>Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.</p> <p>The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.</p> <p>Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on <a href="http://www.galaxy.com/">www.galaxy.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>What We Value:</strong></p> <p>We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals&nbsp;who&nbsp;thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers&nbsp;and&nbsp;embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.</p> <ul> <li><em>Seek Excellence.</em></li> <li><em>Be Selective To Be Effective.</em></li> <li><em>Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.</em></li> <li><em>Disagree Transparently.</em></li> <li><em>Encourage Independent Decision-Making.</em></li> <li><em>Build Dream Teams.</em></li> </ul></div><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <p>The Member of Technical Staff, Forward Deployed Lead is the de facto CEO of their pod within Galaxy Edge — a small, senior team focused on one client engagement or one innovation bet. In this role, you will own product direction, technical standards, client relationships, and account growth, working alongside a dedicated Delivery Lead who handles timelines and execution. You will rotate between our two verticals — Forward Deployed Product &amp; Engineering and R&amp;D &amp; Innovation — carrying hard-won market and technical context across the boundary. You will partner closely with Tier-1 financial institution stakeholders from engineers to C-suite executives, translating their needs in custody, settlement, tokenization, and trading into buildable roadmaps. This is a deliberately hybrid role requiring a hands-on startup CTO mindset combined with the commercial instinct to grow accounts and turn delivered trust into the next engagement.</p> <p title: AI Data Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>UJET leads the way in AI-powered contact center innovation, delivering a future-proof, cloud platform that redefines the customer experience with cutting-edge AI, true multimodality, and a mobile-first approach. We infuse AI across every aspect of your customer journey and contact center operations, to drive automation and efficiency. UJET's AI solutions empower agents, optimize customer journeys, and transform contact center operations for elevated experiences and actionable insights. Built on a cloud-native architecture with a unique CRM-first approach, UJET ensures unmatched security, scalability, and prioritized data insights (without storing PII). Designed for effortless use, UJET partners with businesses to deliver exceptional interactions, smarter decision-making, and accelerated growth in the AI-driven world.</p> <p>Learn more at <a class="c-link" href="http://www.ujet.cx/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://www.ujet.cx" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">www.ujet.cx</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Opportunity</strong></p> <p>UJET’s conversation-analytics product, Spiral, is helping product, support, and CX leaders see what their customers are actually saying at scale. We ingest voice recordings, chat transcripts, surveys, and ticket data from every CCaaS, CRM, and storage system our customers can hand us, transcribe and PII-redact at scale, and use LLMs to surface user stories, taxonomies, and the trends that drive product and operational decisions.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>We are hiring an AI Data Engineer</strong> to own the seam between "customer says yes" and "data is flowing into Spiral." You will run technical discovery with new customers, design the integration that brings their data into our pipeline, and then build it end-to-end,&nbsp; writing the code that adapts their data, wiring the cloud infrastructure that hosts the connection, and shipping the result into production. This is a hybrid role that combines pre-sale technical scoping with hands-on data-pipeline engineering. You will be the customer's technical counterpart from the first discovery call through steady-state ingest. You will be a member of the Spiral engineering team in every operational sense - working in a shared codebase, opening pull requests, participating in code review, debugging in production, and shipping changes through CI alongside the rest of engineering. This role is engineering-team membership with a customer-facing dimension; it is not a customer-success or pre-sales role that occasionally touches code.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run technical discovery with new customers to scope what data is available, where it lives, and how it will reach Spiral</li> <li>Design the integration approach for each customer: whether that's cloud-to-cloud bucket access, vendor push uploads, scheduled API pulls, file drops, or auth-protected exports and explain the tradeoffs to their engineering counterpart</li> <li>Shepherd credential and access exchange between the customer and Spiral - cloud access policies, OAuth or token-based authentication setup, key handoff - and stay on the thread until access is verified end-to-end</li> <li>Write the code that adapts each customer's data shape into our ingestion contract, and ship it to production through code review</li> <li>Make infrastructure-as-code changes to provision the cloud resources, identity grants, and secrets each new customer requires</li> <li>Configure and operate the orchestration that runs each customer's recurring ingest; validate end-to-end through run history, logs, and metrics</li> <li>Reconcile ingested data against source-system counts; diagnose and backfill historical gaps</li> <li>Own customer relationships post-go-live: schema changes, new feed requests, data-format drift, and surfacing upsell opportunities back to the account team</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Spiral Engineering to compress time-to-first-data on every new deal</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;<strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or Data Analytics with a CS/computing focus - or an equivalent rigorous technical degree</li> <li>Prior production engineering experience with data pipelines, integrations, or analytics infrastructure - internship, contract, or full-time all qualify</li> <li>Daily fluency with a standard engineering workflow: working in a shared codebase via git, authoring pull requests, giving and receiving substantive code review, debugging from logs, and shipping through CI - this is everyday work in this role, not a once-a-quarter activity</li> <li>Comfort using AI as part of the everyday engineering workflow - LLM APIs, AI-assisted coding tools, prompt design, and a clear-eyed view of where AI multiplies the work and where its first pass needs to be overridden</li> <li>Comfort writing production code in a modern typed or scripting language (years of experience scaling with level - new grads with strong fundamentals welcome)</li> <li>Working knowledge of a major cloud provider - identity and access management, object storage, secrets handling, and the security model that governs cross-organization access</li> <li>Experience with at least one data orchestration or ETL system, whether durable workflow, batch scheduler, or stream processor</li> <li>Strong SQL chops; comfortable querying data to validate and reconcile what landed against what was sent</li> <li>Customer-facing communication skills - able to hold a technical conversation with a customer's engineering counterpart and leave with a decision</li> <li>Clear written communication, async-first, as most coordination happens over email, chat, and tickets across multiple timezones</li> <li>A bias toward decisions over open questions, and a habit of writing the recommendation, not just the options</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;<strong>Stand-out Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with Temporal or another durable workflow engine</li> <li>OAuth integration experience (Salesforce JWT Bearer or Client Credentials especially)</li> <li>Infrastructure-as-code experience with AWS CDK or Terraform</li> <li>Experience with a columnar analytics database (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, DuckDB)</li> <li>Background in contact center, CCaaS, or CX domains (UJET, Genesys, Five9, Twilio, Aircall, Talkdesk, NICE)</li> <li>Comfort estimating cost and runtime of transcription or LLM pipelines at six-figure-file scale</li> <li>Experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent) - evaluation, prompt design, cost and latency tradeoffs</li> <li>Has used AI coding agents on a non-trivial engineering project and can articulate where the agent multiplied them and where they had to override its first pass</li> <li>Prior experience as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Implementation Engineer, or Technical Account Manager</li> </ul> <p>Annual US Hiring Range: $80,000 - $100,000</p> <p><em>*A candidate’s actual placement within this range will depend on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.<br><br></em>Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.</p> <p>This is hybrid role with in-office collaboration required in Santa Monica, California.&nbsp;Applicants must currently reside in the Greater Los Angeles area to be considered; no relocation will be provided.&nbsp;</p> <p><em>#LI-Hybrid</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why UJET?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Impactful Work:</strong> Be at the forefront of innovation, directly shaping the future of customer experience.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Dynamic Culture:</strong> Join a collaborative, inclusive team that values big ideas, creative solutions, and powerful relationships.</li> <li><strong>Comprehensive Benefits:</strong> Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, wellness benefits, and more.</li> </ul> <p><strong>UJET is an Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></p> <p>UJET provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.</p> <p><strong>Compliance Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Security, data protection and compliance (SDPC) are paramount to the success of our partnerships. All roles at UJET require compliance with legal and regulatory requirements and acceptance and adherence to all policies and standards within UJET. Personnel acknowledges they are personally responsible for reporting any suspected violations or abuse and are required to complete SDPC training and fulfill role-specific SDPC responsibilities.</p> <p><strong>AI Use in Our Hiring Process</strong></p> <p>UJET uses artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist with the initial review and filtering of job applications against the qualifications listed in this posting. AI does not make hiring decisions, does not conduct interviews, and has no authority to reject or advance a candidate on its own. All application review decisions, candidate screening, and interviews are conducted by members of our human recruiting and hiring teams.</p> <p><strong>Reasonable Accommodation</strong></p> <p>If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, including an alternative to AI-assisted screening, please contact <a href="mailto:peopleteam@ujet.cx">peopleteam@ujet.cx</a>.</p> <p><strong>Work Authorization &amp; Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which this position is located, without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa sponsorship. UJET does not sponsor employment visas for this role.</p></div>

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development</strong></p> <p>Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools — the terminal — to make it more usable and powerful for all developers. As AI has advanced, Warp has evolved beyond its terminal roots into a full agentic development environment: a workbench for dispatching agents to code, deploy, and debug production software.&nbsp;</p> <p>Today, we have two products: Warp, the agentic development environment born out of the terminal, and Oz, our orchestration platform for running hundreds of cloud agents in parallel. With both products, we’re creating the scaffolding for developers to build their own workflows for working with agents.&nbsp;</p> <p>In Warp, seamlessly switch between running commands, launching agents, and iterating on code with agents— eliminating the need to jump between a terminal and an IDE. It all works with our built-in SOTA agent or top agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. In Oz, build custom agents that are triggered programmatically, tracked centrally, and are shared across full teams to run agents across organizations without compromising security or reliability. Continue cloud agent runs that were triggered by Oz locally in Warp or on the web with one click.</p> <p>With over 750k active developers at companies including Docker, Ramp, Peloton, and over half of the Fortune 500 and revenue that grew over 44x last year, Warp is one of the fastest-growing startups in the AI development space.</p> <p>Our mission has remained the same even as AI has advanced: to empower developers to ship better software more quickly, freeing them to focus on the creative and rewarding aspects of their work. If you want to help define what development looks like in the agentic era at a company where your work reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers every day, we'd love to have you.</p></div><h4><strong>Why This Role?&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>Warp is scaling its enterprise motion around Oz — Warp's programmable agent platform for running and coordinating agents at scale. Oz Cloud Agents are cloud-connected background agents that run from events, schedules, or integrations, giving engineering teams scalable automation with shared observability. Enterprise customers can choose from Warp-hosted execution (where Oz handles everything from sandboxed environments to integrations) to self-hosted execution (where agents run on the customer's own infrastructure while Oz provides orchestration, session management, and visibility).</p> <p>Every enterprise has different security requirements, internal tooling, and use cases and we need someone to bridge the gap between our platform and their unique environments. As enterprises adopt Oz, they need hands-on technical leadership to deploy production agent workflows: architecting solutions, configuring environments, building integrations, guiding self-hosted deployments, and iterating on prompts and skills until the agents deliver real business value.</p> <p>As our <strong>Founding Forward Deployed Engineer</strong>, you'll be the first hire dedicated to making enterprise implementations successful, turning promising pilots into production deployments that drive real results. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product strategy, and go-to-market — you'll build alongside customers, not just advise them. You'll report to leadership and have direct exposure across every part of the business.</p> <h4><strong>As a Founding Forward Deployed Engineer, you will...</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own end-to-end enterprise implementations.</strong> Lead engagements from first discovery call through production deployment. Run deep discovery on customer engineering environments, define success criteria, architect agent workflows tailored to their stack, and own the outcome end-to-end.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Architect agent workflows with customers.</strong> Help enterprise engineering teams design agent architectures for their specific use cases: selecting triggers (Slack, Linear, GitHub Actions, webhooks, cron schedules, API calls), configuring sandboxed environments, structuring multi-step agent workflows, and designing integration-driven automation that fits into their existing development lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Build production-grade solutions alongside customers.</strong> Write and iterate on agent prompts, skills, and configurations. Set up environments, secrets, MCP servers, and integrations. Debug agent runs using session sharing and observability tools. Ship a working version in days, then harden it over weeks with proper monitoring and iteration based on real usage.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Guide self-hosted deployments.</strong> For enterprises that need execution on their own infrastructure, help configure managed workers (Docker, Kubernetes, or Direct backend), set up task routing, connect private registries, and validate network connectivity, ensuring they get the same orchestration and observability benefits as Warp-hosted execution.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate deals through technical execution.</strong> Join customer calls from the very first discovery meeting to understand their technical environment and identify opportunities for Oz cloud agents.</li> <li><strong>Develop reusable implementation patterns.</strong> Turn what you build into reusable patterns that make the next implementation faster. Document architecture patterns, reference implementations, agent skills, and templates.</li> <li><strong>Be the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering.</strong> You'll be closer to customer needs than almost anyone else on the team. Surface implementation friction, feature gaps, and common pain points. Translate what you're learning in the field – which integrations should become first-party, what's blocking faster deployments, where the platform needs to evolve – into actionable feedback that shapes the Oz platform roadmap.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>You may be a good fit if...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You have FDE-equivalent experience. </strong>Ideally, most recently a Forward Deployed Engineer, or you might be an early engineer or founder at a startup where you worked closely with GTM and did pilot implementations for enterprises. The key signal: you've built custom technical solutions for customers, not just internal products.</li> <li><strong>You have strong infrastructure fundamentals.</strong> You're comfortable with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), container orchestration, and Linux. You understand how enterprise engineering environments work and can navigate them confidently.</li> <li><strong>You're familiar with AI/LLM concepts.</strong> You understand prompt engineering, agent architectures, tool use, and how to evaluate non-deterministic systems. You've built or deployed AI-powered workflows, not just prototypes, but systems that run in production.</li> <li><strong>You're an excellent communicator who can articulate the vision.</strong> You can hold your own with senior engineers and executives alike. You need to articulate Warp's vision for Oz cloud agents in a way that gets enterprise engineering teams and leadership excited.</li> <li><strong>You have high EQ and can navigate enterprise relationships. </strong>Working with other companies' engineers requires a different approach than internal collaboration. You know how to be amenable, patient, and constructive even when things aren't set up the way you'd prefer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus...&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building or deploying AI agents in production (LangChain, custom agent frameworks, or similar)</li> <li>Experience with GitHub Actions, webhooks, and event-driven automation</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, self-hosted deployments, network boundary constraints)</li> <li>Experience with APIs/SDKs in a customer-facing capacity (building integrations, writing client libraries, or doing technical enablement)</li> <li>Experience with terminal applications, shell scripting, or command-line tooling</li> <li>Experience with Rust or Go</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Warp, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. So if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in this job description – we encourage you to apply anyways! We are a community of curious learners, and most of us are learning some skills for the first time (like our engineers learning to program Warp in Rust). You might be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you're feeling playful, try out our optional hiring challenge and submit your answers with your application: <a href="https://github.com/warpdotdev/hiring-challenge">https://github.com/warpdotdev/hiring-challenge</a></span></p> <p><strong>Salary Transparency</strong></p> <p>Warp operates from a place of high trust and transparency around compensation. We state the pay range that best aligns with our understanding of the market and the needs for the open role.</p> <p>When we find the right person, we try to put our best foot forward with an offer that excites you. We consider your skills, the level of experience you bring, and what similar jobs in the market pay, all while ensuring equal pay for equal work at Warp.</p> <p>Total compensation at Warp consists of: (1) a market-competitive base salary, (2) a generous benefits package, and (3) meaningful equity.</p> <p><strong>The budgeted compensation amount for this role is targeted at </strong><strong>$200,000 to $250,000 (inclusive of an 80% base / 20% variable split)</strong><strong>.</strong></p> <p><em>Exact compensation will vary based on skills and experience.</em></p> <p>In addition to salary, all employees receive further compensation in the form of equity in the company. This is a meaningful stock option grant with a four-year vesting period and one-year cliff. Your equity is where most of the significant upside potential is. Comparing startup equity is always a bit tricky, so we’re happy to walk you through different valuation scenarios at the offer stage in order to help paint a clearer picture of the upside.</p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary, generous benefits, and meaningful equity</li> <li>100% coverage on medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees (80% coverage for dependents)</li> <li>A flexible remote-first culture, with optional office spaces in NYC and SF for folks who want to work together IRL</li> <li>Pre-tax FSA and Health Savings Plans</li> <li>Pre-tax Commuter Benefit</li> <li>12 company holidays, 20 days of Paid Time Off, and unlimited sick time</li> <li>16 weeks of paid Parental Leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents</li> <li>Twice-a-year all company retreats in awesome locations</li> <li>A monthly gym and internet stipend</li> <li>A company-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell</li> <li>A complimentary OneMedical membership</li> </ul> <p><em>Individuals seeking employment at Warp are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. #LI-Remote</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Warp</strong></p> <p>We are a company run by product-first builders, building a core product for all developers. We are committed to understanding our users deeply. We will ultimately build the best product and business if that team includes developers and designers from a wide range of backgrounds. The early team comes from Google, Dropbox, Gem, LinkedIn, and Facebook. We are looking for passionate individuals to join us and help bring Warp to the world.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We value honesty, humility, and pragmatism, and our core product principle is focusing on the user. If you’re interested in learning more about our company values and&nbsp;</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px;">the culture of our engineering team, please take a look at our internal&nbsp;<a href="http://warp.dev/how-we-work" target="_blank">'How We Work'</a></span>&nbsp;guide.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re very fortunate to be backed by a great group of venture capital firms. In August 2023, we announced a $50M Series B funding round ($73M total raised), led by Sequoia Capital.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our other investors include Google Ventures, Neo, and Box Group. We are also backed by a network of passionate angels, including Dylan Field (Co-Founder and CEO,&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/why-im-leading-warps-series-dylan-field/">Figma</a>), Elad Gil (early investor in Airbnb, Pinterest, Stripe, and Square), Jeff Weiner (Executive Chairman and Ex-CEO, LinkedIn), Marc Benioff (Founder and CEO, Salesforce), and Sam Altman (Co-Founder &amp; CEO, OpenAI).</span></p> <p><strong>The Product</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Here's our </span><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k9BRhSbVSpI">latest demo</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> showing some of our current features…</span></p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/k9BRhSbVSpI" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p></div>

title: Staff Data Engineer (Coupang Pay)
full_description: <p></p> <div class="ewa-rteLine">The fintech business of Coupang is reimagining financial services for both our consumers and sellers, so they can do more with their money.</div> <div class="ewa-rteLine">&nbsp;</div> <div class="ewa-rteLine">Coupang Pay focuses on delivering innovative payment and financial services solutions to everyone who uses the Coupang app — from customers buying products on Coupang.com, to marketplace vendors, and restaurants that offer their services via Coupang Eats. title: Data & Analytics Engineer
full_description: <h1><strong>Job Description: Data &amp; Analytics Engineer (3-4 Years Experience) : 100% Remote</strong></h1> <p><strong>Job Title:</strong> Data &amp; Analytics Engineer <strong>Experience:</strong> 3-4 years <strong>Location:</strong> Remote <strong>Employment Type:</strong> Full-time <strong>Team:</strong> Data Engineering &amp; Analytics</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Eltropy is a digital conversations platform for credit unions and community financial institutions in the US. The Data Engineering &amp; Analytics team builds the AWS data pipelines and customer-facing dashboards that power analytics across the platform.</p> <p>We are looking for a Data &amp; Analytics Engineer with 3-4 years of experience who can own dashboard delivery end to end along with the pipelines behind it. The ideal candidate learns fast, builds product context quickly, listens well, and collaborates effectively across product, engineering, DevOps, and customer-facing teams.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own dashboard changes end to end in QuickSight and ThoughtSpot - new metrics and filters, SPICE refresh management, internal-to-production promotion, and post-release validation.</li> <li>Build and maintain batch and streaming ETL pipelines on AWS using Glue (PySpark), S3, Redshift, and Airflow (MWAA) DAGs.</li> <li>Write and optimize Redshift SQL; debug query performance, connection contention, and data mismatches across sources.</li> <li>Support near-real-time ingestion (Kafka/MSK CDC → Glue Streaming → S3 → Redshift).</li> <li>Investigate customer-reported analytics discrepancies (Jira/support tickets), root-cause them in the data, and communicate findings clearly to support, product, and engineering.</li> <li>Set up and respond to pipeline monitoring - CloudWatch metrics and alarms, monitoring DAGs, refresh health - and participate in incident triage and RCA.</li> <li>Develop deep product knowledge: understand what each metric means to our credit union customers and translate product changes into data model and dashboard updates.</li> <li>Ensure data quality, validation, and consistency across systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Required Skills &amp; Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3-4 years of experience in data engineering and/or analytics engineering.</li> <li>Strong SQL on Redshift (or a similar MPP warehouse) and solid Python/PySpark.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with the AWS data stack: S3, Glue, Redshift, CloudWatch.</li> <li>Workflow orchestration with Apache Airflow — authoring, debugging, and deploying DAGs.</li> <li>Data modeling and warehousing fundamentals.</li> <li>BI dashboarding experience with QuickSight, ThoughtSpot, Tableau, or Power BI.</li> <li>Quick learner — able to grasp an unfamiliar product and data model fast and work independently.</li> <li>Strong listening and collaboration skills; comfortable coordinating across product, engineering, DevOps, and customer-facing teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Good to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Streaming/CDC experience: Kafka (MSK), Debezium, Spark Structured Streaming.</li> <li>AWS infrastructure awareness: IAM roles, security groups, Secrets Manager, Kinesis/Firehose.</li> <li>Fintech or B2B SaaS analytics exposure.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Security Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Adhere to Eltropy's policies on security, confidentiality, availability, and privacy; handle customer and financial-institution data responsibly, protect access credentials, and report security events promptly through Eltropy's channels.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p>

title: Lead Data Engineer
full_description: <h1></h1> <h1>Job Title: Lead Data Engineer</h1> <p><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ Years<br><strong>Location:</strong> Remote (Anywhere in India)<br><strong>Employment Type:</strong> Full-time</p> <hr> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Lead Data Engineer</strong> with 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and building <strong>scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines</strong>. requirements into robust data solutions.</p> <p>You will be responsible for <strong>architecting, designing, and delivering data engineering solutions</strong>, while also mentoring engineers and Analytics, and Business stakeholders to build a scalable data foundation that supports reporting, analytics, and self-service BI.</p> <hr> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Design, develop, and manage <strong>scalable ETL/ELT pipelines</strong> for structured and unstructured data using AWS services such as <strong>AWS Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, Lambda, and Kinesis/Kafka</strong>.</p> <p>Own the <strong>technical design and end-to-end delivery</strong> of data engineering initiatives.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop robust data models and pipelines that support <strong>analytics, reporting, and business intelligence</strong> use cases.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive <strong>data pipeline automation, orchestration, monitoring, and observability</strong> using tools such as owners and business users to build their own visualizations using Generative BI tools such as <strong>ThoughtSpot, QuickSight Q, or similar platforms</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Optimize data pipelines, queries, and warehouse performance to ensure scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.</p> </li> <li> <p>Establish and maintain standards for <strong>data quality, integrity, security, engineering best practices.</p> </li> <li> <p>Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to building a <strong>high-performing data engineering team</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in <strong>data engineering, cloud platforms, data architecture, and analytics</strong>.</p> </li> </ul> <hr> <h2>Required Skills &amp; Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering</strong>, with demonstrated ownership of complex data engineering projects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong proficiency in <strong>Python and SQL</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration tools such as <strong>AWS Glue, Apache Airflow, and AWS Step Functions</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong experience with the <strong>AWS data stack</strong>, including <strong>S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, and Kinesis or Kafka</strong>.</p> </li> <li> modeling, data warehousing, and database design</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with <strong>query optimization, performance tuning, and cost optimization</strong> across data platforms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with <strong>Spark/PySpark and/or EMR</strong> for large-scale data processing.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience enabling <strong>self-service analytics</strong> through well-designed data models and semantic layers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with BI/analytics platforms such as <strong>ThoughtSpot, Amazon QuickSight, or similar tools</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of <strong>data quality, governance, security, and data lifecycle management</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and <strong>technical leadership skills</strong>.</p> </li> </ul> <hr> <h2>Preferred Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Experience <strong>leading a technical team</strong> or mentoring data engineers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning data engineering projects from <strong>architecture and design through implementation and production</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working in a <strong>SaaS or product-based environment</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with modern data architecture patterns, including <strong>data lakes, lakehouses, streaming pipelines, and event-driven architectures</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with <strong>Kafka/Kinesis</strong> and real-time or near-real-time data pipelines.</p> </li> <li> <p>AWS certifications in <strong>Data Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or related areas</strong>.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contributions to open-source projects or demonstrated involvement in the broader data engineering community.</p> </li> </ul>

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
full_description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>About AvePoint</h2> <p>AvePoint is the global leader in data protection, unifying data security, governance, and resilience to provide a trusted foundation for AI. More than 28,000 customers rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to secure, govern, and rapidly recover data across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other cloud environments. With a single platform for lifecycle control, multicloud governance, and rapid recovery paired with clear ownership across the business, we prevent overexposure and sprawl, modernize legacy and fragmented data, and minimize data loss and interruption. Our global partner ecosystem includes approximately 6,000 MSPs, VARs, and SIs, and our solutions are available in over 100 cloud marketplaces. To learn more, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.avepoint.com/" target="_blank">www.avepoint.com</a>.</p> <h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="zmeluu" data-start="175" data-end="193">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="zmeluu" data-start="175" data-end="193">About the Role</h3> <p data-start="195" data-end="330">&nbsp;</p> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="184" data-end="439">Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.</p> <p data-start="441" data-end="780">You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">&nbsp;</p> <h3 data-section-id="1b5pyf7" data-start="1080" data-end="1096">What you'll do</h3> <h4 data-section-id="1rd6iho" data-start="1098" data-end="1136">Advise on AI trust and governance.</h4> <p data-start="1137" data-end="1641">Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.</p> <h4>Scope and shape AI build projects.</h4> <p data-start="1682" data-end="2121">Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.</p> <h4 data-section-id="1elmp9s" data-start="2123" data-end="2145">Build and deliver.</h4> <p data-start="2146" data-end="2546">Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.</p> <h4 data-section-id="8xgjwk" data-start="2548" data-end="2590">Own the relationship through delivery.</h4> <p data-start="2591" data-end="2805">Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.</p> <h3 data-section-id="kq6nv6" data-start="2807" data-end="2831">What we're looking for</h3> <h4 data-section-id="1wfooam" data-start="2833" data-end="2846">Must-haves</h4> <ul data-start="2848" data-end="4211"> <li data-section-id="1savupk" data-start="2848" data-end="3035">5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).</li> <li data-section-id="qxlgzp" data-start="3036" data-end="3234">Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.</li> <li data-section-id="5cohv6" data-start="3235" data-end="3474"><strong data-start="3237" data-end="3268">Machine Learning Expertise:</strong> Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.</li> <li data-section-id="4qgzw0" data-start="3475" data-end="3667">Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services.</li> <li data-section-id="u9bkd2" data-start="3668" data-end="3894">Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.</li> <li data-section-id="i43vcd" data-start="3895" data-end="4098">Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.</li> <li data-section-id="16b5uac" data-start="4099" data-end="4211">Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.</li> </ul> <h4 data-section-id="gbyf8a" data-start="4213" data-end="4229">Strong pluses</h4> <ul data-start="4231" data-end="5098"> <li data-section-id="otf7d0" data-start="4231" data-end="4368">Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.</li> <li data-section-id="1457rsl" data-start="4369" data-end="4515">Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).</li> <li data-section-id="1l5daxl" data-start="4516" data-end="4648">Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).</li> <li data-section-id="3crjn8" data-start="4649" data-end="4791">Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.</li> <li data-section-id="1h63k2g" data-start="4792" data-end="4936">Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.</li> <li data-section-id="1d0p8e3" data-start="4937" data-end="5036">Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.</li> <li data-section-id="49tosn" data-start="5037" data-end="5098">Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 data-section-id="1bghwns" data-start="5100" data-end="5127">How we'll measure success</h3> <p data-start="5129" data-end="5421">Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. Above all: clients ask for you by name.</p> <p data-start="5129" data-end="5421">&nbsp;</p> <h3 data-section-id="yoij66" data-start="5423" data-end="5447">Why this role, why now</h3> <p data-start="5449" data-end="5893">AI adoption has outrun enterprise control, and regulators have noticed. Every large organization now needs to see, govern, secure, and sustain its AI estate — and most need a partner who can both advise and build. As an FDE at AvePoint you will help define this engagement model from the ground floor, work at the frontier of agentic AI and AI trust, and do it with two decades of enterprise data governance and resilience expertise behind you.</p> <p data-start="5449" data-end="5893">&nbsp;</p> <p>The Salary Range for this role is $180,000 - $230,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.</p> <p>Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our&nbsp;<a id="menur12n" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://www.avepoint.com/company/privacy-notice" target="_blank">Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-SB1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-teams="true"><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak">Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our <a id="menur12n" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://www.avepoint.com/company/privacy-notice" target="_blank">Privacy Notice</a>.</span></span></p></div>

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
full_description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>About AvePoint</h2> <p>AvePoint is the global leader in data protection, unifying data security, governance, and resilience to provide a trusted foundation for AI. More than 28,000 customers rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to secure, govern, and rapidly recover data across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other cloud environments. With a single platform for lifecycle control, multicloud governance, and rapid recovery paired with clear ownership across the business, we prevent overexposure and sprawl, modernize legacy and fragmented data, and minimize data loss and interruption. Our global partner ecosystem includes approximately 6,000 MSPs, VARs, and SIs, and our solutions are available in over 100 cloud marketplaces. To learn more, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.avepoint.com">www.avepoint.com</a>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="zmeluu" data-start="175" data-end="193">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="zmeluu" data-start="175" data-end="193">About the Role</h3> <p data-start="195" data-end="330">&nbsp;</p> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="184" data-end="439">Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.</p> <p data-start="441" data-end="780">You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">&nbsp;</p> <h3 data-section-id="1b5pyf7" data-start="1080" data-end="1096">What you'll do</h3> <h4 data-section-id="1rd6iho" data-start="1098" data-end="1136">Advise on AI trust and governance.</h4> <p data-start="1137" data-end="1641">Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.</p> <h4>Scope and shape AI build projects.</h4> <p data-start="1682" data-end="2121">Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.</p> <h4 data-section-id="1elmp9s" data-start="2123" data-end="2145">Build and deliver.</h4> <p data-start="2146" data-end="2546">Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.</p> <h4 data-section-id="8xgjwk" data-start="2548" data-end="2590">Own the relationship through delivery.</h4> <p data-start="2591" data-end="2805">Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.</p> <h3 data-section-id="kq6nv6" data-start="2807" data-end="2831">What we're looking for</h3> <h4 data-section-id="1wfooam" data-start="2833" data-end="2846">Must-haves</h4> <ul data-start="2848" data-end="4211"> <li data-section-id="1savupk" data-start="2848" experimentation).</li> <li data-section-id="qxlgzp" data-start="3036" data-end="3234">Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.</li> <li data-section-id="5cohv6" data-start="3235" data-end="3474"><strong data-start="3237" solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.</li> <li data-section-id="4qgzw0" data-start="3475" data-end="3667">Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.</li> <li data-section-id="5cohv6" data-start="3235" data-end="3474"><strong data-start="3237" title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Carrot: </strong></p> <p><a href="https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&amp;l=en&amp;o=4420559-1&amp;h=3535232987&amp;u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.carrotfertility.com%2F&amp;a=Carrot+Fertility">Carrot</a> is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.<br><br>Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at <a href="http://get-carrot.com">get-carrot.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>The Opportunity </strong><strong>🚀</strong></p> <p>Carrot is seeking a Sr. Manager, Data Engineering to lead our Business Intelligence data engineering function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is a senior player/coach role with a strong emphasis on strategic leadership, technical excellence, and organizational impact. You will lead and grow a high-impact team while remaining deeply hands-on in architecting and building Carrot's data infrastructure.</p> <p>You will set technical vision, drive cross-functional data strategy, and ensure our data systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. You will influence and execute on the long-term roadmap for Data Engineering within the Data Team, defining how we ingest, transform, govern, and expose data across the company, and partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, and Go-To-Market functions.</p> <p>Given the small-but-mighty nature of the team, this role requires someone who is comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: setting multi-year architectural direction, shaping team and org design, and still rolling up their sleeves to build production-grade pipelines when needed.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Own </strong><strong>💼</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Own the <strong>technical vision and roadmap</strong> for BI data engineering, aligning it with company strategy and analytics needs.</li> <li>Design, build, and review scalable <strong>ETL/ELT pipelines</strong> and workflow orchestration systems, contributing hands-on production code in <strong>Python and SQL</strong>.</li> <li>Architect and optimize <strong>data warehouse models</strong> that support advanced analytics, self-service BI, and operational reporting.</li> <li>Establish and enforce standards for <strong>reliability, observability, testing, and performance</strong> across all data systems.</li> <li>Drive improvements in <strong>data quality, lineage, and governance</strong>, including documentation and metadata practices.</li> <li>Partner with backend product engineering teams to <strong>co-design production database schemas</strong> and event models with analytics and reporting in mind.</li> <li>Lead, mentor, and develop a <strong>team of data engineers</strong>, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration.</li> <li>Own <strong>team-level planning and execution</strong>, including capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery across concurrent workstreams.</li> <li>Translate ambiguous business and analytics needs into a <strong>clear, prioritized engineering roadmap</strong> with measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Partner closely with <strong>Product, Engineering, Analytics, Security, and Legal</strong> to align on priorities, ensure compliance, and remove cross-functional blockers.</li> <li>Evaluate and influence <strong>build vs. buy decisions</strong>, vendor selection, and tool adoption across data platforms, ingestion, and transformation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like </strong><strong>&nbsp;📈</strong></p> <p>In your first 12–18 months, you will have:</p> <ul> <li>Elevated the <strong>maturity and consistency</strong> of data engineering practices across the BI function, with clear standards for reliability, testing, and observability.</li> <li>Built and retained a <strong>high-performing data engineering team</strong> recognized as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the business.</li> <li>Delivered a <strong>prioritized data engineering roadmap</strong> aligned with company strategy, with measurable progress on scalability and platform modernization.</li> <li>Strengthened the <strong>accuracy, recency, and security</strong> of enterprise data, meeting the requirements of regulated healthcare contexts.</li> <li>Enabled <strong>advanced analytics, self-service BI, and data products</strong> that drive meaningful business outcomes and influence Carrot's long-term data architecture strategy.</li> </ul> <p><br><br><br></p> <p><strong>About You </strong><strong>✨</strong></p> <p>You likely have:</p> <ul> <li><strong>8-10+ years</strong> of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, including <strong>3-5+ years</strong> leading and managing data or software engineers.</li> <li><strong>5+ years of advanced SQL</strong> and <strong>5+ years of Python development</strong> experience in production environments, including unit and integration testing.</li> <li>Strong, hands-on experience <strong>designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines</strong> in production.</li> <li>Proficiency with <strong>cloud-based data platforms</strong> (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and modern ingestion, transformation, and orchestration tools (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, Airflow).</li> <li>Strong understanding of <strong>relational modeling and warehouse design principles</strong>, plus version control (Git preferred) and modern CI/CD practices.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to <strong>define technical strategy and standards</strong> while remaining capable of direct technical execution.</li> <li>Excellent <strong>written and verbal communication skills</strong>, with strong knowledge of data governance, security best practices, and compliance protocols.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Nice to Have </strong><strong>⭐</strong></p> <p>While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:</p> <ul> <li>Direct experience with <strong>Carrot's current tech stack</strong>: Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, and AWS.</li> <li>Experience with <strong>enterprise BI platforms</strong> and enabling self-service analytics.</li> <li>Experience integrating <strong>batch and event-streaming or real-time ingestion systems</strong>.</li> <li>Prior experience leading data engineering teams in a <strong>startup or high-growth environment</strong>, ideally including managing other leads or senior-level ICs.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare industry experience</strong>, including familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) and privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why This Role Matters </strong><strong>🧡</strong></p> <p>The reliability, scalability, and usability of Carrot's data systems directly power decision-making across the organization and for our clients. Data Engineering plays a foundational role in enabling the broader Business Intelligence function, and this role serves as the senior-most manager directly responsible for that capability.</p> <p>The Business Intelligence team at Carrot is highly cross-functional and central to the company's long-term success. Led by our Vice President of Data and Business Intelligence, the team includes data engineers, data scientists, and business intelligence analysts. In this role, you will build and nurture a high-performing team, ensure the accuracy and security of enterprise data in a regulated healthcare context, and influence the long-term data architecture and platform strategy at Carrot.</p> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>Interview Process </strong><strong>🤝</strong></p> <p>We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.</p> <p>For this role, candidates can expect:</p> <ol> <li>Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes</li> <li>Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes</li> <li>Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes</li> <li>Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes</li> <li>Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes</li> </ol> <p>Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2><strong>Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍</strong></h2> <p>Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.</p> <p>Highlights include:</p> <ul> <li>A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.</li> <li>A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.</li> <li>Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.</li> <li>Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.</li> <li>Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.</li> <li>A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.</li> <li>The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $170,000-$210,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Fraud and Security Notice: </strong>Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: <a href="mailto:securityreporting@get-carrot.com">securityreporting@get-carrot.com</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>A Note on AI</strong></p> <p>At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.</p> <p>For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Carrot?</strong></p> <p>Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span></p></div>
