title: Forward Deployed Engineer
full_description: <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Forward Deployed Engineer</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">At Dexory, we believe that real-time data will revolutionise the logistics industry. We are building the ultimate data insights platform that provides companies with unprecedented access to their operations through autonomous data capture and digital twins.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">As a <strong>Forward Deployed Engineer</strong> at Dexory, you will sit inside the engineering organisation as an intelligent interface layer between our various engineering teams. Dexory operates with a global fleet of autonomous robots, supported by a 24/7 first-line support team. The Forward Deployed Engineer sits above that layer, taking ownership of complex, ambiguous issues and driving them to resolution or to the right team. You will be one of Dexory’s first Forward Deployed Engineers, representing Dexory at the highest level in customer environments and helping to define how this function operates as we scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">This is a technically demanding role for someone who is as comfortable spotting patterns across weeks of telemetry data as they are at supporting a new customer deployment on the ground. You will query data across logs, databases, and observability tooling, interpret point cloud scan data, and navigate Grafana, AWS, and a range of robotics-specific tooling to investigate issues and understand their root cause. Crucially, you will also use what you learn to improve things — identifying recurring failure modes, feeding structured insights back into the engineering teams, and raising the platform’s reliability across our global fleet. You will also support new customer deployments end-to-end, bridging WMS and network integration questions with robot operational and perception configuration requirements.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The right person is defined by their investigative instinct and technical curiosity, not their robotics or logistics background. Domain knowledge is built on the job through close collaboration with the engineering teams.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Cross-functional Triage &amp; Investigation: </strong>Receive escalated issues from the first-line support team and investigate independently before routing to the relevant engineering teams. Query telemetry data, robot logs, AWS infrastructure, internal tooling and databases — including scan and point cloud data where relevant — to narrow the blast radius of a problem and form a view on root cause before pulling in specialist teams.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Observability &amp; Monitoring: </strong>Navigate Grafana dashboards and internal tooling to monitor fleet and site health. Build or extend dashboards and alerting that improve visibility into system performance across deployed sites. Use telemetry data proactively to identify issues before they surface as customer complaints.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>New Customer Deployment Support: </strong>Work within customer systems to provide white glove deployment support for the Dexory platform end-to-end, covering WMS and ERP integration queries, network and connectivity requirements, robot operational setup, and perception feature configuration. Act as the cross-functional point of contact who can answer or route questions across the full Dexory system.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Intelligent Escalation &amp; Routing: </strong>Own the escalation path from first-line support through to the right engineering team. Ensure that when specialist engineers are brought in, they receive a well-structured summary of what has already been investigated, what has been ruled out, and the most likely failure domain.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Customer Communication: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers throughout deployment and into long-term steady-state operation. Build strong, lasting relationships with customer engineering and operations stakeholders, proactively identifying new opportunities to drive value throughout the lifecycle of an engagement. Run technical workshops and training sessions that drive lasting adoption. Produce clear, professional documentation covering deployment architectures, integration designs, and operational runbooks.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Product &amp; Engineering Feedback: </strong>Identify recurring failure patterns across sites and translate them into structured product and engineering feedback. Contribute to internal knowledge bases and runbooks that reduce investigation time for future issues.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Tooling &amp; Automation: </strong>Write scripts and tooling that automate repetitive investigation or deployment tasks. Contribute to reusable frameworks that improve the efficiency and consistency of the FDE function as the team grows.</span></li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Required Qualifications &amp; Experience</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">4–5+ years of professional solutions engineering or technical operations experience, with a demonstrated ability to advise customer setups and investigate and diagnose complex, multi-system problems independently.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Strong data querying skills: comfortable writing SQL, navigating time-series telemetry data, and pulling structured insight from large, noisy datasets.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Hands-on experience with observability tooling such as Grafana, including building dashboards and using metrics data to diagnose production issues.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Comfortable working in Linux environments: SSH, bash scripting, log analysis, and networking fundamentals.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent), containerised deployments with Docker and Kubernetes, and modern data pipeline tooling.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Proficiency in Python or an equivalent scripting language for investigation tooling, automation, and data analysis.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling (Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI, or similar).</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Strong cross-functional communication skills: able to summarise a complex technical investigation clearly for both engineering teams and customer stakeholders.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity. Comfortable forming and defending an independent view in complex, multi-system situations and driving issues to resolution without close direction.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;"><strong><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Willingness and ability to travel internationally to customer sites across Dexory’s global deployment footprint.</span></strong></li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Nice to Have</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Familiarity with robotics systems, ROS2, or point cloud / LiDAR data, or genuine curiosity and aptitude to learn quickly on the job.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience with robotics visualisation tooling.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">WMS or ERP integration experience (SAP, Manhattan, Oracle WMS, or similar).</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Exposure to real-time messaging protocols such as Zenoh, MQTT, or gRPC.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Consulting or structured delivery experience, with familiarity with the discipline of client accountability and project-based delivery.</span></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Starting from the interview process and continuing into your career with us, you will be working by our four Operating Principles:</p> <ul> <li>Performance: High standards, outstanding results,</li> <li>Impact: Big challenges, bigger results</li> <li>Commitment: All in, every time</li> <li>One team: One mission, shared success</li> </ul> <p>Joining our team and company isn't just about expertise; it's about embracing uncertainty with ambition. We're crafting world-changing solutions, fueled by a passion to redefine what's possible. We will look for you to help create and shape the future of logistics solutions through our products, our culture and our shared vision.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will also receive:</p> <ul> <li>Private healthcare via Bupa with 24/7 medical helpline&nbsp;</li> <li>Life insurance</li> <li>Income protection&nbsp;</li> <li>Pension: 4+% employee with option to opt into salary exchange, 5% employer</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme - mental wellbeing, financial and legal advice/support&nbsp;</li> <li>25 holidays per year&nbsp;</li> <li>Full meals onsite in Wallingford</li> <li>Fun team events on and offsite, snacks of all kinds in the office&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>AAP/EEO Statement &nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Dexory provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. It prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training</p>

title: Data Engineer
location: Los Angeles; New York; Remote; San Francisco
full_description: <div class="jobs-box--fadein jobs-box--full-width jobs-box--with-cta-large jobs-description jobs-description--reformatted "> <article class="jobs-description__container m4"> <div class="jobs-description__content jobs-description-content "> <div id="job-details" class="jobs-box__html-content jobs-description-content__text t-14 t-normal jobs-description-content__text--stretch" data-artdeco-is-focused="true"> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>EDO is the TV outcomes company. Our leading measurement platform connects convergent TV airings to the ad-driven consumer behaviors most predictive of future sales. EDO empowers the advertising industry to maximize media impact, optimize creative performance, and know the fair value of every impression — across linear and streaming for an increasingly programmatic world. By combining immediate engagement signals with world-class decision science and vertical AI, EDO equips industry leaders with syndicated, investment-grade data that aligns media to business results — with detailed competitive, category, and historical insights. Leading brands, agencies, networks, streamers, and studios trust EDO’s TV intelligence to know what works.</p> <p>EDO is headquartered in New York City and Los Angeles with an office space in San Francisco. We recognize the benefits of hybrid working, and want to create the best balance to ensure we can continue working together effectively. <strong>For those who reside full-time in NYC, SF, or LA: we have a hybrid work policy of three days in the office and two remote work days.&nbsp;</strong><br><br>To learn more about the work we do at EDO, please visit <a href="https://www.edo.com/about-us/press"><strong>EDO Press</strong></a>.</p> <h4><strong>The Role</strong></h4> <p>As a Data Engineer at EDO, you will join a team of talented engineers working closely with Data Scientists to build and scale our next-generation Ad EnGage data pipeline. This pipeline measures and optimizes the effectiveness of advertising by combining and analyzing a wide range of datasets, including advertising occurrence data, outcome data, identity resolution data, and more. Our clients rely on these insights to make critical decisions about their advertising strategy.</p> <p>You will work with large-scale datasets (hundreds of TBs to petabyte-scale systems) using a modern data stack centered on AWS, Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake. You’ll contribute to building reliable, high-quality data pipelines and improving the performance, scalability, and observability of our data platform.</p> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For </strong></p> <ul> <li>3-6 years of experience as a Data Engineer.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake or Redshift preferred).</li> <li>Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred).</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines using tools such as Airflow and dbt.</li> <li>Strong SQL skills, including query optimization, data modeling, and working with large datasets.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one scripting language, preferably Python.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with large-scale, complex data pipelines operating at billions to trillions of rows of data.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to work independently on well-scoped projects, collaborate with cross-functional partners, and deliver production-ready solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></p> <p>EDO offers a competitive compensation package. Components of compensation include:</p> <ul> <li>Mid-stage equity and competitive salary</li> <li>Flexible Time Off</li> <li>Medical, dental and vision coverage: EDO provides full coverage for individual medical plans and partial coverage for dependent or family plans.</li> <li>401(k) plan, FSA, HSA</li> <li>Commuter Benefits</li> <li>When in an office, employee meals, snacks, and more</li> </ul> <p>In compliance with New York and California Pay Transparency Law, the salary range for this position is $120,000 to $160,000 plus equity. We note the salary information as a general guideline only, as actual compensation may vary from posting. We will consider various factors to determine the offer for this role, including the scope and responsibilities of the position, relevant work experience, key skills, training, and business considerations.</p> <p>EDO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.</p> </div> </div> </article> </div>

title: Data Engineer, Data Cloud International
full_description: <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Zeta Global is seeking a Data Engineer to help accelerate the operationalization of Zeta’s Data Cloud across international markets.</p> <p>Sitting within the Data Cloud International / commercial data partnerships function, this position will work closely with Business Operations, Applications, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and external partner technical teams.</p> <p>The focus is practical data engineering: turning high-potential data partnerships into usable, repeatable, revenue-generating Data Cloud assets that support product innovation, market expansion, and commercial growth through disciplined evaluation, ingestion, transformation, validation, and documentation.</p> <p>You will work primarily across AWS-based data workflows, using tools such as S3, Athena, Glue, SQL, Python, APIs, and orchestration frameworks such as Airflow. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused position suited to someone who enjoys turning technical data requirements into practical workflows.</p> <p>You will also use AI-assisted tools and automation techniques to improve data evaluation, documentation, workflow generation, and internal productivity.</p> <p>The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Candidates should be able to commute regularly to the Copenhagen office, located in Copenhagen or near Copenhagen Central Station.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Roles &amp; Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>• Build and automate data workflows for new and existing data partnerships.<br>• Create repeatable ingestion, transformation, and replication processes for partner data feeds.<br>• Evaluate incoming datasets for structure, usability, coverage, completeness, and quality.<br>• Write scripts to transform, normalize, move, and prepare data for analysis or downstream use.<br>• Use SQL and Athena to query large datasets, validate outputs, and generate reporting tables or extracts.<br>• Build lightweight validation checks for files, schemas, counts, formats, and expected values.<br>• Produce clear technical documentation, including field mappings, data dictionaries, process notes, data flow summaries, and partner integration documentation.<br>• Use AI-assisted tools where appropriate to accelerate data investigation, documentation, code generation, workflow prototyping, and repeatable analysis.<br>• Communicate with technical contacts at data partners via email and occasional technical calls.<br>• Help translate partner data delivery requirements into practical ingestion and automation workflows.<br>• Work with internal teams across Operations, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data Cloud.<br>• Contribute to reusable templates, naming conventions, and documentation standards for partner data onboarding.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <p>• Strong written and spoken English is required, as the role works across international teams and external data partners.<br>• 3–5 years of relevant experience, or equivalent practical experience, in data engineering, analytics engineering, technical data operations, cloud data automation, or a similar role.<br>• Practical experience writing SQL to query, validate, and transform data.<br>• Hands-on experience with Python for scripting, automation, or data manipulation.<br>• Familiarity with AWS data services, especially S3 and Athena; experience with Glue is strongly preferred.<br>• Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and how data moves between systems.<br>• Experience working with structured and semi-structured data formats, including large delimited files, JSON, Parquet, or ORC.<br>• Comfortable reading technical documentation and working with API-based data sources.<br>• Ability to work with large datasets and investigate issues in schemas, counts, formats, or transformation outputs.<br>• Comfortable collaborating with internal technical teams and external partner technical contacts.<br>• Able to work independently on defined tasks while escalating ambiguity, blockers, or risks appropriately.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Skills</strong></p> <p>• Business-level English communication<br>• SQL<br>• Python<br>• AWS S3, Athena, and Glue / Glue Data Catalog<br>• ETL/ELT workflows<br>• Data ingestion and replication<br>• APIs and file-based data exchange<br>• Airflow, Prefect, or similar orchestration tools<br>• Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Hive, Presto, or similar data platforms<br>• Git or similar version control<br>• Data validation and quality checks<br>• Data dictionaries, field mappings, and technical documentation<br>• Structured and semi-structured data formats, including JSON, Parquet, ORC, and large delimited files<br>• Working knowledge of S3 policies, IAM permissions, and secure data access patterns<br>• Practical use of AI-assisted development, documentation, or data analysis tools</p>

title: Lead Data Engineer - Healthcare Data & Audience Applications
full_description: <p><strong>WHO WE ARE&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to <a href="https://www.zetaglobal.com">www.zetaglobal.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>Zeta Global is seeking a Lead&nbsp;Data Engineer to build and scale healthcare-focused applications and data systems that power audience intelligence, activation, measurement, and reporting across both HCP and DTC workflows.&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;<br>This is a hands-on technical leadership role operating at the intersection of distributed systems, data engineering, and healthcare domain constraints. You will design and deliver systems that integrate identity, audience data, and campaign performance while meeting strict requirements for privacy, compliance, and reliability.&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;<br>The ideal candidate brings strong system design depth, experience building data-intensive platforms, and the ability to lead through architecture and execution in regulated environments.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Build</strong></p> <ul> <li>Applications supporting HCP and&nbsp;patient / direct-to-consumer (DTC) audience&nbsp;discovery, segmentation, and activation&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Scalable data pipelines for ingestion, normalization, and enrichment of healthcare datasets&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Identity resolution and data linkage services across fragmented data sources&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Reporting, attribution, and measurement systems connecting campaigns to outcomes&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>APIs and services enabling downstream activation, analytics, and partner integrations&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Healthcare Cloud and data-mapping architecture across claims/Rx, NPI/HCP, patient, media-exposure, brand, and connector datasets.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Healthcare-specific semantic cubes, governed views, data contracts, and domain APIs consumed by Vertical Apps; front-end applications should consume stable domain APIs rather than query raw stores or Cube directly.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Identity resolution, match-rate measurement, medical-code mapping, and approved joins under CERT/HIPAA rules.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Foundational data products for NPI onboarding, PLD reporting, script reporting, HCP/Patient intelligence, journeys, and Next Best Action.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and maintain the healthcare data architecture, interface contracts, ADRs, schemas, and staged delivery plan.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead ingestion and transformation patterns across Snowflake, Athena/S3, MySQL, and approved healthcare stores without duplicating shared platform capabilities.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Partner with Data Cloud on source certification, partner-feed contracts, identity validation, raw-zone ownership, and data availability SLAs.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Design healthcare base/vertical models and&nbsp;published/governed views,&nbsp;with row/member-level controls, account scoping, masking, and backward-compatible versioning.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Set SLOs and operational readiness criteria; ensure dashboards, alerts, runbooks, rollback paths, and incident ownership are in place before release.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead design and code reviews, mentor the Senior Data Engineer, and coordinate dependencies across the pod.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Support compliance evidence, annual audits, US data-residency controls, and stoplight decisions: Start, Stop, or Requires CERT.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Apply privacy-by-design principles across all systems handling PHI/PII&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Partner with Product and Data teams to translate healthcare requirements into scalable architectures&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Drive engineering best practices across testing, CI/CD, code quality, and operational excellence&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering Expectations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong experience designing distributed systems, including microservices and event-driven architectures&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of data modeling, storage systems (OLTP and OLAP), and data-processing frameworks&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience with streaming and batch processing technologies, such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar tools&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Proficiency in backend development using Python, Java, or Ruby, as well as API design using REST or gRPC&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration tools, such as Apache Airflow&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience working with data warehouses and lakehouse platforms, such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure as code&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience implementing observability practices, including logging, metrics, and tracing, as well as reliability patterns&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of performance optimization and scalability trade-offs&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Healthcare &amp; Domain Expectations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working with HCP data (provider identity, targeting, segmentation)&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience with patient / DTC data workflows and privacy-aware systems&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Understanding of healthcare data ecosystems (claims, provider, or audience datasets)&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Familiarity with identity graphs and data onboarding patterns&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience building reporting or attribution systems tied to business outcomes&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Strong grasp of HIPAA, PHI/PII, and regulated data handling requirements&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Technical standards for lineage, data quality, access control, masking, retention, auditability, observability, and cost.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of data engineering experience with increasing technical ownership&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Expert SQL and strong Python, Java; experience with batch and streaming patterns, orchestration, testing, and schema evolution.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Proven track record of building and scaling data-intensive or distributed systems&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience working in regulated environments (healthcare strongly preferred)&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Strong system design and architecture skills&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Ability to lead technically while remaining hands-on in implementation&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Strong collaboration skills across engineering, product, and data teams&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with healthcare title: Analytics Engineer
full_description: <div class="ace-line"> <div class="ace-line" data-node-type="line"> <div class="page" data-page-number="1" data-loaded="true"> <div class="textLayer">&nbsp;</div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>WHAT IS BOX?</strong></p> <p>Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.</p> <p>By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHY BOX NEEDS YOU</strong></p> <p>Business Analytics at Box is growing, and with it the need for a consistent and trusted data foundation for decision-making at scale. As an Analytics Engineer you will develop and own that foundation: well-designed data models and pipelines, governed metric definitions, systematic testing and quality monitoring, and standards that enable the team to build on it consistently. You will also build workflows and automations that let our data products meet our stakeholders where they are, from Slack to Salesforce.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Evolve our dbt project toward modular, documented and tested data models organized in clear layers, from raw sources to marts</p> </li> <li> <p>Shape our semantic layer from its early stages: define how metrics are modeled and governed, and drive its adoption</p> </li> <li> <p>Shape the data modeling standards and conventions for the Business Analytics team, and uphold them through code review, pairing, and documentation</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Data Scientists and Data Analysts to design the datasets their analyses, dashboards, and ML models are built on</p> </li> <li> <p>Build out our data testing practices and enforce them in CI, implement observability over our data</p> </li> <li> <p>Diagnose upstream data issues and drive them to resolution by partnering with Data Engineering and Enterprise Systems teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and maintain the Prefect workflows that put our data and models to work</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering or a comparable data role, working with large amounts of data</p> </li> <li> <p>Expert in SQL - able to write and review complex queries with confidence</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid understanding of data modeling principles and hands-on experience with dbt or a comparable transformation framework</p> </li> <li> <p>Engineering discipline applied to analytics code: version control, code review, testing, and CI are your defaults, and you can bring a team along to work the same way</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable with Python, with experience in a workflow orchestration tool (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with a cloud data warehouse; BigQuery is a plus</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment</p> </li> <li> <p>A proactive mindset - you look for improvements before anyone asks, and you challenge the status quo when you see a better way</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>BENEFITS</strong><br>Check out the <a href="https://careers.box.com/en/life-at-box/" target="_blank" data-attrib-id="link-5bdab7d9-385c-4446-83cf-46c01577c385"><u>overview of Life at Box</u></a> which include general perks and benefits.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.</p> <p>At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.<strong> </strong>If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>EQUAL OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. title: Senior Staff Data Engineer
location: New York, NY (Hybrid); Redwood City, CA (Hybrid)
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Biohub is the first large-scale initiative bringing frontier AI models, massive compute, and frontier experimental capabilities under one roof. We're building a general-purpose system to accelerate scientific discovery, integrating frontier AI models, biological foundation models, and lab capabilities, with the ultimate goal of curing disease. Our technology powers scientists around the world, translating AI capabilities into tools that accelerate research everywhere.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(40, 40, 39); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Team</span></h2> <p>Biohub is a 501(c)(3) biomedical research organization building the first large-scale scientific initiative combining frontier AI with frontier biology to solve disease. We build the technology to help scientists around the world use AI-powered biology to study how cells operate, organize, and work as part of systems to understand why disease happens and how to correct it. With our compute capacity, AI research and engineering, and state-of-the-art technology for measuring, imaging, and programming biology, we are enabling scientists worldwide to use AI-powered biology to advance our understanding of human health.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(40, 40, 39); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Opportunity</span></h2> <p>The role is part of the Data Engineering team, which focuses on owning the strategy, sourcing and implementation for data supporting AI research and development. Our goal is to maximize the speed, agility, and capability of biological AI research by connecting public data resources and Biohub's experimental platforms to AI systems. The data that trains biological frontier models comes in dozens of modalities (sequences, images, spatial coordinates, time series, molecular structures, metadata, publication artifacts) each with its own noise characteristics, biases, and information content. The question of how to represent this data for learning is one of the most important open problems in biological AI.</p> <p>As a Senior Staff Data Engineer at Biohub, you'll be designing systems that ingest data from public repositories, transform heterogeneous biological formats into AI-ready datasets, combine that with proprietary datasets, and deliver training datasets to researchers pushing the boundaries of what's possible in biological AI. The infrastructure you build will directly shape what our models can learn.</p> <p>We're a small team with significant resources and long time horizons. We use AI tools aggressively in our own work—Claude Code, agents for workflow automation, LLMs for metadata extraction. We care about code quality, operational reliability, and building systems that scale. And we care about the biology: we want engineers who can recognize when a pipeline output is technically correct but scientifically wrong.</p> <p>If you want to work at the intersection of large-scale infrastructure and frontier science, with real autonomy and the chance to build something genuinely new, we'd like to talk.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(40, 40, 39); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">What You'll Do</span></h2> <ul> <li>Design and build data pipelines that process genomic and imaging data at petabyte scale</li> <li>Solve performance and bandwidth challenges with creative engineering</li> <li>Build agent-based systems for automated dataset curation, quality control, and workflow generation</li> <li>Create tooling for data cataloging and registration that makes datasets discoverable and accessible</li> <li>Collaborate with AI Research teams to translate model requirements into data specifications, and with our scientists to integrate public and internal data into large-scale ai-ready datasets&nbsp;</li> <li>Improve pipeline reliability and observability, working toward 99%+ success rates without manual intervention&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(40, 40, 39); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">What You'll Bring</span></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience building reliable, operable data systems at petabyte scale for Staff-level candidates; 12+ years for Senior Staff-level candidates.</li> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals</li> <li>Experience deploying distributed computing frameworks like Databricks, Spark, or Ray for large-scale data processing</li> <li>Experience building and deploying large scale data platform solutions using infrastructure as code like Terraform or CDK</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and on prem infrastructure</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity; ability to make progress when requirements are evolving</li> <li>Interest in AI-native development practices and tooling</li> <li>Nice to have: Background in computational biology, bioinformatics, or life sciences and experience with genomics datasets and formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF) or imaging formats (OME-Zarr, HDF5)</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(40, 40, 39); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Compensation</span><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><br></span></h2> <div id="message-list_1776970235.934109">The anticipated base pay ranges for this role in Redwood City, CA and New York City, NY are $241,000–$301,000 annually for the Staff level and $270,000–$338,000 annually for the Senior Staff level. Final compensation and placement within the applicable range are based on the level at which you are hired, as well as job-related skills, experience, and knowledge evaluated throughout the interview process.</div> <h2><span style="color: rgb(40, 40, 39); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Better Together</span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">As we grow, we’re excited to strengthen in-person connections and cultivate a collaborative, team-oriented environment. This role is a hybrid position requiring you to be onsite for at least 60% of the working month, approximately 3 days a week, with specific in-office days determined by the team’s manager. The exact schedule will be at the hiring manager's discretion and communicated during the interview process.</span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(223, 22, 33); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="color: rgb(40, 40, 39);"><strong>Benefits for the Whole You</strong></span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We’re thankful to have an incredible team behind our work. To honor their commitment, we offer a wide range of benefits to support the people who make all we do possible.&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Provides a generous employer match on employee 401(k) contributions to support planning for the future.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Paid time off to volunteer at an organization of your choice.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Funding for select family-forming benefits.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Relocation support for employees who need assistance moving</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you’re interested in a role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with each qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply as you may be the perfect fit for this or another role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #7e8c8d;">#LI-Hybrid #LI-Onsite</span></p>

title: Principal Data Engineer
full_description: <p>We are building the Data Hub, a centralized data platform responsible for consolidating legacy data infrastructure, establishing enterprise-grade data foundations, and enabling advanced analytics and AI capabilities across Precision AQ.</p> <p>The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical leader and hands-on contributor responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and operation of the Data Hub’s core platform capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, architecture, and data governance. You will help define the technical direction of the platform while remaining actively involved in designing solutions, building infrastructure, reviewing code, troubleshooting production issues, and improving engineering practices.</p> <p>This is not a management role. While you will mentor and guide junior engineers, analytics engineers, and platform contributors, you will not have direct reports. We are looking for an experienced practitioner who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, setting high engineering standards, and leading through expertise and influence rather than organizational hierarchy.</p> <p>As a member of the Data Hub leadership team, you will contribute to technology strategy, roadmap prioritization, architecture governance, vendor evaluation, and executive reporting while remaining deeply engaged in day-to-day engineering activities.</p> <p><strong>Main duties and responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Infrastructure and Platform Engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-native data platform infrastructure.</li> <li>Develop infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and environment management processes.</li> <li>Partner with Corporate IT, Security, and platform vendors to ensure compliance, reliability, and operational excellence.</li> <li>Improve platform observability through monitoring, alerting, logging, and performance tracking.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Architecture and Modelling</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design scalable data models supporting analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and operational use cases.</li> <li>Define and evolve data architecture standards, patterns, and best practices across the Data Hub ecosystem.</li> <li>Ensure data solutions align with governance, lineage, security, and regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Guide engineering teams in implementing maintainable and extensible data structures.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Engineering and Solution Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines across multiple business domains.</li> <li>Lead technical design reviews and contribute directly to implementation of complex data engineering initiatives.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Analytics, AI/ML, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.</li> <li>Provide hands-on support for critical platform initiatives, migrations, and modernization programs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>DevOps and Engineering Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish and enforce software engineering, GitOps, DevOps, testing, and deployment standards.</li> <li>Drive automation across development, deployment, monitoring, and operational processes.</li> <li>Promote best practices for code quality, documentation, technical debt management, and release management.</li> <li>Conduct architecture reviews and code reviews to ensure consistency and maintainability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Quality, Performance, and Reliability Optimization</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across pipelines, databases, and infrastructure.</li> <li>Define and implement data quality frameworks, automated validation processes, and operational controls.</li> <li>Optimize platform cost, scalability, reliability, and processing efficiency.</li> <li>Lead root-cause analysis and remediation efforts for production incidents and operational challenges.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Leadership and Mentorship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mentor Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and other technical contributors through coaching, code reviews, pair programming, and design guidance.</li> <li>Act as a trusted technical advisor across multiple teams and business units.</li> <li>Share knowledge, develop engineering standards, and promote continuous improvement across the Data Hub organization.</li> <li>Help elevate the technical capabilities of the broader engineering team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Planning and Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Participate in Data Hub leadership activities, including roadmap planning, prioritization discussions, technology evaluations, and executive reporting.</li> <li>Provide technical recommendations on platform investments, vendor selection, architecture direction, and engineering standards.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Data Product Management, AI/ML teams, business stakeholders, and Corporate IT to ensure alignment between business priorities and technical execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education and Experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Equivalent experience considered. Advance degree preferred but not required.</p> <p><strong>Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical disciplines.</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise designing and implementing modern cloud-based data platforms.</li> <li>Strong hands-on experience with data warehousing, orchestration, transformation, and DevOps technologies.</li> <li>Experience building and optimizing large-scale data pipelines and data models.</li> <li>Deep understanding of software engineering principles, infrastructure automation, and production operations.</li> <li>Experience operating in highly regulated, compliance-sensitive, or enterprise environments.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading technical initiatives through influence rather than direct authority.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or analytics organizations.</li> <li>Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, MLOps capabilities, feature stores, or model deployment frameworks.</li> <li>Familiarity with claims, formulary, commercial, or real-world evidence datasets.</li> <li>Experience leading enterprise-scale data migrations, modernization programs, or platform consolidations.</li> <li>Exposure to global engineering teams and distributed delivery models.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge, Skills and Competencies</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced knowledge of cloud data platforms, modern data architecture, and platform engineering.</li> <li>Deep expertise in data modelling, query optimization, and analytical data design.</li> <li>Ability to evaluate and select appropriate technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches.</li> <li>Expert-level SQL and strong Python skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Infrastructure and DevOps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, containerization, and deployment automation.</li> <li>Experience implementing operational monitoring, incident management, alerting, and observability solutions.</li> <li>Knowledge of security, access management, and platform governance best practices.</li> <li>Strong understanding of scalability, resilience, and performance engineering.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership and Influence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leads through credibility, expertise, and collaboration rather than formal authority.&nbsp;Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.</li> <p><strong>Communication and Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills and able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Effective stakeholder management across engineering, product, business, and executive teams.&nbsp;Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Environment</strong></p> <p>You will work across a modern data and AI ecosystem that may include:</p> <ul> <li>Data Platforms: Snowflake, AWS Redshift, title: Senior Clinical Data Engineer (LATAM)
location: Remote, Argentina; Remote, Brazil; Remote, Chile; Remote, Colombia; Remote, Mexico; Remote, Peru
full_description: <p>We’re expanding our data engineering capabilities across <strong>Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru</strong>, and we’re hiring a Senior Clinical Data Engineer to help build the foundation of this new regional function. In this role, you’ll lead the development and optimization of clinical data systems, drive data standardization, build validation frameworks, and design high‑performance databases and pipelines across global trials.</p> <p>The Senior Clinical Data Engineer leads the strategic development and optimization of clinical data systems to support regulatory compliance, advanced analytics, and operational excellence across global trials.</p> <p>This role drives enterprise-level data standardization initiatives, and architects scalable validation frameworks to proactively address systemic data issues. With deep expertise in Python, R, SQL, and SAS, the engineer builds and maintains modular codebases, sets coding standards, and mentors junior engineers. The role also oversees regulatory alignment with GCP and FDA 21 CFR Part 11, establishing robust documentation and audit trail protocols. Through dynamic dashboards and analytics tools, the engineer delivers actionable insights into trial performance and data quality. As a strategic liaison across Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory Affairs, the engineer translates clinical requirements into scalable technical solutions and leads the design of secure, high-performance databases and ETL pipelines integrating data from diverse clinical systems.</p> <p><strong>Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:</strong><br><br><strong>Data Standardization &amp; Mapping:</strong> Spearhead the development of enterprise-level data mapping strategies that transform raw clinical data into standardized formats for high-impact analytics. Lead the adoption and governance of data standards across programs to ensure regulatory alignment and consistency.</p> <p><strong>Data Quality Assurance:</strong> Design and implement robust, scalable validation frameworks that proactively detect and resolve systemic data issues. Serve as a strategic partner to Clinical Data Managers and cross-functional teams, driving continuous improvement in data integrity across global trials</p> <p><strong>Programming &amp; Scripting:</strong> Architect and maintain advanced, modular codebases using Python, R, SQL, and SAS to support complex data engineering workflows. Establish coding standards and mentor junior engineers in automation, reproducibility, and performance optimization. Example use cases includes edit checks, reconciliations, exception listings, programmed protocol deviations, resource projections based on site data entry volume</p> <p><strong>Regulatory Compliance &amp; Documentation:</strong> Lead compliance initiatives to ensure all data systems and workflows meet GCP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and evolving global regulatory requirements. Define documentation protocols and oversee audit trail governance to support inspection readiness and transparency.<br>Reporting &amp; Visualization - Develop and operationalize dynamic dashboards and analytics tools that provide real-time insights into data quality, trial progress, and operational KPIs. Translate clinical and scientific requirements into scalable technical solutions that support study execution and data delivery.</p> <p><strong>Database Design &amp; Optimization:</strong> Lead the design and optimization of secure, high-performance relational databases and data lakes. title: Data Engineer
full_description: <h3><strong>About Pedestal Health</strong></h3> <p>Pedestal Health (formerly Target RWE) combines deep health system partnerships, longitudinal data curation at scale, and modern study design to build continuous, high-quality evidence for life sciences organizations. The company partners with pharmaceutical and biotech companies, providers and payers to generate rigorous, multimodal evidence that supports clinical, regulatory and strategic decision-making across the full lifecycle of care. Pedestal Health is committed to advancing medical decision making to improve outcomes for patients. Pedestal Health is a Highlander Health company. Learn more at<a href="http://pedestalhealth.com/">&nbsp;pedestalhealth.com</a>.</p> <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a talented <strong>Data Engineer </strong>to join our Technology team. In this role, you will develop, create, and modify computer application software and databases to drive operational efficiency and improve business processes. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders to analyze user needs, design custom software solutions, and implement scalable, reliable applications that support Pedestal Health’s mission.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement data pipelines and software solutions that promote operational efficiency and scalability.</li> <li>Analyze business requirements and work with stakeholders to translate needs into technical solutions.</li> <li>Write clean, maintainable code primarily in Python, with a strong emphasis on SQL for data manipulation and transformation.</li> <li>Support and optimize cloud-based data infrastructure (AWS preferred).</li> <li>Develop and modify databases to support internal applications.</li> <li>Collaborate with operations and product teams to support deployment, testing, and maintenance.</li> <li>Help troubleshoot production issues and contribute to ongoing improvement efforts.</li> <li>Stay up to date on relevant tools, technologies, and best practices.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of software development experience, ideally in data engineering, data platform development, or backend systems.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and working in cloud-native environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitLab, GitHub Actions).</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and manage tasks with moderate supervision.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Have&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience working with or developing machine learning pipelines or models.</li> <li>Exposure to Generative AI or LLM frameworks (e.g., Langchain, LangGraph).</li> <li>Knowledge of distributed computing concepts or tools (e.g., Spark, Dask).</li> <li>Background in healthcare, life sciences, or clinical data.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).</li> </ul> <p>If you are ready to be part of a team where your work truly matters - where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported and your contributions help shape the future of healthcare, Pedestal Health is the place for you. We’re building something meaningful together, and we’d love for you to be a part of it.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What we offer you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Hybrid work — 3 days/week in our brand-new office!</li> <li>Comprehensive health, dental, and vision for you and your family</li> <li>401(k) with company match</li> <li>Generous PTO and company holidays</li> <li>Paid parental leave<strong><em>&nbsp;</em></strong></li> </ul> <div class="job__description body"> <div> <p>Hybrid role: Located in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina</p> <p>If you are ready to be part of a team where your work truly matters—where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape the future of healthcare—Pedestal Health is the place for you. We’re building something meaningful together, and we’d love for you to be a part of it.</p> <p><em>Pedestal Health is an equal opportunity employer and seeks candidates from diverse backgrounds and abilities.</em></p> </div> </div>

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
full_description: <p><span data-contrast="none">Most AI roles keep you at arm’s length from the people the agents are supposed to help. This one puts you in the room with them.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We’re&nbsp;building AI agents for risk managers, internal auditors, and compliance professionals,&nbsp;not assistants that surface suggestions, but agents that own complex, multi-step workflows end to end. Agents that an audit team can hand a task to and trust it will come back done. Getting from a promising agent prototype to something a Chief Audit Officer depends on is a completely different discipline to building the prototype.&nbsp;That’s&nbsp;what this role is about.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">As a Forward Deployed Engineer,&nbsp;roughly 80%&nbsp;of your time is with our biggest enterprise customers across Europe and the US.&nbsp;You’re&nbsp;embedded in their environments,&nbsp;sitting with internal audit teams as they plan an audit programme, with risk functions assessing their control landscape, with compliance teams navigating regulatory obligations.&nbsp;You’re&nbsp;not there to show them what the agents already do.&nbsp;You’re&nbsp;there to understand their world well enough to discover what the agents need to do next.</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">You run discovery workshops,&nbsp;identify&nbsp;which workflows are genuinely ripe for agentic automation, prototype rapidly, test with real practitioners, and stay until the agent is reliable enough to be trusted.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">The other 20% is feeding everything&nbsp;you’ve&nbsp;learned back into the platform. The goal&nbsp;isn’t&nbsp;to accumulate bespoke agent builds,&nbsp;it’s&nbsp;to&nbsp;identify&nbsp;the patterns across risk and audit functions that should be generalised, so every&nbsp;subsequent&nbsp;engagement is&nbsp;faster&nbsp;and the agents get better for everyone.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">You sit in Product with a matrix into&nbsp;Engineering&nbsp;,&nbsp;which means you shape both the agent roadmap and the technical decisions that make agents work in production.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335572079&quot;:2,&quot;335572080&quot;:4,&quot;335572081&quot;:13421772,&quot;469789806&quot;:&quot;single&quot;}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">This is not a sales role and&nbsp;it’s&nbsp;not consulting.</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:80}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">You write code. You build evaluation infrastructure. You design golden datasets grounded in real audit and risk workflows. You catch agent regressions before a customer’s compliance team does.&nbsp;You’re&nbsp;accountable for outcomes.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">The Hard Parts of Agentic AI Are Your Domain</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:400,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335572079&quot;:8,&quot;335572080&quot;:6,&quot;335572081&quot;:12086318,&quot;469789806&quot;:&quot;single&quot;}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Silent regressions when a model updates. Context window degradation across long audit workflows. Prompt instability under varied user inputs. Non-deterministic outputs in environments where a compliance officer needs to explain every decision to a regulator. You know these failure&nbsp;modes&nbsp;and you know how to build the guardrails, tracing, and evaluation infrastructure that prevents them.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">The Customer Environment</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:400,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335572079&quot;:8,&quot;335572080&quot;:6,&quot;335572081&quot;:12086318,&quot;469789806&quot;:&quot;single&quot;}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Enterprise GRC,&nbsp;global banks,&nbsp;large regulated&nbsp;corporates, sophisticated internal audit and risk functions across Europe and the US. You&nbsp;don’t&nbsp;need a compliance background, but you need the curiosity to learn it fast and the presence to earn trust with senior risk and audit professionals. These are people whose professional reputations depend on getting this right;&nbsp;that’s&nbsp;a good reason to make the agents&nbsp;actually reliable.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:80,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Travel is a meaningful part of this role.&nbsp;You’ll&nbsp;be on-site regularly with enterprise customers across EU and US markets. If&nbsp;you’re&nbsp;energised by variety,&nbsp;different industries, different regulatory cultures,&nbsp;different stages&nbsp;of agent maturity&nbsp;-&nbsp;this will suit you well.</span><span Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!</p> <p><strong>Wat ga je doen als Analytics Engineer?</strong></p> <p>Als Analytics Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren van data-oplossingen die marketing- en klantdata toegankelijk maken voor analyses, rapportages en activatie. Je werkt op het snijvlak van digital analytics, data engineering en marketing technology.</p> <p>Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt datamodellen, geautomatiseerde datastromen en integraties tussen verschillende platformen. Daarbij maak je gebruik van tools zoals DBT, Adverity, data warehouses, API-koppelingen en Customer Data Platforms (CDP's). Je zorgt ervoor dat data uit marketingplatformen, analytics-tools en andere databronnen op een betrouwbare en schaalbare manier beschikbaar komt voor klanten en collega's.</p> <p>Naast het technische werk denk je mee over de architectuur van data-oplossingen en adviseer je klanten over de mogelijkheden om hun marketing- en datastrategie verder te professionaliseren. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met andere Data &amp; Tech specialisten.</p> <p><strong>Wie ben jij?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen analytics engineering, marketing technology of data engineering</li> <li>Je hebt ervaring met dbt en het modelleren van data binnen moderne data platformen</li> <li>Je hebt goede SQL-vaardigheden en ervaring met het bouwen van datamodellen</li> <li>Je hebt ervaring met API-integraties en geautomatiseerde datastromen</li> <li>Je hebt ervaring met marketing- en klantdataplatformen zoals CDP's, marketing automation platformen of vergelijkbare oplossingen</li> <li>Kennis van de Google Marketing Platform stack, GA4, BigQuery of vergelijkbare ecosystemen is een pré</li> <li>Je hebt ervaring met scripting in Python of een vergelijkbare programmeertaal</li> <li>Je begrijpt hoe marketingprocessen werken en vindt het leuk om deze verder te automatiseren</li> <li>Je bent in staat technische architecturen begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan niet-technische stakeholders</li> <li>Je bent zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en vindt het leuk om klanten te adviseren</li> <li>Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245417&quot;:true,&quot;335559739&quot;:80,&quot;469777462&quot;:[220,720],&quot;469777927&quot;:[0,0],&quot;469777928&quot;:[1,1]}"><strong>Wat bieden wij?<br></strong>Bij WPP Media werk je in een ambitieus en creatief team aan een merk dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Je krijgt de ruimte om echt impact te maken op hoe we ons in de markt positioneren, hoe we proposities lanceren en hoe we thought leadership tot leven brengen.</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Flexibiliteit:</strong>&nbsp;Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).</li> <li><strong>Groeikansen</strong>: Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team.</li> <li><strong>Salaris:</strong>&nbsp;Een marktconform salaris (op basis van 38,75 uur per week).</li> <li><strong>Toegang tot M Academy:</strong>&nbsp;Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.</li> <li><strong>Mental Wellbeing</strong>: Toegang tot het platform Tellus</li> <li><strong>Vakantie</strong>: 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).</li> <li><strong>Hybrid Working allowance</strong>: €30 netto per maand bij fulltime.</li> <li><strong>Bring Your Own Device (BYOD):</strong>&nbsp;Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van €57,50 netto.</li> <li><strong>Alleo benefits:</strong>&nbsp;Via onze samenwerking met Alleo ontvang je maandelijks €10 persoonlijk budget dat je kunt besteden aan voordelen die passen bij jouw lifestyle en welzijn.</li> <li><strong>Lunchfaciliteiten</strong>: Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.</li> <li><strong>Zorgverzekering</strong>: Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team:</strong></p> <p>Naast het samenwerken met klanten en interne teams ben je dagelijks bezig met het ontwikkelen van nieuwe oplossingen die schaalbaar inzetbaar zijn voor meerdere klanten. Omdat iedere klant andere wensen en doelen heeft werk je met uiteenlopende technologieën; van API-integraties en CDP's tot cloud data platformen, dbt-modellen en marketing automatiseringen.</p> <p>Binnen ons interdisciplinaire Data, Tech &amp; Analytics team delen we kennis en toffe projecten, maar ook daarbuiten biedt WPP Media allerlei mogelijkheden om te leren en ontwikkelen. Daarnaast duiken we graag samen het terras op en organiseren activiteiten als boulderen of pubquizes!</p> <p></p> <div><strong><span class="___1cs5bdp f1w7gpdv f5p0z4x">Ben</span> <span title: Associate, Data Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>WPP Media Hong Kong is seeking a motivated, analytical, and curious Associate, Data Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will support the team in building, maintaining, and optimizing the critical data pipelines, architectures, and data models that power WPP's analytics and business decision-making. This is an exceptional early-career opportunity to gain hands-on experience with modern data platforms and engineering best practices within the fast-paced media and advertising landscape while working on real-world business challenges.</p> <p><strong>Core Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Pipeline Development &amp; Maintenance:&nbsp;</strong>Support the design, development, and monitoring of robust data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows to consolidate data from diverse media platforms.</p> <p><strong>Database &amp; Transformation Optimization:&nbsp;</strong>Develop, optimize, and maintain high-performing SQL queries, database views, and automated data transformations.</p> <p><strong>Data Integration:</strong>&nbsp;Assist in integrating data from multiple primary sources into our central enterprise data platforms.</p> <p><strong>Data Quality &amp; Governance:</strong>&nbsp;Actively validate data integrity, troubleshoot data failures, and investigate data quality issues to maintain high trust in our analytical tools.</p> <p><strong>Process Documentation:&nbsp;</strong>Clearly document data flows, technical processes, and business logic rules.</p> <p><strong>Stakeholder Collaboration: </strong>Collaborate effectively with both technical (analysts, developers, architects) and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable technical data solutions.</p> <p><strong>Task Ownership: </strong>Take proactive ownership of small-to-medium data engineering tasks and technical projects, managing them from planning to successful delivery.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It's what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP &amp; WPP Media's shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.</li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Required Skills &amp; Experience:</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative/technical discipline.</li> <li>1 to 2 years of relevant experience in data engineering, with strong, hands-on SQL proficiency and a deep conceptual understanding of relational databases. Fresh graduates with internships, university capstone projects, or personal projects involving data engineering or data analytics are also welcome.</li> <li>Solid foundational knowledge of data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, data modeling fundamental, and data quality practices.</li> <li>Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with a strong attention to detail.</li> <li>Good communication skills and a highly collaborative approach to working within cross-functional teams.</li> <li>An eagerness to learn and rapidly adopt modern data engineering practices, cloud tools, and frameworks.</li> <li>Fluency in spoken and written English, Cantonese, and Mandarin</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Desired Skills &amp; Experience:</p> <ul> <li>Basic scripting and development skills in Python or a similar programming language.</li> <li>Familiarity with&nbsp;Git&nbsp;or standard version control systems.</li> <li>Basic exposure to cloud ecosystems such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Azure, or AWS.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern data stack architectures or tools (e.g., dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks).</li> <li>Conceptual or practical experience with BI tools (such as Power BI or Tableau).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div>

In this role, you will:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="none">Support the development and maintenance of cloud-based data pipelines and infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Use Python and SQL to collect, transform and prepare data for reporting, measurement, analytics and AI use cases.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Assist with data quality checks, monitoring and troubleshooting to help keep data products accurate and reliable.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Work with colleagues in media, business intelligence and data science to understand internal needs and turn them into practical data solutions.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Contribute to documentation, version control and repeatable engineering practices, including infrastructure and transformation workflows.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Take part in training, workshops and knowledge sharing, while gradually taking ownership of well-defined engineering tasks.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Skills and Experience </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p></p> <div>This is an entry-level position, suitable for candidates with approximately 0–2 years of experience.
