full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Join PatientPoint to be part of a dynamic team creating change in and around the doctor’s office. As a leading digital health company, we <strong>innovate</strong> to positively <strong>impact </strong>patient behaviors. Our purpose-driven approach offers <strong>an inspirational career</strong> opportunity where you can contribute to improving health outcomes for millions of patients nationwide.</span></p> <p><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 100%;" src="https://cdn.builtin.com/cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,fit=cover,w=2580,h=480,q=80/sites/www.builtin.com/files/2026-01/Greenhouse%20Cover%20Image.png" alt="" width="699"></p></div><p><strong>Location</strong>: Remote</p> <p><strong>Travel Requirements</strong>: 2 to 4 times per year</p> <p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Analytics Engineer to design, build, and own end-to-end data solutions for our Core products, spanning data ingestion, modeling, semantic layer development, and final user experience.</p> <p>In this role, you will help establish and scale analytics foundations by partnering on and implementing data pipelines that integrate data from internal and external business systems while developing governed, analytics-ready models and semantic layers that power trusted metrics and insights. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to critical, strategic initiatives and shape the future of analytics, data visualization, and reporting within our Core Products organization.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Data Visualization &amp; Report Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the development, maintenance, and delivery of analytics-ready data platforms, driving data management best practices to deliver clean, standardized, and well-documented data assets using Snowflake, dbt, and Looker.</li> <li>Foster strong partnerships with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver actionable analytics and reporting that surface key provider sales, operational, and business performance metrics, trends, and insights.</li> <li>Partner with the Data team during the design, build, and testing of certified datasets in dbt and Snowflake, including the ingestion, transformation, and modeling of data from internal and external business systems.</li> <li>Oversee the design and development of interactive and performant analytical experiences, with primary ownership of Looker dashboards, Explores, and semantic models supporting provider sales, commercial, and operational analytics.</li> <li>Design and maintain analytics models and metrics supporting provider sales performance, including pipeline, revenue, customer engagement, operational KPIs, and other key business performance metrics.</li> <li>Formulate and implement techniques for auditing and evaluating data collection quality, ensuring adequacy, accuracy, and legitimacy of data.</li> <li>Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements, such as optimizing data delivery and redesigning tools and data models for maximum impact.</li> <li>Mentor and support the growth of junior team members through coaching, knowledge sharing, and regular feedback.</li> <li>Champion and uphold data governance practices by promoting data quality, documentation standards, and consistent metric definitions across data models, semantic layers, and reporting tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be infinitely curious about data and build actionable insights through a deep understanding of the business and the data we collect.</li> <li>Drive a culture of storytelling through data by enabling consistent, trusted, and well-modeled datasets that empower self-service analytics and informed decision-making.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional collaboration with business leaders, analysts, data scientists, and engineers to understand analytical needs and architect data models and analytics pipelines that support provider sales, commercial operations, and strategic business objectives.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership and guidance on data visualization enablement by ensuring robust backend data structures that support intuitive, performant dashboards.</li> <li>Advocate for and implement best practices in semantic modeling, metric standardization, and reporting infrastructure to promote an insight-driven culture.</li> <li>Own and evolve governance frameworks and development processes within the visualization and reporting space to ensure data quality, maintainability, and long-term scalability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in a related data visualization or data engineering role.</li> <li>Proficiency in Looker and LookML, with experience using other business intelligence platforms such as Tableau or Power BI.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and maintaining analytics models using dbt and Snowflake.</li> <li>Advanced SQL knowledge, including writing complex queries, optimizing performance, and working with large datasets.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.</li> <li>Experience working within agile development methodologies and collaborative project delivery practices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.</li> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.</li> <li>Experience partnering with sales teams to deliver analytics, reporting, and data-driven insights.</li> <li>Knowledge of statistical analysis and data mining techniques.</li> <li>Previous experience partnering with cross-functional teams to support analytics and reporting needs.</li> <li>Healthcare industry experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.</li> <li>Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and as part of a team.</li> <li>Sense of urgency to learn and take on new challenges.</li> <li>Ability to manage stakeholder expectations and requirements to deliver governed, flexible analytics assets that align with enterprise best practices.</li> </ul> <p>Base Salary Band: $73,539.55 to $165,000</p> <p>Compensation: At PatientPoint, we are committed to providing competitive pay and benefits that are in line with industry standards. title: Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Practice)
full_description: <p>Greenlight helps organizations solve complex business challenges through intelligent automation, agentic AI, and custom technology solutions.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Our teams work directly with clients to understand their operations, identify opportunities, and rapidly build solutions that create measurable business value. We combine deep consulting expertise with hands-on engineering to bridge the gap between strategy and execution.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We’re building a future where consultants and engineers work alongside AI to deliver faster outcomes, stronger businesses, and transformative customer experiences. Anthropic’s Claude is embedded across how we design, build, and validate solutions - and this role is at the technical frontier of that capability.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>What makes a star at Greenlight?</strong></h3> <h3>·&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Builder's instinct, architect's discipline</h3> <h3>·&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; The most technically credible person in the room</h3> <h3>·&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; AI-native at depth - you know how LLMs fail and build around it</h3> <h3>·&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Client-embedded, not arm's length</h3> <h3>·&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Commercially aware - scope, economics, outcomes</h3> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>The Forward Deployed Engineer is Greenlight’s most senior technical delivery role. You design, build, and operationalize AI agent workflows and intelligent automation solutions - embedded directly in client environments, working alongside their teams to deliver production-grade solutions that create measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This is not a back-office engineering role. You will be in client discovery sessions, presenting architectures to IT leadership, deploying AI agents against real enterprise systems, and building the reusable skills and accelerators that make Greenlight faster and more differentiated on every subsequent engagement. You are expected to be the most technically credible person in the room - combining deep AI fluency with the consulting presence of a senior practitioner.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You work at the frontier of agentic AI - designing and building Claude-powered solutions, connecting AI agents to enterprise systems through MCP integrations, and producing the technical documentation that the delivery team and the client can both stand behind. The platform is Anthropic Claude. The problem space is complex, regulated, and high-stakes. The bar is production-grade.</p> <p><strong>At a Glance</strong></p> <table width="624"> <tbody> <tr> <td width="142"> <p><strong>Reports To</strong></p> </td> <td width="482"> <p>AI Practice Lead</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="142"> <p><strong>Works Closely With</strong></p> </td> <td width="482"> <p>Pre-Sales SE, Automation Business Consultant, AI Delivery Engagement Manager</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="142"> <p><strong>Client Interaction</strong></p> </td> <td width="482"> <p>Yes — C-suite, IT architects, operations leaders, technical teams</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="142"> <p><strong>Travel Requirement</strong></p> </td> <td width="482"> <p>Regular client travel required — discovery, workshops, POC delivery, go-live</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="142"> <p><strong>Platform Focus</strong></p> </td> <td width="482"> <p>Anthropic Claude (Cowork + Skills), MCP, Python / Node.js, REST APIs</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="142"> <p><strong>Seniority</strong></p> </td> <td width="482"> <p>Intermediate 3-5 year’s experience</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="142"> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> </td> <td width="482"> <p>Onshore Canada — Toronto preferred</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="142"> <p><strong>Engagement Type</strong></p> </td> <td width="482"> <p>Hybrid — onsite client-facing with remote delivery phases</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Solution Architecture &amp; Technical Discovery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead technical discovery workshops with C-suite, IT architects, and operations leaders - identifying high-value AI automation opportunities and translating complex operational workflows into executable solution architectures</li> <li>Design end-to-end AI agent architectures using Anthropic’s Claude platform (Cowork and Skills framework), aligned to client infrastructure, security requirements, and compliance constraints</li> <li>Translate business requirements into agent-based automation blueprints: what the AI owns, what stays human, how exceptions route, and how the two coordinate</li> <li>Assess the right solution architecture for each use case - knowing when a Claude agent is the answer, when a procode integration is cleaner, and when a simpler rules-based approach is more appropriate than AI</li> <li>Present technical architectures to executive and non-technical audiences with clarity, confidence, and the credibility that comes from having built things like this before</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Agent Build &amp; Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engineer production-ready AI agent workflows using Claude Cowork and the Skills framework - built to a standard that holds up in regulated, enterprise production environments</li> <li>Develop and configure Claude Skills: structured instruction sets, templates, validation rules, and reference documents that encode client-specific processes and quality standards into repeatable AI agent behaviour</li> <li>Build and maintain MCP connectors that integrate AI agents with enterprise systems - CRMs, ERPs, document management platforms, core banking systems, and custom APIs - handling authentication, data mapping, error handling, and audit requirements</li> <li>Implement advanced LLM patterns where required: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), chain-of-thought reasoning, tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and structured output validation</li> <li>Conduct output validation, performance tuning, and safety testing of deployed AI agents before client go-live - quality is non-negotiable when outputs go to regulators or clients</li> </ul> <p><strong>Procode &amp; Integration Engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Write production-quality Python or Node.js to extend platform capability - data pipelines, transformation logic, webhook handlers, API wrappers, and back-end components that sit outside the automation itself</li> <li>Build, test, and maintain integrations with enterprise platforms (Salesforce, Jira, DocuSign, SharePoint, ServiceNow, and others) using REST, GraphQL, OAuth 2.0, and enterprise authentication patterns</li> <li>Design and implement monitoring, logging, and observability into deployed solutions so operations teams can diagnose issues without requiring an engineer in the room</li> <li>Apply cloud platform fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP) to deployment, scaling, and infrastructure decisions where the engagement requires it</li> </ul> <p><strong>Accelerators &amp; Practice Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and continuously refine reusable Skills libraries, automation templates, and reference architectures that make every subsequent Greenlight engagement faster and more defensible</li> <li>Contribute to pre-sales activities: technical demos, POC builds, RFP responses, and solution estimations - your hands-on credibility is a direct input to Greenlight’s win rate</li> <li>Produce high-quality technical documentation - solution design documents, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and post-deployment reports - written to a standard the client’s IT team can maintain</li> <li>Identify account expansion opportunities within active engagements - additional use cases, adjacent processes, and follow-on automation candidates - and surface them to the AI Delivery Engagement Manager</li> <li>Mentor Automation Engineers and client technical teams on AI agent patterns, LLM integration best practices, and platform capabilities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client Engagement &amp; Consulting Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate with high autonomy inside client environments - navigating ambiguity, defining structure where none exists, and delivering without requiring hand-holding from the practice lead</li> <li>Manage scope, timelines, and deliverables across concurrent client engagements - you know when to flag a risk and when to absorb it</li> <li>Build trusted-advisor relationships with client technical teams - the goal is to be the person they call when they have an AI or automation problem, not just the vendor who delivered the last project</li> <li>Deliver working solutions within 2–4 week sprint cycles - you build and show, you don’t slide and tell</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Competencies</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical depth with consulting presence - credible with a CTO and a COO in the same meeting</li> <li>AI-native - you understand how LLMs behave under pressure, where they fail, and how to build reliable systems around them</li> <li>Builder's bias - working software over slide decks, every time</li> <li>High autonomy - you define structure where none exists without needing direction</li> <li>Commercially aware - scope, delivery economics, and what it costs when technical decisions go sideways</li> <li>Clear communicator - architecture decisions and trade-offs explained in language both business and IT can act on</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Technical Familiarity</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>LLM platforms - Anthropic Claude (primary), Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, OpenAI; hands-on with APIs, agent frameworks, and production deployment across at least one</li> <li>Claude Skills framework and Cowork - structured instruction design, output validation, skill packaging</li> <li>MCP (Model Context Protocol) - connector design, enterprise system integration, authentication flows</li> <li>Python and/or Node.js - production-grade, testable, maintainable code</li> <li>REST and GraphQL APIs - authentication, error handling, rate limiting, webhooks</li> <li>Cloud platforms - AWS, Azure, or GCP; deployment, containers, infrastructure basics</li> <li>LLM evaluation and observability - LangSmith, Weights &amp; Biases, or equivalent</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Great Looks Like in This Role</strong></p> <table width="624"> <tbody> <tr> <td width="624"> <p><strong>The standard we are hiring to:</strong></p> <p>The best FDEs we have worked with walk into a client environment and within a week they know more about the client’s process than the client’s own team has documented. They build a working POC in a few weeks that makes the client stop asking whether it’s possible and start asking when it can go to production. They write code that the next engineer can understand without a two-hour briefing. They know when the LLM is going to fail before it does, and they’ve already built the fallback. And they leave every engagement with a client technical team that is more capable than when they arrived - because that is what makes clients come back.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <table width="624"> <tbody> <tr> <td width="624"> <p><strong>AI in Our Hiring Process</strong></p> <p>We use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment - organizing applications and flagging relevant experience. These tools inform our process, they don’t drive it. Every hiring decision is made by our team, full stop.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The expected salary range for this role is $90,000 – $130,000 CAD annually, based on experience and qualifications.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Backend)
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Who Are We?</strong></h2> <p>Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.</p> <p>The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.</p> <p>P.S: We highly recommend reading <a href="https://api-first-world.com/">The "API-First World" graphic novel</a> to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.</p></div><h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="960" data-end="1267">The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team tackles some of Postman's most strategic technical challenges. We partner directly with enterprise customers to solve problems that don't fit neatly into existing product boundaries, building production-grade solutions that often become core product capabilities.</p> <p data-start="1269" data-end="1596">As a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll deploy Postman's critical infrastructure into customer environments, solve complex distributed systems challenges, and build the enterprise foundations that enable customers to safely adopt AI at scale.</p> <p data-start="1598" data-end="1815"><strong>This isn't consulting or professional services. </strong>You're an engineer building production systems alongside customers, turning real-world deployments into durable platform capabilities used by thousands of organizations. &nbsp;This team will build 0-to-1 products from scratch - innovative, strategic initiatives designed to unlock hundreds of millions of dollars in new revenue.&nbsp;</p> <p data-start="1817" data-end="1952">If you enjoy difficult engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building products from the field, you'll thrive here.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Customize and deploy Postman's data-path components into customer environments and make them run reliably: deployment, hardening, and the field engineering required to operate on infrastructure we don't control.</li> <li>Engineer for performance, availability, and fault tolerance where it's hardest: live traffic on the critical path, running in environments we don't control. Hold the line on latency and reliability under real customer load.</li> <li>Build the IT controls and enablement that unlock Applied AI for our customers: the identity, policy, governance, and observability that let an enterprise safely run AI agents against their APIs. This is the layer that turns "interesting AI demo" into "AI in production" inside a regulated enterprise.</li> <li>Turn field experience into a product. Take what you learn in real customer deployments and feed it back to core engineering, hardening one-off solutions into durable product capabilities.</li> <li>Set the engineering bar for FDE's data-path work in the field, mentor engineers, and help grow the team as the surface expands.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <p data-start="3704" data-end="3853">You are an experienced backend or distributed systems engineer who enjoys solving difficult technical problems while working directly with customers.</p> <p data-start="3855" data-end="3871">You likely have:</p> <ul data-start="3873" data-end="4805"> <li>5+ years of backend or systems engineering experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of large-scale distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience building high-throughput, low-latency backend services, with strong command of concurrency, performance tuning, fault tolerance, and high availability.</li> <li>Expert-level engineering in a backend or systems language such as Go, Python, Java, Rust, or C++, on Linux, with strong debugging skills in complex production codebases.</li> <li>A track record as a technical lead or architect on a significant backend system, setting technical direction and raising the quality bar across a team.</li> <li>Comfort with ownership and ambiguity: able to work autonomously in a small team, make decisions independently, and drive high-stakes projects to completion in the field.</li> <li>A builder's interest in enterprise IT controls and enablement (identity, authorization, policy, governance, observability) as the foundation that lets customers adopt Applied AI safely.</li> <li>Strong communication and a genuine willingness to engage directly with customers and field teams.</li> </ul> <h2 data-section-id="1dtylgm" data-start="4812" data-end="4826"><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <p data-start="4828" data-end="4881">We're especially excited if you have experience with:</p> <ul data-start="4883" data-end="5547"> <li>Experience with software deployed and operated in customer environments (on-prem, appliance, agent, or self-hosted), including install, upgrade, and remote diagnosis.</li> <li>Familiarity with identity and authorization (OAuth2, OIDC, SCIM), API gateways, or policy enforcement systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with the agentic AI stack: LLM-based agents, MCP, evaluation frameworks, or agent orchestration.</li> <li>Experience building observability into products deployed across many heterogeneous customer environments.</li> </ul> <h2 data-section-id="1ny543q" data-start="5554" data-end="5581">Why You'll Love This Role</h2> <ul data-start="5583" data-end="6071"> <li data-section-id="z64rmu" data-start="5583" data-end="5670">Solve technically challenging distributed systems problems with real customer impact.</li> <li data-section-id="luskqe" data-start="5671" data-end="5782">Work directly with some of the world's largest enterprises as they modernize their API and AI infrastructure.</li> <li data-section-id="net964" data-start="5783" data-end="5882">Influence Postman's product roadmap by transforming customer problems into platform capabilities.</li> <li data-section-id="1qtot4v" data-start="5883" data-end="5978">Help define and build a growing Forward Deployed Engineering organization from the ground up.</li> <li data-section-id="a0d1fl" data-start="5979" data-end="6071">Build the infrastructure that enables enterprises to safely deploy AI at production scale.</li> </ul> <p>The reasonably estimated base salary for this role ranges from $220,000 to $240,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2 data-renderer-start-pos="4036"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What Else?</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4048">In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4048">At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.</p> <h2 data-renderer-start-pos="3620"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Our Values</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3633">At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.</p> <h2><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4048">Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.</p></div>

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h1><strong>Who We Are</strong></h1> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.</span></p> <p><a href="https://www.justworks.com/careers#values"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our Values</span></a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.</span></p></div><h1><strong>Department</strong></h1> <p>Technology, Data &amp; AI</p> <h1><strong>About The Team</strong></h1> <p>The Data &amp; Analytics team is Justworks' data and AI center of excellence — a connected set of functions spanning business intelligence, data science, analytics engineering, platform data/ML engineering and AI builders. We've grown significantly over the last several years and continue to build momentum across the business, leveling up maturity in how we deliver insights, govern data, and enable the company to make better decisions. You'll find a highly collaborative &amp; diverse group motivated by craft, shared learning, and a genuine commitment to growing our impact for customers while evolving how we work together for our people. Come build with us!</p> <p>The Data Platform Engineering team sits at the core of this foundation, owning the pipelines, platform infrastructure, and reliability that every other DNA function depends on.</p> <h1><strong>Who You Are</strong></h1> <p>You're a hands-on engineering leader with deep experience building and operating modern data platforms. You've led teams through scale — evolving architecture, improving reliability, and making hard tradeoffs between speed, cost, and quality. You're as comfortable reviewing a PR or debugging a pipeline failure as you are setting quarterly roadmap priorities or presenting a platform strategy to senior leadership.</p> <p>You think in systems - how pipelines, orchestration, governance, and observability connect to produce a trustworthy platform - and you know how to build a team that operates with both craft and urgency. You develop engineers, set a high technical bar, and create an environment where people grow.</p> <p>You bring strong opinions grounded in experience with modern PaaS data stack technologies - Snowflake, Fivetran, Airflow, dbt, Estuary - and you've seen what works and what doesn't at scale. Snowflake is core to how we operate and you should have depth there.</p> <p>Reporting to the VP of Data &amp; Analytics, you'll lead the data platform organization, setting technical direction, driving operational excellence, and ensuring the platform is reliable, scalable, and built to support the company's growth.</p> <h1><strong>Your Success Profile</strong></h1> <h2><strong>What You Will Work On</strong></h2> <p><strong>Platform Leadership &amp; Technical Direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the technical direction of Justworks' core data platform — pipelines, infrastructure, orchestration, and the standards that keep it trustworthy</li> <li>Lead architectural decisions on cloud data infrastructure, balancing scalability, cost, reliability, and security</li> <li>Drive operational excellence across the platform — observability, data quality, cost optimization, incident management, and SLAs</li> <li>Set and enforce engineering standards — testing, documentation, CI/CD, and code review best practices</li> <li>Maintain and evolve infrastructure as code, ensuring the platform is auditable, repeatable, and resilient</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a team of data engineers, including direct line managers and individual contributors at various levels</li> <li>Set a high bar for engineering craft — mentor engineers, conduct architecture reviews, and foster a culture of continuous improvement</li> <li>Recruit and hire high-caliber data engineers as the platform team grows</li> <li>Create an environment where engineers develop their skills, take ownership, and do the best work of their careers</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Partnership &amp; Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with DNA functional teams (e.g. Analytics Engineering, BI, Data Science) and distributed Data Engineering teams to ensure the platform serves the full breadth of org needs</li> <li>Collaborate with other engineering teams to align on data contracts, security, compliance, and shared infrastructure</li> <li>Drive planning processes that connect platform priorities to DNA's overall strategy and enterprise OKRs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How You Will Do Your Work</strong></h2> <p>As a Sr. Manager, Data Platform Engineering,, <em>how</em> results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately results in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Plans &amp; Aligns</strong> - Ensures individual actions support company mission; communicates effectively; understands urgency and plans accordingly</li> <li><strong>Balances Stakeholders</strong> - Understands internal and external stakeholder requirements, expectations, and needs and acts fairly despite conflicting demands of stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Influence and Leadership</strong> - fostering a community of knowledge-sharing, collaboration, mentorship, and forward-thinking across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Manages Complexity</strong> - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.</li> <li><strong>Good Judgment</strong> - Pauses before acting; asks questions to fully understand context; applies critical thinking and takes ownership of outcomes</li> <li><strong>Teamwork &amp; Communication</strong> - Honors diverse thoughts and opinions; leverages unique skills to maximize efficiency</li> <li><strong>Skills and Knowledge</strong> - the capacity to actively learn and apply specific domain knowledge, know-how, and best practices to continually enhance and improve.</li> </ul> <p>In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Camaraderie</strong> - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.</li> <li><strong>Openness</strong> - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.</li> <li><strong>Grit </strong>- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.</li> <li><strong>Integrity</strong> - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Simplicity</strong> - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2> <p>You're a builder who applies systems thinking to internal infrastructure. You're comfortable working across a diverse data organization and partnering with leadership to turn fragmented ways of working into scalable, durable systems.</p> <ul> <li>10+ years of professional experience in data engineering, with at least 5 years working hands-on with modern PaaS data stack technologies (Snowflake, Fivetran, Airflow, dbt, Estuary, or equivalent)</li> <li>Deep Snowflake expertise - schema design, query optimization, cost governance, data sharing, and performance tuning at scale</li> <li>5+ years of engineering management experience, including experience managing managers or leading a multi-team engineering organization</li> <li>Strong architectural judgment - able to make sound decisions on pipeline design, infrastructure patterns, and platform evolution</li> <li>Experience leading a distributed engineering team across multiple workstreams and delivery tracks</li> <li>Deep proficiency in SQL and Python; recognized by peers for technical rigor</li> <li>Strong expertise with AWS services (S3, Lambda, Fargate, Redshift, Kinesis) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation)</li> <li>Strong experience with data governance, security, and compliance in a production environment</li> <li>Excellent communicator — able to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, present platform strategy to senior leadership, and translate infrastructure investments into business terms</li> <li>Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving work forward in a fast-moving environment</li> <li>Point of view on how AI is changing data platform engineering — both in how the team works and what the platform enables</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building data platforms that support ML/AI workloads (feature stores, model pipelines, vector stores)</li> <li>Background in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment (fintech, HR tech, healthcare)</li> <li>Experience with streaming/CDC technologies (Estuary, Kafka, Debezium)</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Technologies Used</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Languages: Python, SQL, Terraform</li> <li>Data &amp; Analytics: Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran</li> <li>Streaming &amp; CDC: Estuary</li> <li>Workflow Orchestration: Airflow, MWAA</li> <li>Cloud: AWS (S3, Lambda, Fargate, Redshift, Kinesis, Step Functions, EventBridge)</li> <li>Observability &amp; Monitoring: Datadog</li> <li>CI/CD: CircleCI, GitHub Actions</li> </ul> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $240,000.00 - $310,000.00 per year.</span></p> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">#LI-DG2 #LI-Hybrid</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.&nbsp; </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit </span><a href="https://www.justworks.com/careers#total-reward-philosophy">Total Rewards @ Justworks</a><span style="font-weight: 400;">.&nbsp;</span></p> <h1><strong>Diversity At Justworks</strong></h1> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.</span></p> <p>We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at <a href="mailto:accommodations@justworks.com">accommodations@justworks.com</a>. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.</p> <p><a href="https://www.justworks.com/press/company-news/justworks-impact-report-2024" target="_blank"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our DEIB Report&nbsp;</span></a></p></div>

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Remote Build)
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Remote</strong></h2> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.<br><br><span class="discussion-id-2f7cb4da-dab4-8068-a80f-001c50b2d808 suggestion-update notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.</span><br><br>We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!</span></div></div><h2><strong>What this job can offer you</strong></h2> <p>As a <span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="1">Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)</span> at Remote, you will work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that connect Remote’s platform to customer systems and workflows. You will turn messy, real-world requirements into production-grade implementations — often by building integrations, automations, and agentic workflows — and you’ll translate field learnings back into reusable patterns and product roadmap inputs.</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy and direct ownership of customer outcomes — from discovery through production rollout</li> <li>Work at the frontier of practical AI: shipping systems that are reliable, observable, secure, and measurable</li> <li>A seat at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales/CS, and customer teams — with clear influence on what we build next</li> <li>Exposure to a wide set of domains (HR, payroll, finance ops, IT, integrations) and complex enterprise ecosystems</li> <li>A remote-first environment with strong documentation culture and high trust</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <h3>Must have</h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrated experience shipping production software (backend and/or full-stack) and owning it in production (on-call mindset, debugging, instrumentation)</li> <li>Strong integration and systems thinking: APIs, event-driven systems, webhooks, auth (OAuth/service accounts), data modeling, idempotency, and failure modes</li> <li>Applied AI/LLM experience beyond prototypes: prompt+tool design, RAG and retrieval patterns, evaluation, latency/cost trade-offs, and reliability practices</li> <li>Ability to operate in ambiguity: you can go from “problem statement” to “shipped solution” with minimal hand-holding</li> <li>Clear, structured communication in writing; ability to explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with enterprise environments (security reviews, compliance constraints, procurement, change management)</li> <li>Experience building with agent frameworks and/or workflow orchestration systems</li> <li>Familiarity with HRIS, payroll, identity/access management, or adjacent enterprise domains</li> <li>Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, RBAC, and data privacy by design</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Partner with customers</strong> to understand operational challenges, constraints, and success criteria; run structured technical discovery and define the “definition of done”</li> <li><strong>Translate open-ended problems</strong> into clear technical designs and implementation plans (architecture, data flows, integration surfaces, security considerations, rollout strategy)</li> <li><strong>Build AI-enabled solutions</strong> that integrate with customer systems and Remote’s platform (e.g., data pipelines, workflow automations, tool integrations, agentic services) and perform real tasks end-to-end</li> <li><strong>Own deployments</strong> including reliability, performance, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement</li> <li><strong>Develop evaluation and measurement</strong> for AI behavior: success metrics, test harnesses, golden datasets, regression suites, and guardrails (quality, safety, privacy)</li> <li><strong>Work with real data</strong> to validate outputs, quantify impact, and iterate quickly based on evidence</li> <li><strong>Collaborate cross-functionally</strong> with Product and Engineering to ship high-quality solutions and to upstream reusable components</li> <li><strong>Create leverage</strong> by turning one-off solutions into repeatable playbooks, reference architectures, templates, and internal tooling</li> <li><strong>Be the voice of the field</strong>: bring back concrete customer needs, edge cases, and constraints that should shape product strategy</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Practicals</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Team:</strong> Remote Build / Customer Engineering (or equivalent)</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Remote</li> <li><strong>Time zones:</strong> Ability to overlap with customer working hours as needed</li> <li><strong>Travel</strong>: Whilst the majority of the work is Remote, please expect around 10% of travel for customer engagements</li> <li><strong>Start date:</strong> As soon as possible</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Application process</strong></h2> <ol> <li>Recruiter screen</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical challenge</li> <li>Team interview</li> <li>Bar Raiser interview&nbsp;</li> <li>Executive interview&nbsp;</li> <li>Offer + <a href="https://www.notion.so/Veremark-Remote-96e108c037b8423cbd4c3f07a1f9b38b">Prior employment verification check</a>&nbsp;</li> </ol><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Remote's <a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/people-Total-Rewards-1945bce8d3924ece9421ba8630f57b0c">Total Rewards philosophy</a> is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair <span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-1691622878">equity</span><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-f2a82bc4-09e4-4a71-ad93-755b1d26a690 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="3"> pay </span>along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.</p> <p>At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce.&nbsp; We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.<br><br>Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.<br><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards &amp; People Enablement team on a case by case basis.</em></p></div><div class="title">The annual salary range for this full-time position is</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$53,300</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$215,750 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Benefits</strong></h2> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our full benefits &amp; perks are explained in our handbook at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://remote.com/r/benefits" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://remote.com/r/benefits" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote.com/r/benefits</a>. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:</span></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">work from anywhere</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">flexible paid time off</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">flexible working hours (we are&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://remote.com/async" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/Working-Async-at-Remote-80c01cd443ad4c77a8ceaef7c5fba5d0" data-sk="tooltip_parent">async</a>)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">16 weeks paid parental leave</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">budget towards <a href="https://app.notion.com/p/remotecom/Benefits-Perks-1e48a5869c274f40910b76d405b92f63?source=copy_link#3accb4dadab48025b7a6dbc23bc47504" target="_blank">co-working spaces, learning and wellness</a> (including gym memberships)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">mental health support services</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">stock options</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">home office budget &amp; IT equipment</span></li> </ul> </div> <h2><strong>How you’ll plan your day (and life)</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at <a href="https://remote.com/async" target="_blank">remote.com/async</a>.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your <strong>life-work balance</strong> is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If that sounds like something you want, apply now!</span></p> <h2><strong>How to apply</strong></h2> <ol> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong data-stringify-type="bold">We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.</strong></span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.</span></li> </ol> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask &amp; encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.<br></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity.&nbsp;We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience.&nbsp;To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see&nbsp;<a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/Guidelines-on-using-AI-when-applying-for-a-job-at-Remote-11ccb4dadab4805f80a7c73b6567bd8f" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.notion.so/remotecom/Guidelines-on-using-AI-when-applying-for-a-job-at-Remote-11ccb4dadab4805f80a7c73b6567bd8f&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1733927526443000&amp;usg=AOvVaw2sIVooKuyGfRra1PtGXreV">here</a>.&nbsp;</span><br><br><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><em>Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.&nbsp;</em></span></p></div>

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Finance
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>About Jetson</strong></span></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">Jetson is on a mission to accelerate the transition of 100 million homes across North America away from fossil fuels toward sustainable energy use. We believe in a future that is 100% electric and 100% better.</span></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">Homes are one of the largest sources of carbon emissions, yet adoption of solutions like heat pumps remains slow due to cost and complexity. Jetson is solving this by building the first fully vertically integrated home electrification company — making clean energy simple, transparent, and affordable.</span></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">We rely heavily on technology, automation, and data to scale this impact. At Jetson, we value people who are excellent at their craft, curious about new tools (including AI), and motivated to continuously improve how work gets done.</span></p></div><h4><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The Opportunity</span></h4> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">We're building a new kind of role to help us scale: the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE). The title was originally coined for engineers embedded with external customers, and we've pointed that model inward. As an FDE on our Finance team, your customers are Jetson's own teams. You'll sit with them, learn their work deeply, and build the agents, tools, and automations that change how they operate.<br><br>Instead of routing every request through a central engineering backlog, we put engineers inside the teams that need help. You hear the problem firsthand, build the fix, and iterate the next day. FDEs across functions build on a shared internal platform alongside core engineering, so every automation you ship makes the next one faster. The more we deploy, the faster we can deploy.</span></p> <h4><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Who You Are</span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>A builder who ships.</strong> Strong engineering fundamentals, good judgment, and a drive to get things into people's hands. You're fluent in TypeScript, Python, or other high-level language, comfortable with SQL, APIs, and cloud tooling, and you write code others can build on. You value breadth and speed over deep specialization.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>An excellent communicator.</strong> This is what separates the role from a typical SWE job and brings it closer to a PM. You can sit with accounting, FP&amp;A, and leadership stakeholders, draw out what they actually need (often not what they first asked for), explain tradeoffs, and drive a project to adoption.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>A fast learner who's excited by the domain.</strong> You're energized by getting deep into how Finance works: its workflows, systems, and constraints. Familiarity with financial workflows like close, reporting, or FP&amp;A, or with an ERP (we use NetSuite), is a plus, but what matters more is the drive and ability to learn it fast. full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About Hightouch</h2> <p>Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.</p> <p>Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.</p> <p>Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.</p> <p>At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.</p></div><h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>Most AI-generated ads still look like AI-generated ads. Generic lighting, off-brand color, the same five compositions on a loop. Brands that care about their identity have stayed on the sidelines because the output hasn't met their bar.</p> <p>We're changing that. Hightouch's Agentic Marketing Platform is the system enterprise marketers are using to plan, generate, and ship campaigns with their data, their guidelines, and their voice. Our customers include Domino's, Chime, Spotify, Ramp, Whoop, and Grammarly. They are not going to settle for slop, and neither are we.</p> <p><strong>We're hiring a Forward Deployed Creative Designer, Ads </strong>to be the human who proves what's possible. You'll collaborate alongside our Solutions Engineering team on enterprise customer calls, translate brand guidelines into agentic workflows that actually produce on-brand work, and ship the creative that makes the case. You will be the most influential creative voice in the room, both for our customers and for our product.</p> <p>You will define how the most recognizable brands in the world make ads with AI, and you will watch the work you direct ship to millions of impressions.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Product Adoption:</strong> Partner directly with enterprise marketing teams to onboard them onto the Agentic Marketing Platform Ads, ensuring they see immediate value through high-quality creative output.</li> <li><strong>Master AI Workflows:</strong> Utilize advanced prompt engineering across leading generative AI models to create polished, on-brand, and performant ad creatives (imagery, video, and copy) tailored to complex client guidelines.</li> <li><strong>Consult &amp; Strategize</strong>: Act as a creative consultant for top-tier brands. You will help clients understand how to merge traditional brand guidelines with agentic AI workflows, ensuring the output maintains a high bar for "taste" and aesthetic quality.</li> <li><strong>Performance Optimization</strong>: Collaborate with clients to set up A/B tests, analyze creative performance data, and continuously refine prompts and strategies to drive higher ROI and conversion rates.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong>: Work closely with the product and engineering teams, providing ground-level feedback from enterprise clients to shape the future roadmap of our AI Decisioning and creative generation tools.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>A portfolio that does the talking:</strong>&nbsp;Real ads, real product launches, real campaigns. Ideally with AI integrated into the workflow, but the bar is craft. If your work is exceptional, we want to see it. (Applications without a portfolio link will not be reviewed.)</li> <li><strong>Deep AI fluency:</strong>&nbsp;You don't need us to teach you what's new. You're already testing the latest image and video models the week they drop, you’re stringing them together in node based UIs, you have strong opinions about which ones get which jobs, and you know how to push them past their defaults to hit a specific look.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise client instincts:</strong>&nbsp;You've worked directly with sophisticated marketing teams, in-house, agency, or consultancy, and you know how to navigate brand reviews, legal, and the politics of getting work approved.</li> <li><strong>Performance marketing literacy:</strong>&nbsp;You understand the difference between an ad that wins a Cannes Lion and an ad that wins a CAC target, and you can hold both standards at once.</li> <li><strong>Taste:</strong>&nbsp;This is the hardest one to write a bullet for, so we'll just say it: you have it, your portfolio shows it, and you can articulate <em>why</em> something works.</li> </ul> <h3>You might be a fit if you are...</h3> <ul> <li>A <strong>Senior Art Director or Creative Lead at an agency</strong> who's frustrated with the pace, the layers of approval, and watching AI eat workflows you can't influence from where you sit.</li> <li>An <strong>in-house Creative Lead at a DTC or consumer brand</strong> who's been quietly building AI workflows nights and weekends, and is ready to do it as the job.</li> <li>A <strong>Creative Strategist at a Meta, Google, or TikTok partner shop</strong> who wants to be closer to the product and further from the deck.</li> <li>A <strong>product or brand designer at a fast-moving startup</strong> who's been pulled into ads work, found you're great at it, and want to go all-in on the AI side.</li> <li>Or you don't fit any of these neatly, but your portfolio is undeniable and you've been waiting for a role that takes AI in advertising seriously. Apply.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Hightouch?</strong></h3> <p>You’ll be joining a fast-paced, high-growth environment where you can directly impact the success of some of the world’s most recognizable brands. You will be at the absolute forefront of AI in marketing, helping to define how the industry uses agentic models to drive real revenue.</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>The salary range for this position is $140,000-$180,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10-year post-termination exercise window.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>E-Verify Statement</strong></p> <p><em>Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.</em></p> <p><em><br></em><a href="https://www.rhoworld.com/wp-content/uploads/E-Verify_Participation_Poster-1.pdf"><em>E-Verify Notice</em><em><br></em></a><a href="https://www.rhoworld.com/wp-content/uploads/E-Verify_Participation_Poster_ES-1.pdf"><em>E-Verify Notice (Spanish)</em><em><br></em></a><a href="https://www.rhoworld.com/wp-content/uploads/ier_poster_final.pdf"><em>Right to Work Notice</em><em><br></em></a><a href="https://www.rhoworld.com/wp-content/uploads/spanish_ier_poster_final.pdf"><em>Right to Work Notice (Spanish)</em></a></p></div>
