title: Forward Deployed Marketing Data Scientist
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About Hightouch</h2> <p>Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.</p> <p>Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.</p> <p>Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.</p> <p>At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.</p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Forward Deployed Marketing Data Scientist</strong> to partner closely with our AI Decisioning customers and internal engineering teams to ensure that AI-driven marketing campaigns deliver measurable, compounding impact. This role is uniquely cross-functional: you’ll spend time diagnosing model behavior, tuning ML levers, analyzing incrementality, exploring customer data, and explaining insights to marketers and executives.</p> <p>Marketing teams come to Hightouch to transform how they operate. Instead of planning campaigns weeks ahead on a calendar, AI Decisioning continuously learns customer preferences and executes 1:1 messaging that adapts in real time. Your mission is to make sure that these AI agents perform at their best—and to help customers understand <em>why</em> they are performing the way they are.</p> <p>You’ll work alongside ML engineers, product managers, Solutions Consultants, and some of the world’s most recognizable brands to improve campaign performance, debug experiments, and identify opportunities for additional lift. Roughly <strong>30%</strong> of your time will be customer-facing and <strong>70%</strong> deep analytical and modeling work.</p> <p>No two days are the same, but you can expect to:</p> <h3><strong>Own diagnostics, insights, and tuning for AI Decisioning campaigns</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Explain <em>why</em> AI Decisioning is driving lift using counterfactuals, incrementality breakdowns, and cohort analysis.</li> <li>Debug performance issues, iterate on reward functions, and ensure the agent’s recommendations align with customer goals.</li> <li>Investigate experiment setups (send volumes, reachability, channel constraints) and surface actionable recommendations.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Work deeply with data in notebooks and customer warehouses</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Pull down historical data to run exploratory analyses using Polars / Pandas in Jupyter notebooks</li> <li>Modify and improve customer feature matrices to unlock deep personalization.</li> <li>Conduct deeper warehouse-level SQL analyses when insights aren’t available in the UI.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Build lightweight tooling that enables scale</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create templates, notebooks, scripts, and repeatable workflows that improve how we analyze performance across customers.</li> <li>Identify systemic gaps and influence the direction of ML reporting and introspection.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Communicate ML concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Present model insights and recommendations to marketers, analysts, and executives.</li> <li>Explain how the decision engine handles cold start, message transfer learning, exploration vs. exploitation, and more.</li> <li>Partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and drive new opportunities for uplift.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong ability to perform deep exploratory data analysis in Python (Polars / Pandas, Jupyter notebooks).</li> <li>Ability to write and interpret SQL for customer warehouse analysis.</li> <li>High-level understanding of ML modeling concepts (features, hyperparameters, reward functions, training windows).</li> <li>Excellent communication skills; able to explain technical reasoning simply and confidently to marketers.</li> <li>A customer-first attitude with high ownership and urgency when resolving issues.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience setting up and analyzing marketing experiments such as A/B, multivariate tests.</li> <li>Prior experience in an applied ML, data science, analytics engineering, or forward-deployed role.</li> <li>Experience building lightweight internal tools or scripting solutions.</li> </ul> <p>We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. We focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $140,000 - $220,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy.</p> <h2>Interview Process</h2> <p>We have limited inbound applications to one application per candidate. You will be auto-rejected if you apply to multiple roles. Please only apply to the position you are most qualified for.</p> <p>Our interview process evaluates the most important dimensions of the role: analytical depth, customer communication, first-principles problem solving, and alignment with Hightouch’s values.</p> <p><strong>Intro Call [15–30m]</strong></p> <p>Introductory call with either a member of our recruiting team or the hiring manager to get to know each other and see if the role could be a good mutual fit.</p> <p><strong>Take Home Data Analysis Exercise + Review Session [45m]</strong></p> <p>You’ll complete a short take-home assignment focused on exploratory data analysis of an example dataset. In the live review, you’ll walk through your approach, explain your reasoning, and present your findings as if you were guiding a customer through your analysis. We’re looking for clarity of communication, rigor of thinking, and the ability to turn data into actionable insights.</p> <p><strong>Experiment Design &amp; Analysis Session [90m]</strong></p> <p>A hands-on session where we collaboratively design and evaluate an experiment end-to-end. This includes:</p> <ul> <li>Defining the experimental goal and how success should be measured</li> <li>Identifying the most relevant context and features to use in modeling</li> <li>Interpreting example results and diagnosing performance patterns</li> <li>Recommending next steps and communicating tradeoffs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Hiring Manager Interview [30m]</strong></p> <p>Chat with hiring manager about past experiences and future operating preferences to assess fit on company values and operating principles.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>E-Verify Statement</strong></p> <p><em>Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.</em></p> <p><em><br></em><a href="https://www.rhoworld.com/wp-content/uploads/E-Verify_Participation_Poster-1.pdf"><em>E-Verify Notice</em><em><br></em></a><a href="https://www.rhoworld.com/wp-content/uploads/E-Verify_Participation_Poster_ES-1.pdf"><em>E-Verify Notice (Spanish)</em><em><br></em></a><a href="https://www.rhoworld.com/wp-content/uploads/ier_poster_final.pdf"><em>Right to Work Notice</em><em><br></em></a><a href="https://www.rhoworld.com/wp-content/uploads/spanish_ier_poster_final.pdf"><em>Right to Work Notice (Spanish)</em></a></p></div>

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Inference & Post-Training) - Mandarin Speaking
full_description: <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) focused on Inference &amp; Post-Training, you will be a hands-on technical partner to our most strategic customers — production AI teams looking to leverage high quality models and do inference at scale. For us, FDE is not a replacement for a Solutions Architect; you will partner with our SAs as a deep-domain specialist in inference optimization, fine-tuning pipelines, and production deployment. As key contributors to both the CX, Engineering, and Sales organizations, FDEs add tremendous value by ensuring we can meet the requirements of our most complex POCs, facilitate successful platform adoption, and guide tailored optimization efforts — directly impacting customer success, company growth, and the hardening of our core platform.</p> <p>Must be a permanent resident or citizen of Singapore.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Inference Engine Optimization: Select, configure, and optimize inference engine based on hardware, model architecture, and workload profile</li> <li>Configuration &amp; Performance Tuning: Develop configuration updates to win critical POCs, benchmarks, and optimize customer deployments; tune KV cache, apply speculative decoding, determine optimal tensor parallelism, and determine quantization strategy to hit throughput and latency targets.</li> <li>Post-Training &amp; Fine-Tuning: Drive hands-on RL training runs and optimize system design; guide customers through LoRA, SFT, DPO, RLHF, and GRPO pipelines from experimentation through production.</li> <li>Strategic Customer Alignment: Act as the primary technical point of contact for aligned strategic accounts — monitoring and optimizing endpoint configurations, helping customers get the most out of the platform, and collaborating to ensure we hit critical milestones.</li> <li>Opinionated Onboarding: Establish direct alignment with strategic customers at onboarding; ensure the right inference and post-training configurations are in place from day one to improve time-to-value.</li> <li>Product Feedback Loop: Directly influence our software and model roadmap by surfacing insights from the field. Contribute back to the product where needed to support customer requirements or drive a better experience. Drive early feature and research adoption with strategic logos.</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Experience: 5+ years in a technical role, with a strong focus on inference systems, open-source LLM deployment, or post-training workflows.</li> <li>Inference Engine Depth: Expert-level, hands-on experience with inference engines (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang); ability to diagnose and resolve performance issues at the engine level.</li> <li>Inference Optimization: Deep knowledge of KV cache tuning, speculative decoding, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and quantization techniques</li> <li>Post-Training Knowledge: Hands-on experience with fine-tuning and post-training pipelines, including LoRA, SFT, DPO, RLHF, and GRPO; ability to advise on system design</li> <li>Model Landscape Awareness: Broad knowledge of state-of-the-art open-source models and strong judgment on model selection for specific customer use cases, hardware profiles, and performance targets.</li> <li>Coding Proficiency: Strong Python skills; comfortable working in production environments</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Together AI</strong></h3> <p>Together AI is a research-driven artificial intelligence company. We believe open and transparent AI systems will drive innovation and create the best outcomes for society, and together we are on a mission to significantly lower the cost of modern AI systems by co-designing software, hardware, algorithms, and models. We have contributed to leading open-source research, models, and datasets to advance the frontier of AI, and our team has been behind technological advancements such as FlashAttention, Hyena, FlexGen, and RedPajama. We invite you to join a passionate group of researchers on our journey in building the next generation of AI infrastructure.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits, as well as flexibility in terms of remote work. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></h3> <p>Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.</p> <p>Please see our Privacy Policy at <a href="https://www.together.ai/privacy">https://www.together.ai/privacy</a></p>

title: Engineering: Senior Customer Forward Deployed Engineer
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at <a href="http://amplitude.com">amplitude.com</a>.</p> <p>As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.</p> <p><strong>Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity &amp; Inclusion (DEI): </strong>Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.</p></div><p><strong>About The Role &amp; Team</strong></p> <p>Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, and our ability to deliver measurable customer outcomes quickly is a key part of how we keep that lead. The Customer FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success — owning the technical delivery that takes validated products from co-development and implements them across enterprise customers.</p> <p>As a Customer Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own end-to-end technical delivery for enterprise customer implementations, from sales engagement through post-deployment validation. You'll work directly in Amplitude's product codebase, submitting PRs, shipping customer-specific solutions, and building reusable patterns that make every successive engagement faster. This is not a traditional support or solutions role. Customer FDEs are engineers first who partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to turn customer needs into working software. The right person thrives in ambiguity, learns new domains quickly, and cares as much about the customer's outcome as about technical elegance.</p> <p><strong>As a Customer Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own enterprise implementations end-to-end — engage during sales to map customer needs to capabilities, scope implementation plans, and deliver through post-deployment validation with measurable customer outcomes</li> <li>Work directly in the product codebase — submit PRs, test, and ship customer-specific solutions without requiring constant oversight; over time, the gap between "what we built" and "what the customer needs" keeps shrinking because you're the one closing it</li> <li>Ship early, ship often, and gather feedback — treat every customer interaction as an opportunity to validate your approach and course-correct quickly</li> <li>Build reusable patterns and playbooks — when you solve something once, make sure the next person doesn't have to solve it again; identify and document implementation patterns that reduce effort for subsequent engagements</li> <li>Feed structured signals back to Product — translate customer pain into actionable product feedback that influences the roadmap; surface gaps so they get fixed rather than hiding them</li> <li>Establish an AI-native engineering workflow — AI tools are integral to how you write, test, debug, and deliver code, not an occasional supplement; this is a professional standard, not an optional enhancement</li> <li>Proactively identify the right engagements — dictate what you work on, identify accounts that need FDE engagement pre-Sales, and have the judgment to say "no" when the fit isn't right</li> <li>Build cross-functional trust — partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Product full_description: <h2><strong>Senior Data Engineer</strong></h2> <p><strong>Latin America | 100% Remote</strong></p> <h3><strong>About CodeRoad</strong></h3> <p>CodeRoad provides end-to-end software development services, helping businesses scale with ideal infrastructure solutions. across the enterprise.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Design</strong> and implement standardized, normalized data models capable of integrating heterogeneous and complex source systems.</li> <li><strong>Lead</strong> org-wide architectural decisions for data warehousing, orchestration, and pipeline reliability across the data engineering ecosystem.</li> title: Data Engineer
full_description: <p><strong>About Interval</strong></p> <p class="p1">Interval helps enterprises turn messy, underused data into governed, high-confidence&nbsp;intelligence—without handing control to a black box. We bring compute to your data with a private&nbsp;data lakehouse, verifiable audit trails, and <strong>U-AI</strong>, our contextual AI framework for secure AI&nbsp;workflows.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>Our platform is built around three outcomes:</strong><br>- Control: Keep ownership of your data and how models use it.<br>- Verify: Audit what happened, why it happened, and where results came from.<br>- Monetize: Create new revenue opportunities through private, permissioned data exchange.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong><br>We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our team and revolutionize how enterprises secure, analyze, and monetize their data—on their terms. As a Data Engineer at Interval, you’ll work on building and optimizing secure, scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that ensure privacy, compliance, and enable AI-powered business transformation.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><br>- Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and delivery of large datasets across diverse industries.<br>- Implement and ensure data privacy and security best practices, supporting data sovereignty and compliance with regulatory requirements.<br>- Collaborate closely with AI/ML engineers, Data Scientists, and Platform engineers to enable advanced analytics and AI capabilities while retaining strict data control.<br>- Optimize data platforms and systems for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.<br>- Build tools and frameworks for secure, privacy-preserving data processing and orchestration.<br>- Develop and maintain documentation, data models, and technical workflows.<br>- Partner with cross-functional teams to launch new data-driven product features and solutions.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong><br>- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.<br>- Proven experience in designing and building ETL pipelines and data infrastructure (cloud, hybrid, and/or on-premise).<br>- Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, and modern data engineering toolsets (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka).<br>- Solid understanding of data security, privacy frameworks, and regulatory compliance such as GDPR, CCPA, or equivalent.<br>- Experience with privacy-first, AI-native, or data sovereignty-focused platforms is a plus.<br>- Familiarity with industry-specific data challenges (CPG, financial services, energy, supply chain, etc.) is advantageous.<br>- Excellent analytical and communication skills; proactive and detail-oriented.</p> <p><strong>Why Interval?</strong><br>- Shape the frontier of AI, blockchain, and enterprise data infrastructure.&nbsp;<br>- Enjoy meaningful ownership, flexible work, and the autonomy where data, AI, and privacy meet<br>- Thrive in a sharp, mission-driven team backed by top-tier technical leadership and investors</p>

title: Analytics Engineer III - FMX
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.&nbsp;</div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>Overview</strong></span></p> <p class="p1">We are seeking a Analytics Engineer III to join our growing Data organization in the Analytics Engineering team. As an Analytics Engineer III, you'll report directly to the Manager of Analytics Engineering and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to create valuable insights to drive our business's growth. As an AE, your work will be critical in building accurate reporting across the business. You'll also be responsible for providing ongoing analysis and recommendations to stakeholders. We're looking for someone passionate, eager to learn, and can work well within a team.This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic team and directly contribute to our business's success.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>Responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Develop a strong understanding of Fanatics Betting and Gaming, as well as related products and operations.</li> <li class="li1">Design and build insightful metric definitions, KPIs, and source of truth tables utilizing advanced sql</li> <li class="li1">Ownership of our DBT cloud infrastructure and implementation of data modeling best practices</li> <li class="li1">Collaboration with other Analysts and Data Engineering teams to find solutions to business problems.</li> <li class="li1">Develop our Snowflake Intelligence AI to help empower teams to self-serve analytics.</li> <li class="li1">Remain current on technology and trends in data analytics and the sports betting &amp; gaming industry.</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></span></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Advanced SQL skills, including model/query optimization</li> <li class="li1">Data modeling utilizing a tool such as DBT, including incremental modeling strategies</li> <li class="li1">Manage and optimize source code control in GitHub, leveraging branching strategies and best practices to ensure efficient collaboration and code quality</li> <li class="li1">Experienced with building dashboards and reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, Looker).</li> <li class="li1">Customer obsessed and experience focused; highly outcome-oriented and data-driven; experienced in working in high-growth environments.</li> <li class="li1">Demonstrated ability to partner closely with stakeholders, earning trust and prioritizing relationships.</li> <li class="li1">Logical and analytical approach to problem solving. Plus for utilizing AI in analytics.</li> <li class="li1">Strong organizational and communication skills.</li> <li class="li1">Positive and flexible attitude, a willingness to embrace new initiatives.</li> <li class="li1">Understanding of sports betting or experience in customer behavior analysis is a significant plus.</li> <li class="li1">Must be open to travel for team offsites and events.</li> <li class="li1">5+ years of relevant experience</li> </ul> <p class="p2"><strong>Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position</strong>.</p> <p class="p1"><em>Ready to build the future of sports betting? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!</em></p> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our&nbsp;<a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p></div>

Each analytics engineer has ownership and autonomy over a set of entities / tables in a domain, collaborating on a single data design from first principles that the team owns together. As their products mature they merchandise them as Tableau Connections, extracts into sheets or any other end point needed to achieve their mission.</p> <p>Some analytics engineers have an interest in data infrastructure and integrations, others in bringing their data to life through interactive visualizations but all have the skills to work with unruly raw data, design analytics friendly data products (incl entities and flat tables) and build them to a production standard that the whole company can rely on. Everyone in data at CookUnity comes with a high agency mindset, a passion for collaborating with others, a pattern of achievement and a sincere interest in investing in their own development.</p> <p>Everyone in data at CookUnity comes with a high agency mindset, a passion for collaborating with others, a pattern of achievement and a sincere interest in investing in their own development.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Own Core Data Products</strong></p> <p>Design, build, and maintain dbt models in Snowflake that reflect key business logic and serve as reliable sources of truth. Measure success through usage metrics, reduced support needs, and SLA coverage.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Ensure Reliability and Observability</strong></p> <p>Monitor pipelines, track schema changes, and implement testing and alerting to ensure consistent data quality and uptime.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Drive Iteration Through Feedback</strong></p> <p>Collect and act on feedback from users. Use metrics, interviews, and usage logs to continuously improve your data products and documentation.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Advance AI Adoption in Analytics</strong></p> <p>Champion the use of agentic and AI-assisted tools in data workflows. Lead pilots, measure impact, and scale successful practices across the team.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Collaborate Cross-Functionally</strong></p> <p>Work with Engineering, Product, and Ops to align on metrics, instrumentation, experimentation, and data needs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Mentor and Raise the Bar</strong></p> <p>Review code, guide design decisions, and share knowledge to elevate the craft of Analytics Engineering within the team.</p> </li> </ul> <hr> <h3><strong>Qualifications:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a similar role working with modern data stacks (dbt, Fivetran/Airbyte, Airflow, Snowflake/BigQuery, etc.)</li> <li>Deep understanding of data modeling principles (e.g. dimensional modeling, ELT best practices, testing strategies, etc.)</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL and version control (Git), with experience shipping production-quality data pipelines</li> <li>Experience collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Operations, etc.) to translate business needs into data solutions</li> <li>Comfort navigating ambiguity in fast-paced environments, with a strong sense of ownership and problem-solving mindset</li> <li>Familiarity with BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Hex, Looker) and a passion for enabling self-serve data culture</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <h3><strong>Learn More About CookUnity</strong></h3> <p>We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. Data is fundamental to DoorDash’s success, and this team plays a critical role in enabling high-impact, data-driven solutions across Product, Operations, Finance, and more.</p> <p><strong>Please apply here for all non-managerial levels within the following analytics teams:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Consumer &amp; Growth</li> <li>Business Operations</li> <li>Dasher &amp; Logistics</li> <li>Customer Experience &amp; Integrity</li> <li>Merchant</li> <li>Ads &amp; Promotions&nbsp;</li> <li>New Verticals</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll play a key role in building and scaling the data foundations that enable fast, reliable, and actionable insights. You’ll work closely with partner teams to drive end-to-end analytics initiatives, working alongside Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Operators.</p> <p>This is a highly technical role where you'll be a driving force behind the analytics stack, delivering trusted data and metrics that support decision-making at all levels of the company. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and are comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!</p> <h2><strong>You're excited about this opportunity because you will…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders to understand business needs, and translate that scope into data requirements</li> <li>Identify key business questions and problems to solve for, and generate insights by developing structured solutions to resolve them</li> <li>Lead the development of data products and self-serve tools that enable analytics to scale across the company</li> <li>Build and maintain canonical datasets by developing high-volume, reliable ETL/ELT pipelines using data lake and data warehousing concepts</li> <li>Design metrics and data visualizations with dashboarding tools like Tableau, Sigma, and Mode</li> <li>Be a cross-functional champion at upholding high data integrity standards to increase reusability, readability and standardization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We're excited about you because you have…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain</li> <li>2-6+ years of experience working in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role</li> <li>Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, comfort in at least one functional/OOP language such as Python or Scala</li> <li>Experience in creating compelling reporting and data visualization solutions using dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Sigma)</li> <li>Familiarity with database fundamentals (e.g. S3, Trino, Hive, Spark), and experience with SQL performance tuning</li> non-technical teams</li> <li>Comfortable working in fast paced environment, self starter and self organizing</li> <li>Ability to think strategically, analyze and interpret market and consumer information</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.</p> <p>By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.</p> <p>Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.</p> <p>If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.</p></div><h3><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h3> <p>Most companies make you choose: build the platform, or go deploy it. Here you do both — and that's the point.</p> <p>As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you're part of a single team that both delivers Afresh's AI into enterprise grocery customers and builds the platform that makes that delivery fast. You'll spend dedicated time in the field — embedded with a customer, integrating into their data, shipping AI systems on top of it — and dedicated time on the platform, turning what you just learned into reusable tooling the whole team deploys next. You build the house you live in.</p> <p>Afresh leads the customer relationship and direction; you and a small team bring the technical firepower — scope and architect the work with the customer, then build it. Because you also own the platform underneath, the rough edges you hit in the field become the things you fix at the root.</p> <p>This is senior, hands-on, 0-to-1 work in a space with no playbook.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></h3> <p><strong>In the field (forward deployed)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Afresh's account lead and the customer's technical teams to scope and architect the work — the data sources, the architecture, and the path to production.</li> <li>Embed with the customer's data and engineering teams (remote and on-site); integrate into their cloud and data platform; build production-grade pipelines and model messy enterprise data into trustworthy data products.</li> <li>Design and ship LLM- and agent-powered systems on that data — retrieval, agentic workflows, data-quality and analytics agents — reliable enough to run in production, not just to demo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>On the platform (building the house you live in)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Harden what works in the field into the shared platform: the knowledge and grounding layer (knowledge graph, ontology, and retrieval) that makes grocery data usable by LLMs, the agent frameworks, and the serving infrastructure.</li> <li>Build the evals, tracing, and tooling that let the team measure quality — accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, cost — and ship faster on the next customer.</li> <li>Build for leverage: clean interfaces and reusable building blocks, not one-off per-customer code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Across both</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the flywheel: field learnings flow straight into the platform, and platform improvements show up at the next customer.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit</strong></span></h3> <p>We encourage all highly-qualified candidates to apply, even if they do not fulfill all the listed criteria.</p> <ul> <li>3+ years building production software and data systems, with strong, production-grade code</li> <li>An architect's instinct: you can take an ambiguous problem and a messy data landscape, design a clean and workable solution, and then build it.</li> <li>Genuine <strong>AI/LLM depth —</strong> you've built real systems with LLMs and agents (retrieval/RAG, tool-use) and you evaluate quality rather than eyeball it.</li> <li>Real <strong>data-engineering depth</strong>: building and operating data pipelines, modeling messy enterprise data, and working in a modern cloud data platform (Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).</li> <li><strong>Range across both modes</strong> — you genuinely like being in front of customers and going heads-down to build reusable infrastructure, and you can switch between them without one suffering. This is the role's defining trait.</li> <li>Customer-facing comfort: you work well with a customer's engineers and data teams — running working sessions, explaining your thinking, and earning trust through what you deliver.</li> <li>A bias toward ownership and momentum, and comfort traveling to customer sites regularly (~10-20%).</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Nice to Have</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in grocery, retail, or supply chain data domains.</li> <li>Knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic layers in production; graph and vector stores (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) and hybrid search.</li> <li>MCP or similar tool/context protocols; agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph); MLOps, model serving, and observability for LLM systems.</li> <li>Prior forward-deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering — or early-stage startup experience navigating rapid customer expansion.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Why Afresh?</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>We're a mission-driven company that eliminates hundreds of millions of pounds of food waste in grocery stores every year — your work has direct, visible impact.</li> <li>You'll do both halves of the job: deploy with customers and build the platform you deploy — never a body-shop consultant, never an ivory-tower platform engineer.</li> <li>Be part of an engineering culture that's genuinely AI-forward — we want to be on the bleeding edge of agentic development, not watching from the sidelines.</li> <li>Senior team, high trust, and real ownership at a pivotal inflection point for how Afresh scales.</li> <li>Collaborative, supportive environment &amp; awesome people</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span class="discussion-id-360287fd-508b-8041-b13b-001c71e28a70 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco office (3 days/week)</span></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>This position is not eligible for company sponsorship.</strong></p> <p>Salary Range in U.S.: $156,060 - $211,140 + meaningful early-stage equity + benefits</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh</strong><br>At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.</div> <ul> <li><strong>Comprehensive Health &amp; Wellness:</strong> Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.</li> <li><strong>Invested in Your Future:</strong> Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match.</li> <li><strong>Flexible &amp; Modern Workspace:</strong> Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access.</li> <li><strong>Growth-Obsessed Culture:</strong> We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh.</li> <li><strong>Holistic Monthly Stipends:</strong> Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for "Betterment" (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive.</li> <li><strong>Time to Recharge:</strong> Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge.</li> </ul> <div>*<em>Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <p><strong>About Afresh</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.</p> <p>Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors.</p> <p>Grocery is the past, present, and future of our food system – the waste we create today will impact our planet for years to come. Join us as we continue to build a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive team that embodies our company’s values of proactivity, kindness, candor, and humility.</p> <p><strong>Afresh provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.</strong></p> <p><strong>Here at Afresh, many of our employees work remotely provided that they reside in one of the following states:&nbsp;AL, AR, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MA, MI, MT, MO, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OR, PA, TX, WA,&nbsp;UT,&nbsp;VA, WI</strong>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.</div> <ul> <li><strong>Comprehensive Health &amp; Wellness:</strong> Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.</li> <li><strong>Invested in Your Future:</strong> Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match.</li> <li><strong>Flexible &amp; Modern Workspace:</strong> Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access.</li> <li><strong>Growth-Obsessed Culture:</strong> We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh.</li> <li><strong>Holistic Monthly Stipends:</strong> Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for "Betterment" (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive.</li> <li><strong>Time to Recharge:</strong> Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge.</li> </ul> <div>*<em>Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <p><strong>About Afresh</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.</p> <p>Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors.</p> <p>Grocery is the past, present, and future of our food system – the waste we create today will impact our planet for years to come. Join us as we continue to build a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive team that embodies our company’s values of proactivity, kindness, candor, and humility.</p> <p><strong>Afresh provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.</strong></p> <p><strong>Here at Afresh, many of our employees work remotely provided that they reside in one of the following states:&nbsp;AL, AR, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MA, MI, MT, MO, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OR, PA, TX, WA,&nbsp;UT,&nbsp;VA, WI</strong>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
full_description: <div class="content-intro"><section id="st-companyDescription" class="job-section"> <div class="wysiwyg"> <section id="st-companyDescription" class="job-section"> <div class="wysiwyg"> <h2 class="title">Company Description</h2> <p>Farther is a rapidly growing RIA that combines expert advisors with cutting-edge technology - delivering a comprehensive, tailored wealth management experience.</p> <p>Farther’s founders are leaders and innovators from the private wealth industry who possess a unique blend of traditional wealth management, fintech, and technology production expertise.&nbsp;We’re backed by top-tier venture capital firms, fintech investors, and industry leaders.</p> <p>Joining Farther means joining a collaborative team of entrepreneurs who are passionate about helping their clients and our teammates achieve more. If you’re the type who breaks through walls to get things done the right way, we want to build the future of wealth management with you.</p> </div> </section> </div> </section></div><h3>The Role</h3> <p>As the Senior Manager, Data Engineering at Farther, you will own the data platform powering a modern, technology-driven wealth management firm — the security master, custodial pipelines, and canonical financial models every downstream system depends on.</p> <p>The platform is already in production. Your mandate is to take it much further: define the roadmap, own it end-to-end, and execute — growing the team and expanding what the platform makes possible across the firm, including the AI systems built on top of it.</p> <h3>Your Impact</h3> <ul> <li>Own and execute the data platform roadmap — from custodial ingestion through the security master to AI-ready data products</li> <li>Lead and grow the data engineering team, setting the bar for technical quality</li> <li>Own the firm's security master: reference data, corporate actions, and golden-source resolution across vendors</li> <li>Design canonical models unifying accounts, positions, and transactions across Schwab, Fidelity, Pershing, and other custodians</li> <li>Drive data quality, reconciliation, lineage, and governance across regulated datasets</li> </ul> <h3>The Ideal Match</h3> <ul> <li>8+ years in data platform roles, with 4+ years managing data teams</li> <li>Deep security master experience — instrument reference data, corporate actions, multi-vendor golden-source resolution</li> <li>Prior experience on the data team at a broker/dealer</li> <li>Exceptional data modeling skills — schemas that are correct, extensible, and built to last</li> <li>Strong hands-on expertise with PostgreSQL, AWS, and Python</li> <li>A builder's mindset — energized by scaling a strong foundation into something category-defining</li> </ul> <h3>Technical Stack</h3> <ul> <li>PostgreSQL, Python, SQL</li> <li>AWS (S3, Lambda, ECS Fargate, Glue, Athena, Step Functions)</li> <li>Parquet-based data lake, infrastructure-as-code (CDK), CI/CD-driven delivery</li> <li>AI/agent integrations built on the platform (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock)</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience running a global or distributed data team</li> <li>Bitemporal or point-in-time financial data modeling</li> <li>Data governance, lineage, and fine-grained access control</li> <li>Experience supporting AI/ML systems with production data products</li> </ul> <h3>Why Join Us</h3> <ul> <li>Learn &amp; grow through book clubs, seminars, and peer learning sessions</li> <li>Competitive comp package that rewards impact</li> <li>Work alongside some of the brightest minds in fintech</li> <li>Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-scaling startup</li> <li>Chart your own growth path as we expand</li> <li>Full health benefits + 401(k) matching &amp; Roth IRA options</li> <li>Unlimited PTO</li> <li>An amazing collaborative atmosphere between product, design, and engineering to solve hard problems together</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ready to disrupt wealth management? Let's talk!</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

title: Lead Data Engineer
full_description: <h2><strong>What is Coast</strong></h2> <p>Coast is re-imagining the trillion-dollar U.S. B2B card payments infrastructure, with a focus on the country’s 500,000 commercial fleets, 40 million commercial vehicles, and many millions of commercial drivers. The incumbent technologies that cater to these customers are decades old, and businesses with fleets increasingly demand modern digital experiences and transparent financial services products. Coast’s mission is to deliver this at a transformational scale, beginning with the Coast Fleet and Fuel Card built on a cutting-edge spend management platform.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a leader of the Coast data engineering team to shape our company’s data culture and underlying infrastructure.</p> <p>At Coast, the success of our data platform is driving accelerating demand from all corners of the company. We’re looking for a key builder to help us meet this moment. In this role, you will drive the evolution of our modern, cloud-native data platform. This is a chance to lead a small, high-leverage team and make a definitive impact, building the systems that help us understand risk, acquire customers, and create a better financial product. You will be building on a solid foundation that lets you focus on high-impact work from day one. Our data engineering organization follows the federated model of data product ownership—the data platform serves as the foundation, not the first line of defense against data issues.</p> <p>We need you to help us establish a vision for the data ecosystem evolution while satisfying day to day demands of a rapidly growing early stage startup.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will report directly to the Head of Engineering and work from our NYC office.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>lead design and implementation of all aspects of our data ecosystem — from obtaining third party data to building our own data products, from infrastructure architecture to end-user BI and data exploration toolchain;</li> <li>evangelize and implement the best practices, from reasoning about statistical significance to granting data access via AI tools, from source control and change management to database migrations;</li> <li>establish guardrails for self-serve ecosystem for the business users;</li> <li>help our product engineering teams evolve from treating data as exhaust to building DDD-based data products;</li> <li>enhance our ETL/ELT patterns, from landing zone to semantic layers;</li> <li>ensure that our metrics are built on top of consistent, curated data with clear stewardship;</li> <li>oversee our connected SaaS data landscape;</li> <li>own the budget for the data infrastructure and develop a sensible cost allocation model;</li> <li>safeguard our data, from tokenization and access controls, to retention and backups;</li> <li>remain relentlessly pragmatic and balance the daily demands or a fast-growing startup business with the needs of a well-managed platform;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>have 7-10+ years hands-on experience working across the data ecosystem, from modern ETL/ELT and orchestration to data warehouses and columnar stores, from BI tooling for less-technical business users to SQL optimization;</li> <li>have software engineering mindset, leading with the principles of source control, infrastructure as code, testing, modularity, automation, CICD, and observability;</li> <li>bring in a strong professional network, since it is impossible to know everything, and one must be able to tap others for advice;</li> <li>have experience working directly with product engineers as well as business users;</li> <li>be proficient in Python, since you would be expected to contribute data platform aspects into product engineering code as well as write your own tools;</li> <li>be able to figure stuff out - the modern data space is deep and complex, and there are many ways of solving the same problem; you need to be able to go off on your own, research and design a solution, implement technical spikes, and then deliver it through responsible change management;</li> <li>have an owner mindset and continuously look for, notice, and implement improvements to our data infrastructure, because small continuous improvements matter;</li> <li>be a thought-leader that keeps a finger on the pulse of the industry - vendor landscape, industry trends;</li> <li>work from our NYC SoHo office at least four days a week.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h2> <p>Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of our total compensation package that also includes benefits, signing bonus, and equity. Pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including scope and qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Coast employees. We expect the majority of candidates who are offered roles at Coast to fall healthily within the range based on these factors.</p> <p><strong>Salary range</strong>: $170K-$220K&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Equity Grant</strong>: Meaningful potential upside given Coast’s early-stage trajectory</p> <p><strong>Benefits Overview</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Medical, dental and vision insurance</li> <li>Flexible paid time off (vacation, personal well being, paid holidays)</li> <li>Tools to help manage your financial wellness, including webinars, access to an equity tax advisory service, and company-sponsored 401(k)</li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>$400 accessories allowance (a keyboard, mouse, headphones, etc.)</li> <li>Education stipend</li> <li>Free lunch every Friday</li> </ul> <p>Coast is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are building a diverse and inclusive environment, so we encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</p> <p>Check out the latest podcast interview on<a href="https://fintechlayercake.buzzsprout.com/1985266/14997028-fleet-card-masterclass-with-coast-founder-daniel-simon"> Fintech Layer Cake with Coast Founder Daniel Simon</a>!&nbsp;</p>

full_description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="p1"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Us</strong></span></p> <p class="p1"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. monitor progress and drive continuous improvement.</li> <li><strong>Encourage Innovation: </strong>Promote thoughtful adoption of new tools, technologies, and approaches that improve scalability, quality, and efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you bring to the team</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Data Engineering Experience: </strong>Minimum 7 years of experience in data engineering roles, including client‑facing implementations.</li> <li><strong>Technical Leadership: </strong>Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring technical teams.</li> <li><strong>ETL &amp; Data Integration Expertise: </strong>Strong hands‑on experience designing and supporting ETL workflows and complex data integrations.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare Domain Knowledge: </strong>Working knowledge of healthcare data environments and standards; experience handling clinical or claims‑related data.</li> <li><strong>Programming &amp; Analytics Skills: </strong>Proficiency with Python and PySpark for data processing and transformation.</li> <li><strong>Advanced SQL: </strong>Strong ability to write, optimize, and manage complex queries across large datasets.</li> <li><strong>Cloud &amp; Data Platforms: </strong>Experience working with AWS‑based architectures; familiarity with Databricks and Snowflake.</li> <li><strong>Version Control &amp; Collaboration: </strong>Practical experience using GitHub or GitLab for code management and collaboration.</li> <li><strong>Communication &amp; Problem‑Solving: </strong>Clear communicator with a data‑driven approach to solving complex technical and operational challenges.</li> <li><strong>Education: </strong>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we would like to see, but not required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience supporting healthcare analytics, payer systems, or healthcare operations.</li> <li>Exposure to machine learning concepts or data science workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.</li> <li>Experience applying DevOps or CI/CD practices in data engineering environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll get in return&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive Leave &amp; Benefits</li> <li>Comprehensive health coverage</li> <li>Equity for every employee&nbsp;– share in our success</li> <li>Growth-focused environment – your development matters here</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work arrangements&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week</li> <li>Location: Pune, Hybrid (3 days a week in office)</li> <li>Shift: Your standard working hours will be nine (9) hours per day within the Company’s standard working hours.&nbsp;&nbsp;Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></span></p> <p class="p1"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.</span></p> <p class="p1"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Ready to make an impact? Join us and let’s build the future together.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Senior Site Reliability Engineer – Forward Deployed (AWS &amp; Databricks) is a senior individual contributor responsible for production operations, incident response, and post‑launch system reliability across Abacus Insights’ platform.</p> <p>This role blends:</p> <ul> <li>SRE and production operations</li> <li>SWAT-style deep technical problem solving</li> <li>Forward‑deployed, customer‑facing technical work</li> <li>Hands‑on software development and automation</li> </ul> <p>You will own the&nbsp;most complex, ambiguous, and high‑impact production issues, particularly those involving&nbsp;AWS infrastructure, Databricks workloads, and large‑scale data pipelines. You will work directly with customers on escalations and deployments, while ensuring learnings are translated back into durable product and platform improvements.</p> <p>This is a&nbsp;hands-on role. You are expected to lead technically during incidents, debug live systems, and write production code where it meaningfully improves reliability and operability.</p> <p><strong>Your day to day</strong></p> <p><strong>Production Operations &amp; Incident Response</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a&nbsp;senior technical escalation point&nbsp;during production incidents</li> <li>Lead real-time incident triage, mitigation, and recovery efforts</li> <li>Drive&nbsp;root cause analysis (RCA)&nbsp;with a focus on systemic, long-term fixes</li> <li>Identify recurring failure patterns and push for architectural or operational improvements</li> <li>Partner with Customer Success and Engineering to manage customer impact during incidents</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sustaining Engineering &amp; Post‑Launch Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own&nbsp;post-launch reliability, stability, and operational quality&nbsp;of core systems</li> <li>Investigate and resolve complex field issues and production defects</li> <li>Ensure fixes developed during incidents or customer escalations are&nbsp;up streamed into the core product</li> <li>Improve operational readiness of services through better runbooks, monitoring, and alerting</li> <li>Reduce operational toil by converting repeated manual work into automation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Forward Deployed / Customer‑Facing Engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage directly with strategic customers to solve&nbsp;real-world, production-grade technical challenges</li> <li>Support complex deployments, integrations, and escalations in customer environments</li> <li>Act as a trusted technical partner to customers during high-impact issues</li> <li>Translate customer learnings into&nbsp;concrete product, platform, and operational improvements</li> <li>Contribute to reusable tools, playbooks, and best practices that accelerate future deployments</li> </ul> <p><strong>AWS &amp; Databricks Technical Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a subject matter expert for&nbsp;AWS-hosted production systems</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve issues across: <ul> <li>AWS compute, storage, networking, IAM, and security</li> <li>Databricks jobs, clusters, and Spark-based data pipelines</li> </ul> </li> <li>Debug performance degradation, scalability issues, job failures, and data correctness problems</li> <li>Partner with platform and data teams to harden systems for&nbsp;reliability, scale, and operability</li> </ul> <p><strong>Software Development &amp; Automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Write&nbsp;production-quality code&nbsp;to: <ul> <li>Automate operational workflows</li> <li>Improve reliability and observability</li> <li>Eliminate manual intervention and reduce incident frequency</li> </ul> </li> <li>Contribute primarily in&nbsp;Python, with exposure to JVM-based systems as needed</li> <li>Review code with a strong emphasis on&nbsp;operability, resiliency, and maintainability</li> <li>Advocate for “build it so it can be operated” engineering standards</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Leadership &amp; Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide&nbsp;technical leadership without formal authority, influencing design and operational decisions</li> <li>Mentor engineers through pairing, reviews, and incident leadership</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer teams</li> <li>Operate effectively in&nbsp;high-pressure, ambiguous environments, especially during customer-impacting incidents</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you bring to the team</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in&nbsp;software engineering, SRE, sustaining engineering, or production operations</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience operating&nbsp;production systems in AWS</li> <li>Strong experience troubleshooting&nbsp;Databricks and large-scale data platforms</li> <li>Proficiency in&nbsp;Python&nbsp;and experience building production services or tooling</li> <li>Strong understanding of: <ul> <li>Distributed systems</li> <li>Incident management and RCA practices</li> <li>Monitoring, alerting, and observability</li> <li>CI/CD Pipelines that leverage Infrastructure as Code.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Proven ability to own problems&nbsp;end-to-end, from detection to permanent resolution</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, especially during incidents and customer escalations</li> <li>Ability to work backward from customer impact to root cause across systems and codebases, delivering fixes in environments with minimal documentation.</li> <li>Strong instinct for operational risk, with the ability to proactively identify failure modes and harden systems before they impact customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we would like to see, but not required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in&nbsp;healthcare, health insurance, or regulated data environments</li> <li>Familiarity with: <ul> <li>Kubernetes (EKS), EMR, Lambda</li> <li>Spark tiger-team roles</li> <li>Experience contributing to or operating within SRE/on-call programs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:&nbsp;</strong>Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll get in return:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid time off – full_description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> </div></div><h2 class="chakra-heading css-17hyekh"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Day-to-Day Responsibilities:</span></h2> <ul class="chakra-list__root css-192by25"> <li class="chakra-list__item css-7nbze4" style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Collaborative Teamwork</strong>: Partner with engineers, program managers, and domain specialists to conceive, architect, build, and maintain applications that meet AFS clients’ needs.</span></li> <li class="chakra-list__item css-7nbze4" style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Data Synthesis</strong>: Understand a client’s most critical objectives and synthesize disparate information into a cohesive vision and actionable roadmap, interpreting what the data signifies and outlining an impact-based plan to rapidly go from use case to prototype to scaled deployment.</span></li> <li class="chakra-list__item css-7nbze4" style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Rapid Iteration</strong>: Quickly iterate, build from scratch, and help transform clients' operations at uncommon speed. You won’t just deploy software—you’ll help reshape how entire organizations work by putting powerful tools in the hands of executives and real operators.</span></li> <li class="chakra-list__item css-7nbze4" style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Production-Grade Solutions</strong>: Develop production-grade solutions that make sense of the client’s data and process it through an actionable workflow that can help clients make better decisions.</span></li> <li class="chakra-list__item css-7nbze4" style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Collaboration</strong>: Collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues to define solution requirements, iterate on the solution, and ship code.</span></li> </ul> <p>Key Responsibilities:</p> <ul> <li>Deliver end‑to‑end, production-grade data and AI solutions on Databricks platforms.</li> <li>Design and build scalable data pipelines, APIs, and user-facing applications using Spark and modern big‑data engines.</li> <li>Design and build Databricks Apps, including both front‑end and back‑end components.</li> <li>Integrate LLMs and AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) into applications and data workflows.</li> <li>Deploy solutions to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and monitor production systems for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.</li> <li>Debug complex issues across the full stack, including data pipelines, application services, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations.</li> <li>Implement CI/CD workflows, automated testing, and secure, repeatable production deployments.</li> <li>Ensure data governance, quality, and security through best practices and tools like Unity Catalog.</li> <li>Partner directly with customer stakeholders to define requirements, architect solutions, and provide hands-on technical guidance.</li> <li>Produce clear documentation, runbooks, and technical enablement materials for long-term maintainability.</li> </ul> <h2 class="chakra-heading css-17hyekh"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What We Look For:</span></h2> <ul class="chakra-list__root css-192by25"> <li class="chakra-list__item title: Analytics Engineer I
location: New York, New York, United States
full_description: <p>Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring an Analytics Engineer I to join our Data Team.</p> <p>Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>The Analytics Engineer I designs, builds, and maintains dimensional models and data transformations that convert raw operational data into reliable, well-structured analytical assets. You’ll work within Oscar’s unified data foundation in dbt, partnering with domain experts and stakeholders to capture business logic and translate it into dimensional models that serve analytics use cases across the organization. Under the guidance of more senior Analytics Engineers, you’ll build and maintain models, implement automated tests to ensure long-term data product health, and contribute to the semantic layer that powers enterprise business intelligence. This is a hands-on role focused on growing your craft in dimensional modeling, SQL, and analytics engineering within a healthcare environment.</p> <p>You will report into the Associate Director, Data Science.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Work Location: </strong>This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule.</p> <p><strong>Pay Transparency: </strong>The base pay for this role is: $106,812 - $140,190.75 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants, and annual performance bonuses.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrates a strong working knowledge of Oscar's analytics technologies and tools as well as the breadth of content contained within.</li> <li>Contribute to the development and documentation of best practices for engineering and analytics development, consistent with industry standards and internal guidelines.</li> <li>Under the guidance of more senior Analytics Engineers, partner with Subject Matter Experts and Business stakeholders to explore data, define business requirements, design and implement solutions for one or more data transformation and/or downstream semantic layer systems.</li> <li>Advance the Analytics Engineering roadmap by executing on small-to-medium projects with minimal oversight</li> <li>Contribute to the administration of the analytics platform, including but not limited to active participation in support channels and actioning&nbsp; access requests.</li> <li>Leverage a working knowledge of existing data quality checks as well as monitoring and alerting pipelines to perform Root Cause Analyses of data defects as needed and escalate to the appropriate team when warranted.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.</li> <li>1+ years of experience working with SQL.</li> <li>1+ years of experience developing in a semantic modeling language (e.g. LookML).</li> <li>1+ years of experience developing within a modern data transformation tool like DBT.</li> <li>1+ years of experience with cloud database tools (GCP, AWS, Azure).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working with healthcare or insurance industry data, analytics, and reporting.</li> <li>Experience with Google Cloud Platform and dbt.</li> <li>Experience building dimensional models (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions).</li> <li>Strong communication skills, as demonstrated by experience partnering with non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity. The core challenge is data modeling: transforming messy, per-instrument measurements into clean, well-typed data that is efficient to query, reliable to use, and ready for downstream analysis.</p> <p>You’ll also build domain-specific analysis functions and reusable data pipelines that help scientists and AI researchers move faster without re-deriving bespoke solutions.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <p>• Design pipelines that turn raw lab output into analysis-ready scientific data. • Model heterogeneous data from bio, chemistry, and materials instruments. • Build validation checks, schema-evolution gates, and data quality workflows. • Develop reusable analysis functions for scientific and AI research workflows. • Improve automation and observability across instrument-to-result data flows. • Build canonical datasets that scientists and AI researchers can trust. • Use AI coding tools to accelerate pipeline development and team velocity.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <p>• 2–6 years of experience in data engineering, bioinformatics, cheminformatics, or computational science. •<br>Strong Python skills, including typed, tested, production-quality code.<br>• Strong SQL skills, especially with Postgres or similar relational databases. <br>• Experience building ETL pipelines, data models, and reusable data transformations. <br>• Data science foundation, including statistics and pandas, NumPy, or similar tools. <br>• Experience translating noisy scientific measurements into accurate, validated datasets. <br>• Workflow orchestration experience, ideally Flyte, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or Nextflow. <br>• Active use of AI coding tools in day-to-day engineering work.</p> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <p>• Experience with columnar or lakehouse stacks such as Parquet, Iceberg, DuckDB, Polars, or Ibis.<br>• Familiarity with event-driven pipelines such as NATS or Kafka. • Exposure to lab instrument data formats, LIMS, or ELN systems. <br>• Familiarity with life sciences assays, sequencing, imaging, or flow cytometry. <br>• Familiarity with materials or chemistry methods such as XRD, XRF, SEM, TGA, or DSC. <br>• Experience with curve fitting, peak detection, or unit and dimensional analysis.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div In this highly technical, customer-facing role, you will own end-to-end technical integration work with enterprise customers and partners—from pre-sales through production deployment—bridging complex healthcare systems with Cohere’s AI-first platform. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Customer Success teams to design and execute sophisticated integrations that improve access to care for millions of members.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end technical integration design and execution for enterprise customers, from initial scoping through production deployment, serving as the primary technical authority throughout</li> <li>Lead technical discovery, scoping, and proof-of-concept work during pre-sales cycles, creating technical proposals and estimates to validate feasibility for prospective customers</li> <li>Design system architectures that bridge customer IT environments with Cohere’s platform, making key architectural decisions that balance customer constraints with platform capabilities</li> <li>Work hands-on with AI/ML-enabled healthcare features—including clinical decision support, automated review, and intelligent routing—ensuring they meet regulatory requirements and clinical safety standards</li> <li>Produce high-quality technical artifacts including integration designs, architecture diagrams, data mappings, API implementation guides, and operational runbooks</li> <li>Build reusable integration patterns and templates that scale across customers, and continuously identify opportunities to improve platform capabilities based on implementation learnings</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Customer Success teams to drive successful go-live outcomes and mentor junior team members</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6–10+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend/systems focus</li> <li>Healthcare industry experience, particularly on the payer side (health plans, managed care organizations), including familiarity with healthcare workflows, data standards, and
